domains.name: sequencing
domains.description: Core NGS operations including WGS, WES, targeted sequencing, library preparation, flow cell management, multiplexing, demultiplexing, and raw data generation. Manages sequencing runs, read quality (Phred scores), coverage depth, read length, and FASTQ output. Central to genomic data production workflows integrated with Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub.

products.name: sequencing_run
products.description: Core master record for each NGS sequencing run executed on an instrument. Captures run identity, instrument assignment, flow cell, run mode (WGS, WES, targeted), read length, paired-end configuration, run status (queued, in-progress, completed, failed), start/end timestamps, operator, reagent kit lot, BaseSpace run ID, total cycles, and run-level QC pass/fail outcome. This is the central operational entity of the sequencing domain — every downstream FASTQ, QC metric, and library result traces back to a sequencing run.

attributes.name: sequencing_run_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) run record in the Databricks Silver layer. Primary key for the sequencing_run entity. Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — this entity represents a discrete NGS sequencing execution event with a full operational lifecycle.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run Object Model

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.validation_study. Business justification: Sequencing runs are used in validation studies (assay validation, instrument qualification, method verification, software validation). Labs must link validation runs to study records for regulatory su

attributes.name: actual_sample_count
attributes.description: Actual number of samples successfully demultiplexed and yielding usable FASTQ data from this run. May differ from planned_sample_count due to index mismatches, low-quality libraries, or run failures. Key metric for run efficiency and yield reporting.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Demultiplexing Report; CLIA §493.1291

attributes.name: basespace_run_code
attributes.description: The unique run identifier assigned by Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub for this sequencing run. Used to link the internal enterprise record to the BaseSpace cloud platform for FASTQ retrieval, run monitoring, and bioinformatics pipeline initiation.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run API Object; Illumina Run Monitoring Documentation

attributes.name: cluster_density
attributes.description: The density of sequencing clusters generated on the flow cell surface, measured in thousands of clusters per mm². A critical run quality parameter — too low indicates under-loading, too high causes cluster overlap and quality degradation. Reported by the instrument and BaseSpace.
attributes.references: Illumina Flow Cell Loading Guidelines; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run Metrics

attributes.name: cluster_pf_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of clusters that pass the Illumina chastity filter (PF = Passing Filter), indicating the proportion of reads with sufficient signal purity for reliable base calling. A key run-level QC metric; typically expected to be >75-80% for a passing run.
attributes.references: Illumina Quality Metrics Documentation; CAP NGS Checklist NGS.40100; ISO 20166

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this sequencing run record was first created in the enterprise data system (LIMS or BaseSpace ingestion). Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED timestamp for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity. Distinct from run_start_timestamp which reflects the physical run start. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GxP 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; ISO 27001 Audit Logging; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: data_retention_category
attributes.description: Data retention classification for this sequencing run record and its associated FASTQ/BAM/VCF outputs, determining the minimum retention period per applicable regulations. 'standard' = 2 years (RUO); 'extended' = 10+ years (clinical/GxP); 'permanent' = indefinite (regulatory submission data); 'restricted_deletion' = deletion requires regulatory approval.
attributes.references: HIPAA §164.530(j) Record Retention; CLIA §493.1105; FDA 21 CFR §211.180; GDPR Article 5(1)(e); NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: demultiplexing_status
attributes.description: Current status of the FASTQ demultiplexing process for this run, which separates pooled (multiplexed) sample reads by their index barcodes into individual sample FASTQ files. Tracks the post-run data processing step that precedes bioinformatics pipeline execution.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — DRAGEN Demultiplexing; Illumina bcl2fastq Documentation

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the sequencing run completed (final cycle finished or run terminated). Used with run_start_timestamp to calculate run duration and TAT. Null if run is still in progress or queued. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run End Time; LabVantage LIMS

attributes.name: error_rate_pct
attributes.description: The base-level sequencing error rate for this run expressed as a percentage, calculated using PhiX control spike-in alignment. Lower values indicate higher sequencing accuracy. Used for run QC acceptance/rejection decisions and instrument performance trending.
attributes.references: Illumina PhiX Control Library; Illumina BaseSpace Run Metrics; CAP NGS Checklist NGS.40200

attributes.name: fastq_output_path
attributes.description: The storage path or URI (e.g., S3 bucket path, BaseSpace project URL, or HPC filesystem path) where the FASTQ output files for this run are stored. Confidential as it reveals internal data infrastructure topology. Used by bioinformatics pipelines to locate raw sequencing data.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; HIPAA §164.312 Technical Safeguards

attributes.name: flow_cell_type
attributes.description: The type/format of flow cell used in this run (e.g., SP, S1, S2, S4 for NovaSeq; P1, P2, P3 for NovaSeq X; nano, micro for MiSeq). Determines lane count, cluster capacity, and maximum output yield. Critical for run planning and cost accounting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SP|S1|S2|S4|P1|P2|P3|nano|micro|high|mid — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Illumina Flow Cell Specifications; SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Master (Consumables)

attributes.name: folder_name
attributes.description: The instrument-generated run folder name following Illumina naming convention (e.g., '240115_A00001_0001_AHXXXXXX'). Contains date, instrument serial, run number, and flow cell ID. Used for data traceability between instrument output and enterprise data systems.
attributes.references: Illumina Instrument Run Folder Naming Convention; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: index_read_length
attributes.description: Number of base pairs sequenced for the index (barcode) reads used in multiplexing/demultiplexing. Typically 6, 8, or 10 bp per index. Determines the number of samples that can be multiplexed on a single flow cell and the accuracy of demultiplexing.
attributes.references: Illumina Multiplexing Guidelines; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run Parameters

attributes.name: is_paired_end
attributes.description: Indicates whether this run was configured as paired-end (True) or single-read (False) sequencing. Paired-end sequencing generates reads from both ends of a DNA fragment, improving alignment accuracy and variant detection. Critical parameter for bioinformatics pipeline configuration.
attributes.references: Illumina Paired-End Sequencing Technology; NGS Library Preparation Best Practices

attributes.name: lane_count
attributes.description: Number of lanes on the flow cell used in this sequencing run (e.g., 1 for MiSeq, 2 for NextSeq, 4 for NovaSeq SP/S1/S2, 8 for NovaSeq S4). Used for per-lane QC analysis, sample distribution planning, and run capacity calculations.
attributes.references: Illumina Flow Cell Architecture Documentation; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Lane Metrics

attributes.name: library_prep_kit
attributes.description: Name or catalog identifier of the library preparation kit used to prepare samples for this sequencing run (e.g., 'Illumina DNA Prep', 'TruSeq Stranded mRNA', 'Nextera DNA Flex'). Affects sequencing performance, adapter trimming parameters, and bioinformatics pipeline configuration.
attributes.references: Illumina Library Preparation Kit Catalog; LabVantage LIMS — Protocol Management; ISO 13485 §7.5

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operator or QC reviewer notes about this sequencing run, including observations about run performance, deviations from SOP, troubleshooting actions taken, or contextual information relevant to data interpretation. Supports GxP deviation documentation.
attributes.references: GxP SOP Documentation Requirements; CLIA §493.1291; ISO 15189 §5.8

attributes.name: output_yield_gb
attributes.description: Total sequencing data output generated by this run measured in gigabases (Gb). Represents the QUANTITATIVE_RESULT for this non-monetary TRANSACTION_HEADER. Used for run performance benchmarking, storage capacity planning, and comparison against instrument specifications.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run Metrics; Illumina Instrument Specification Sheets

attributes.name: phix_spike_in_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of PhiX bacteriophage control library spiked into the sequencing run for real-time quality monitoring and error rate calibration. Typically 1-5% for standard runs. Used to calculate error_rate_pct and validate instrument performance.
attributes.references: Illumina PhiX Control v3 Library Documentation; CAP NGS Checklist

attributes.name: planned_sample_count
attributes.description: Number of samples planned to be multiplexed and sequenced in this run as defined in the sample sheet at run setup. Used for capacity planning, reagent consumption estimation, and comparison against actual demultiplexed sample count.
attributes.references: Illumina Sample Sheet Specification; LabVantage LIMS — Run Planning

attributes.name: q30_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of bases with a Phred quality score of 30 or higher (Q30), indicating ≥99.9% base call accuracy. The primary industry-standard run quality metric. Typically required to be >75-80% for a run to pass QC. Directly impacts variant calling accuracy and clinical reporting confidence.
attributes.references: Phred Quality Score Standard (Ewing & Green 1998); CAP NGS Checklist; CLIA §493.1253; Illumina BaseSpace Run Metrics

attributes.name: qc_reviewed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the QC review of this sequencing run was completed and the run_qc_status was formally assigned. Part of the GxP electronic audit trail. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: qc_status
attributes.description: The overall QC pass/fail determination for this sequencing run based on evaluation of run metrics (Q30%, cluster density, error rate, yield). 'pass' = all metrics within specification; 'fail' = one or more critical metrics out of specification; 'pending_review' = awaiting manual QC review; 'conditional_pass' = passed with noted deviations. Determines whether downstream FASTQ data is released for analysis.
attributes.references: CAP NGS Checklist; CLIA §493.1253; ISO 15189 §5.6; GxP QC Release Procedures

attributes.name: read_length
attributes.description: The number of base pairs sequenced per read in this run (e.g., 75, 100, 150, 250 bp). A key sequencing parameter that determines data quality, coverage, and application suitability. Configured at run setup and recorded for QC and reproducibility.
attributes.references: Illumina Sequencing by Synthesis Technology; NGS Best Practices; ISO 20166 Molecular In Vitro Diagnostic Examinations

attributes.name: run_mode
attributes.description: The NGS application type or sequencing strategy for this run. Determines the library preparation approach, bioinformatics pipeline, and downstream analysis. WGS = Whole Genome Sequencing; WES = Whole Exome Sequencing; targeted = targeted panel sequencing; amplicon = amplicon-based sequencing; RNA-seq = transcriptome sequencing; metagenomics = environmental/microbial sequencing.
attributes.references: NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; Illumina Application Notes; IVDR 2017/746 Annex I

attributes.name: run_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name assigned to the sequencing run, typically following a lab naming convention (e.g., 'RUN-2024-001-NovaSeq'). Used for identification in LIMS, BaseSpace, and operational dashboards. Maps to the Run Name field in Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run Name Field; LabVantage LIMS

attributes.name: run_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the sequencing run, assigned by the LIMS or laboratory operations system. Used for cross-system referencing, customer reporting, and regulatory traceability. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Run Number; CLIA 42 CFR §493.1291; ISO 15189 §5.8

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the sequencing run. Drives operational workflows, downstream pipeline triggering, and SLA monitoring. 'queued' = scheduled but not started; 'in_progress' = actively sequencing; 'completed' = run finished successfully; 'failed' = run terminated with errors; 'aborted' = manually stopped; 'paused' = temporarily halted. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run Status Enumeration; LabVantage LIMS Workflow States

attributes.name: run_type
attributes.description: Classification of the run by its intended use context. 'clinical' = IVD/LDT clinical diagnostic run subject to CLIA/CAP; 'research' = RUO research run; 'validation' = assay validation run; 'QC' = quality control run; 'development' = R&D development run. Determines applicable regulatory framework and data handling requirements.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR §493; CAP Accreditation Standards; FDA IVD Regulations 21 CFR Part 820; IVDR 2017/746

attributes.name: sample_sheet_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Illumina sample sheet file used to configure this sequencing run, specifying sample IDs, index sequences, and demultiplexing parameters. Used for run reproducibility, troubleshooting, and audit trail. Maps to Illumina SampleSheet.csv versioning.
attributes.references: Illumina Sample Sheet v2 Specification; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run Configuration

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the sequencing run was initiated on the instrument (first cycle commenced). Serves as the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity. Used for TAT (Turnaround Time) calculation, SLA monitoring, and run scheduling. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run Start Time; LabVantage LIMS; CLIA §493.1291

attributes.name: target_coverage_depth
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Coverage Depth (Mean Depth of Coverage)
attributes.description: The intended mean sequencing coverage depth (number of times each base is sequenced) specified at run design time (e.g., 30x for WGS, 100x for WES, 500x for targeted panels). Used to validate whether the run met its coverage objectives and for clinical reporting thresholds.
attributes.references: ACMG/AMP Variant Interpretation Guidelines; CAP NGS Checklist; CLIA §493.1253

attributes.name: total_cycles
attributes.description: Total number of sequencing chemistry cycles executed in this run. For paired-end runs, this includes both read 1, index reads, and read 2 cycles (e.g., 2×150 bp = 300 cycles + index cycles). Used for run cost accounting, reagent consumption tracking, and run configuration validation.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run Parameters; Illumina Reagent Kit Specifications

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this sequencing run record was last modified in the enterprise data system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED timestamp for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity. Used for change tracking, data synchronization, and audit compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GxP 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 27001; SOX Section 404

products.name: flow_cell
products.description: Master record for each physical flow cell consumable loaded onto a sequencing instrument. Tracks flow cell serial number, part number, lot number, flow cell type (e.g., S1, S2, S4, SP for NovaSeq; MID, HIGH for NextSeq), number of lanes, cluster density specification, maximum output (Gb), expiry date, storage conditions, receipt date, and current status (in-stock, loaded, consumed, failed). Links to reagent domain for procurement lineage and to sequencing_run for usage tracking.

attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each flow cell master record in the Genomics Biotech lakehouse. Primary key for the flow_cell data product. Role: MASTER_RESOURCE.

attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 6.3 — Infrastructure; LabVantage LIMS Instrument Management

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reagent.coa. Business justification: Flow cells require Certificate of Analysis verification for GxP-compliant sequencing runs, quality control, and regulatory audits. supplier_lot_certificate_number is a reference string, not a denormal

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.deviation. Business justification: Flow cells with cold_chain_breach_flag or QC failures require deviation records in GxP genomics labs. Direct FK enables traceability from a specific flow cell to the deviation raised against it — a st

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reagent.lot. Business justification: Flow cells are reagent consumables requiring lot-level traceability for recall management, expiry enforcement, and QC release status. The existing flow_cell FKs cover catalog and COA but not the speci

attributes.name: manufacturing_production_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.production_batch. Business justification: Vertically-integrated genomics companies manufacturing flow cells in-house require full batch traceability for regulatory compliance (ISO 13485, FDA QSR). Flow cell performance issues (low cluster den

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material. Business justification: Flow cells are materials in supply chain. Link enables inventory management, MRP planning, demand forecasting, and integration with ERP material master for procurement, costing, and warehouse manageme

attributes.name: nonconformance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.nonconformance. Business justification: Flow cells failing incoming QC inspection (qc_inspection_status present) require formal nonconformance records for material disposition under ISO 13485 / GxP material control. A genomics lab QA expert

attributes.name: qc_result_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.qc_result. Business justification: Flow cells undergo incoming QC inspection (qc_inspection_status, qc_inspection_date on flow_cell). The formal QC result record must be traceable from the flow cell for ISO 13485 incoming material insp

attributes.name: regulatory_classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.regulatory_classification. Business justification: Flow cells used in IVD applications require regulatory classification traceability for FDA/CE compliance. The plain column regulatory_use_classification is denormalized from product.regulatory_classif

attributes.name: sequencing_run_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the sequencing run associated with this flow cell. Links to the sequencing_run data product for run parameters, quality metrics, and FASTQ output tracking. A flow cell may be associated with at most one sequencing run in its lifecycle.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run Object; LabVantage LIMS Run Tracking

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Flow cell inventory management requires SKU-level tracking (lane count variant, read length configuration). Procurement reorder points and lot-level COGS accounting depend on the specific SKU consumed

attributes.name: specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.specification. Business justification: Flow cell QC inspection compares actual performance against product specifications. Columns cluster_density_spec_mm2, max_output_gb, read_length_spec are denormalized from product.specification. Linki

attributes.name: basespace_flow_cell_code
attributes.description: External identifier assigned to this flow cell within the Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub system. Enables cross-system reconciliation between the internal lakehouse record and the BaseSpace sequencing data management platform. Used for data lineage and run data retrieval.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub API — Flow Cell Object

attributes.name: cold_chain_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a temperature excursion or cold chain breach was detected during shipping or storage of this flow cell (True = breach detected). Triggers quarantine workflow and quality investigation in LabVantage LIMS and Veeva Vault. A breached flow cell must not be used until cleared by QA.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 7.5.11 — Preservation of Product; GMP 21 CFR Part 211.142; GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: consumed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the sequencing run was completed and the flow cell was fully consumed or removed from the instrument. Marks the end of the flow cell's active lifecycle. Used for TAT reporting, instrument utilization metrics, and inventory depletion tracking.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run Completion Metadata; LabVantage LIMS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the flow cell master record was first created in the Genomics Biotech lakehouse, typically at the point of goods receipt registration. Supports audit trail requirements under GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, and SOX internal controls.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 — Electronic Records; SOX Section 404; ISO 27001 — Audit Logging

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the unit_cost field (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Enables multi-currency financial reporting and cost normalization across global procurement activities.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI — Financial Accounting

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the consumed, failed, or expired flow cell was disposed of per the applicable disposal method. Required for environmental compliance records and GMP documentation of consumable lifecycle closure.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 261; ISO 13485 Section 4.2 — Record Control; GMP 21 CFR Part 211.67

attributes.name: disposal_method
attributes.description: Method used for disposal of the consumed or failed flow cell. Governs environmental health and safety (EHS) compliance for waste management. Options include standard laboratory waste, biohazardous waste, chemical waste, or return to supplier for failed/defective units.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 261 — Hazardous Waste; ISO 14001 — Environmental Management; GMP 21 CFR Part 211.67

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Manufacturer-specified expiration date after which the flow cell must not be used for sequencing. Critical for GMP compliance, inventory management, and preventing use of expired consumables that could compromise sequencing quality. Monitored in SAP S/4HANA QM and LabVantage LIMS for automated expiry alerts.
attributes.references: GMP 21 CFR Part 211.122; ISO 13485 Section 7.5.11 — Preservation of Product; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.150

attributes.name: facility_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the Genomics Biotech facility (laboratory or sequencing center) where this flow cell is stored and used. Supports multi-site inventory management, site-level capacity planning, and regulatory site-specific compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 6.3 — Infrastructure; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493 — Laboratory Requirements

attributes.name: flow_cell_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the physical flow cell consumable. Tracks the operational state from receipt through consumption or disposal. 'in_stock' = received and available; 'reserved' = allocated to a planned run; 'loaded' = currently on instrument; 'consumed' = run completed; 'failed' = quality failure; 'expired' = past expiry date; 'quarantined' = held for investigation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: in_stock|reserved|loaded|consumed|failed|expired|quarantined — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 7.5 — Production and Service Provision; LabVantage LIMS Inventory Status Workflow

attributes.name: flow_cell_type
attributes.description: Instrument-specific flow cell format designation indicating throughput tier and lane configuration (e.g., S1, S2, S4, SP for NovaSeq 6000; MID, HIGH for NextSeq 550; P1, P2, P3 for NovaSeq X). Determines maximum output (Gb), number of lanes, and cluster density specifications. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: S1|S2|S4|SP|MID|HIGH|P1|P2|P3 — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Illumina Flow Cell Specification Sheets; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub Metadata Standards

attributes.name: instrument_platform
attributes.description: The sequencing instrument platform for which this flow cell is designed and compatible (e.g., NovaSeq 6000, NovaSeq X, NextSeq 2000, MiSeq). Governs compatibility rules for loading, reagent kits, and run parameters. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NovaSeq 6000|NovaSeq X|NextSeq 550|NextSeq 2000|MiSeq|HiSeq 4000|iSeq 100 — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Illumina Instrument Compatibility Matrix; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: intended_application
attributes.description: Primary sequencing application for which this flow cell is designated (e.g., WGS — Whole Genome Sequencing, WES — Whole Exome Sequencing, targeted sequencing, RNA-seq, single-cell). Drives run parameter configuration and quality acceptance criteria. Also distinguishes Research Use Only (RUO) from In Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) use contexts for regulatory compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WGS|WES|targeted_sequencing|amplicon|RNA_seq|single_cell|RUO|IVD — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA IVD Regulation 21 CFR Part 809; IVDR EU 2017/746; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493

attributes.name: is_single_use
attributes.description: Indicates whether the flow cell is designed for single use only (True) or supports multiple sequencing runs (False). Governs reuse policies, disposal procedures, and run scheduling logic. Most modern Illumina flow cells are single-use; this flag supports future platform compatibility.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 7.5.11; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.70 — Production and Process Controls

attributes.name: lane_count
attributes.description: Number of independent sequencing lanes on the flow cell (e.g., 1, 2, or 4 lanes for NovaSeq S1/S2/S4). Each lane can be loaded with a separate library pool, enabling multiplexing strategies. Drives capacity planning for sample batching and run scheduling.
attributes.references: Illumina Flow Cell Specification Sheets; NGS Run Planning Best Practices

attributes.name: lims_barcode
attributes.description: Barcode label scanned into LabVantage LIMS at receipt to register the flow cell in the laboratory inventory system. Used for physical tracking, chain-of-custody documentation, and automated workflow triggering in the LIMS. May differ from the manufacturer serial number.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Inventory Management; ISO 15189 Section 5.4 — Pre-examination Processes

attributes.name: loaded_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the flow cell was physically loaded onto the sequencing instrument, marking the transition from 'reserved' to 'loaded' status. Recorded in Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub and LabVantage LIMS. Used for run scheduling, instrument utilization analysis, and TAT (Turnaround Time) calculations.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run Metadata; LabVantage LIMS Workflow Tracking

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: Date the flow cell was manufactured by the supplier, as printed on the product label or Certificate of Analysis (COA). Used for shelf-life calculations, lot traceability, and quality investigations. Sourced from the COA accompanying the shipment.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 7.5.8 — Identification and Traceability; GMP 21 CFR Part 211.68

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for laboratory personnel to record observations, anomalies, deviations, or special handling instructions associated with this flow cell. Examples include cold chain deviation details, physical damage observations, or QA hold reasons. Captured in LabVantage LIMS.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 4.2 — Document Control; GMP 21 CFR Part 211.68

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA purchase order number under which this flow cell was procured. Provides procurement lineage linking the physical consumable to the financial transaction, supplier contract, and goods receipt documentation. Supports COGS tracking and financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchase Order Management; SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls

attributes.name: qc_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date on which the incoming QC inspection was performed for this flow cell. Used for compliance audit trails, SOP adherence tracking, and calculating time-from-receipt-to-clearance metrics.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 7.4.3; GMP 21 CFR Part 211.84; SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: qc_inspection_status
attributes.description: Result of the incoming quality control inspection performed upon receipt of the flow cell. 'pending' = inspection not yet completed; 'passed' = meets acceptance criteria; 'failed' = does not meet criteria, quarantined; 'waived' = inspection waived per approved SOP (e.g., for pre-qualified lots). Managed in SAP S/4HANA QM and LabVantage LIMS.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 7.4.3 — Verification of Purchased Product; GMP 21 CFR Part 211.84; SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: reagent_kit_lot_number
attributes.description: Lot number of the sequencing reagent kit used in conjunction with this flow cell. Enables paired traceability between the flow cell consumable and its associated reagent kit for quality investigations, recall management, and GMP compliance. Sourced from LabVantage LIMS run setup records.
attributes.references: GMP 21 CFR Part 211.68; ISO 13485 Section 7.5.8 — Identification and Traceability

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: Date the flow cell was physically received at the Genomics Biotech facility and logged into inventory. Recorded in SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Receipt and LabVantage LIMS. Used to calculate storage duration, validate shelf life, and support FIFO inventory management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Goods Receipt; ISO 13485 Section 7.4.3 — Verification of Purchased Product

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned unique serial number printed on the physical flow cell cartridge. Used as the primary external identifier for traceability across LabVantage LIMS, Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub, and SAP S/4HANA inventory management. Enables one-to-one mapping between the physical consumable and its digital record.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 7.5.8 — Identification and Traceability; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.60

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the physical storage location (e.g., freezer unit, shelf, rack position) where the flow cell is currently stored within the facility. Managed in SAP S/4HANA MM Warehouse Management and LabVantage LIMS. Enables rapid physical retrieval and inventory audits.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Warehouse Management; ISO 13485 Section 6.3 — Infrastructure

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius as specified by the manufacturer. Paired with storage_temperature_min_c to define the acceptable cold chain range. Monitored against environmental monitoring system data to ensure GMP-compliant storage conditions.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 7.5.11 — Preservation of Product; GMP 21 CFR Part 211.142

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum required storage temperature in degrees Celsius as specified by the manufacturer. Used to validate cold chain compliance during receipt inspection and ongoing storage monitoring. Deviations from this range trigger quarantine and quality investigation workflows.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 7.5.11 — Preservation of Product; GMP 21 CFR Part 211.142

attributes.name: supplier_lot_certificate_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supplier Lot Certificate of Analysis (COA) Number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Certificate of Analysis (COA) issued by the supplier for this specific lot. The COA documents manufacturer QC test results confirming the flow cell meets specification. Stored in Veeva Vault for regulatory document management and GMP compliance.
attributes.references: GMP 21 CFR Part 211.84; ISO 13485 Section 7.4.3; Veeva Vault Quality Document Management

attributes.name: supplier_name
attributes.description: Name of the external supplier or manufacturer who supplied this flow cell (e.g., Illumina, Inc.). Used for procurement lineage, supplier qualification tracking, and quality management. Linked to the reagent and consumable domain for full procurement traceability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Vendor Master; ISO 13485 Section 7.4 — Purchasing

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Actual procurement cost per flow cell unit in the operating currency (USD). Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM invoice verification. Used for Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) allocation, run cost accounting, and financial reporting. Classified as confidential due to commercial sensitivity of supplier pricing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO — Cost Object Controlling; SOX Section 404; GAAP/IFRS Inventory Valuation

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the flow cell master record. Tracks status transitions, QC result updates, and any modifications to the record. Required for data lineage, GxP audit trails, and Silver Layer change tracking in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 — Electronic Records; ISO 27001 — Audit Logging; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

products.name: library
products.description: Master record representing a prepared sequencing library — the biochemically processed form of a biological sample ready for loading onto a flow cell. Captures library identity, source sample reference (FK to sample domain), preparation protocol and kit, insert size (bp), concentration (nM), quantification method (qPCR, Bioanalyzer, Qubit), library type (WGS, WES, amplicon, RNA-seq, ChIP-seq, targeted panel, methylation), adapter sequences, unique dual index (UDI) assignment, strand specificity, preparation date, operator, QC status (pass/fail/pending), volume remaining (µL), and storage location (plate/well). SSOT for library identity within the sequencing domain — the central entity linking sample preparation to sequencing output and the primary unit of work for coverage tracking.

attributes.name: library_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the sequencing library record within the Genomics Biotech data platform. Primary key for the library master record. MASTER_RESOURCE role — serves as the SSOT for library identity within the sequencing domain.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Libraries prepared for customer samples in service/contract research. Essential for sample ownership tracking, billing, data access control, consent management, and regulatory compliance (PHI/GDPR).

attributes.name: accreditation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.accreditation. Business justification: Libraries prepared for clinical/diagnostic use must be traceable to the customer's CLIA/CAP accreditation for regulatory audit and IVD compliance. Clinical genomics labs require this traceability at t

attributes.name: aliquot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sample.aliquot. Business justification: A sequencing library is prepared from a specific aliquot. GMP chain-of-custody, freeze-thaw tracking, and QC failure investigations require knowing exactly which aliquot was used. Genomics LIMS expert

attributes.name: approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.regulatory_approval. Business justification: Libraries used in IVD/clinical workflows must be traceable to the regulatory approval authorizing the assay. Required for 21 CFR Part 820 device history records and ISO 13485 traceability. Genomics la

attributes.name: assay_development_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.assay_development. Business justification: Libraries prepared for assay development validation must link to the assay_development record. Assay development programs track library type, insert size, and prep kit requirements — all defined in as

attributes.name: assay_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.assay_version. Business justification: A library is prepared according to an assay version's library_preparation_protocol and quality thresholds. CLIA labs must document which assay version governed library preparation for regulatory audit

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.contact. Business justification: Sample submitter/technical contact for library-specific communications: QC results, resequencing decisions, consent verification. Critical for customer-facing service labs and regulatory traceability.

attributes.name: container_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the physical plate or rack in which the library is stored. Used for laboratory inventory management, retrieval workflows, and storage location tracking within the LIMS.

attributes.name: extraction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sample.extraction. Business justification: Libraries are prepared from extracted nucleic acid. Extraction quality metrics (RIN, yield, purity) are direct inputs to library QC. Regulatory traceability (CAP/CLIA) and method validation require li

attributes.name: index_set_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sequencing.index_set. Business justification: Libraries are assigned index adapters from controlled index sets for multiplexing. library currently has adapter_sequence_i7, adapter_sequence_i5, and udi_plate_id but no FK to index_set. Adding index

attributes.name: library_prep_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sequencing.library_prep_run. Business justification: Each library is produced by a specific library preparation run. This is a standard parent-child relationship where library_prep_run is the batch execution entity and library is the output product. Cur

attributes.name: molecular_design_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.molecular_design. Business justification: Targeted sequencing libraries (capture panels, amplicon libraries) are built from specific molecular designs defining target loci and probe sequences. Linking library to molecular_design enables trace

attributes.name: multiplexing_pool_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the multiplexing pool to which this library has been assigned for co-loading onto a flow cell. Enables tracking of pooled libraries, demultiplexing yield analysis, and per-library coverage attribution within a pooled run.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; LabVantage LIMS

attributes.name: nonconformance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.nonconformance. Business justification: Libraries failing QC (qc_status, qc_failure_reason on library) require nonconformance records for material disposition decisions in GxP genomics. Library already links to oos_investigation and qc_resu

attributes.name: oos_investigation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.oos_investigation. Business justification: Libraries with out-of-specification QC results (concentration out of range, wrong fragment size, high adapter dimer) trigger OOS investigations. Labs link investigations to specific libraries for root

attributes.name: original_library_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original library record when this library is a resequencing attempt (resequencing_flag = True). Enables lineage tracking across preparation attempts and supports failure analysis workflows. Null for original preparations.

attributes.name: prep_kit_catalog_item_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prep Kit Catalog Item Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.catalog_item. Business justification: Library prep kits are commercial catalog items. Labs track which kit SKU was used for cost allocation, protocol validation, regulatory compliance, and troubleshooting quality issues. Essential for GxP

attributes.name: prep_kit_sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Library prep kit SKU traceability is required for lot-level COGS accounting and inventory depletion. In regulated genomics labs, the specific kit SKU (pack size, configuration) used per library must b

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the research or clinical project under which this library was prepared. Supports project-level tracking, cost allocation, and reporting across the R&D and clinical genomics domains.

attributes.name: qc_result_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.qc_result. Business justification: Libraries undergo QC testing (concentration via Qubit/qPCR, fragment size via Bioanalyzer/TapeStation, adapter dimer assessment). Each library has multiple QC results tracked for batch release, troubl

attributes.name: sample_specimen_id
attributes.description: Reference to the biological sample from which this library was prepared. Links the library to its upstream sample management record, enabling traceability from raw specimen through sequencing output.

attributes.name: specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.specification. Business justification: Library QC pass/fail is evaluated against product specifications (insert size range, PCR cycle count, reaction volume). For OOS investigations and CLIA compliance, the specification version the librar

attributes.name: technical_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.technical_requirement. Business justification: Libraries prepared to meet customer-specified technical requirements (coverage, insert size, prep method). Links library design to customer engagement specifications for acceptance criteria validation

attributes.name: test_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.test_order. Business justification: A library is prepared to fulfill a specific clinical test order. CLIA audit trails require direct traceability from library preparation to the clinical test order, enabling consent verification, TAT t

attributes.name: basespace_library_code
attributes.description: External identifier assigned to this library within Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub. Enables cross-system traceability between the internal LIMS record and the BaseSpace sequencing data management platform for FASTQ retrieval and run association.

attributes.name: concentration_nm
attributes.description: Measured molar concentration of the library in nanomolar (nM) units. Used for accurate loading onto flow cells and pooling calculations during multiplexing. Sourced from quantification instrument output.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; LabVantage LIMS

attributes.name: consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether valid informed consent has been obtained for the use of the source sample in sequencing and data sharing (True = consent confirmed; False = consent not confirmed or withdrawn). Required for HIPAA, GDPR, and NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA; GDPR Article 9; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; IRB requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the library record was first created in the system of record. Supports audit trail requirements, TAT calculations, and data lineage tracking. Aligns with FDA 21 CFR Part 11 electronic record requirements.

attributes.name: data_sharing_restricted
attributes.description: Indicates whether genomic data derived from this library is subject to data sharing restrictions (True = restricted; False = unrestricted). Restrictions may arise from consent limitations, IRB conditions, contractual obligations, or GDPR/HIPAA data subject rights. Governs downstream data product access controls.
attributes.references: HIPAA; GDPR Article 9; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; IRB requirements

attributes.name: input_dna_mass_ng
attributes.description: Mass of input nucleic acid (DNA or RNA) used for library preparation, measured in nanograms (ng). A key QC parameter — insufficient input mass is a leading cause of library preparation failure and low complexity.

attributes.name: insert_size_bp
attributes.description: Target or measured average insert size of the library fragments in base pairs (bp). A key MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE (MASTER_RESOURCE category) for library quality assessment. Impacts read alignment efficiency, coverage uniformity, and variant calling accuracy. Typically 150–500 bp for WGS/WES.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; CAP; CLIA

attributes.name: intended_use
attributes.description: Regulatory classification of the library's intended use. Determines applicable quality, documentation, and reporting requirements. Values: RUO — Research Use Only; IVD — In Vitro Diagnostic; LDT — Laboratory Developed Test; clinical_trial — use in regulated clinical study; research — internal R&D use.
attributes.references: FDA IVD guidance; IVDR 2017/746; CLIA; CAP; ISO 13485

attributes.name: is_paired_end
attributes.description: Indicates whether the library is designed for paired-end (True) or single-read (False) sequencing. Paired-end sequencing generates two reads per fragment, improving alignment accuracy and structural variant detection. Drives instrument run configuration.

attributes.name: is_pcr_free
attributes.description: Indicates whether the library was prepared using a PCR-free protocol (True) or a PCR-amplified protocol (False). PCR-free libraries have lower duplicate rates and reduced GC bias, preferred for high-accuracy WGS applications.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS; Benchling; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: library_code
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier for the sequencing library, used in LIMS, BaseSpace, and laboratory documentation. Follows the internal naming convention LIB-{alphanumeric}. This is the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER (MASTER_RESOURCE category) used across operational systems.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: library_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name assigned to the sequencing library, typically incorporating sample identifier, preparation date, and assay type. Used as the IDENTITY_LABEL (MASTER_RESOURCE category) for display in LIMS dashboards, BaseSpace projects, and laboratory reports.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: library_type
attributes.description: Classification of the sequencing library by assay strategy. Drives downstream bioinformatics pipeline selection, coverage expectations, and reporting templates. CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE (MASTER_RESOURCE category). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WGS|WES|amplicon|RNA-seq|targeted_panel|methylation|ChIP-seq|ATAC-seq|single_cell — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; CLIA; CAP

attributes.name: lims_library_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Library ID
attributes.description: Native identifier for this library record within LabVantage LIMS. Supports bidirectional reconciliation between the Silver Layer data product and the operational LIMS system of record for audit and data lineage purposes.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; GxP

attributes.name: nucleic_acid_type
attributes.description: Type of nucleic acid used as input for library preparation. Drives protocol selection, QC thresholds, and bioinformatics pipeline configuration. Values: gDNA — genomic DNA; cfDNA — cell-free DNA (liquid biopsy); RNA — total or mRNA; cDNA — complementary DNA; FFPE_DNA — formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded DNA; amplicon_DNA — pre-amplified target DNA.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS; CAP; CLIA; FDA IVD guidance

attributes.name: pcr_cycle_count
attributes.description: Number of PCR amplification cycles applied during library preparation. Impacts PCR duplicate rate, GC bias, and library complexity. PCR-free libraries have a value of 0. Tracked for QC benchmarking and protocol optimization.

attributes.name: pooling_proportion_pct
attributes.description: Percentage contribution of this library to the total multiplexing pool by molar concentration. Used to balance per-library coverage in multiplexed sequencing runs and to investigate coverage imbalance post-sequencing.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; LabVantage LIMS

attributes.name: prep_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the library preparation protocol was completed. Used for lot traceability, reagent expiry correlation, and turnaround time (TAT) calculations. Aligns with GxP batch record requirements.

attributes.name: qc_failure_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded description of the reason for QC failure when qc_status is 'fail' or 'conditional_pass'. Supports root-cause analysis, protocol improvement, and regulatory deviation reporting. Null when qc_status is 'pass' or 'pending'.

attributes.name: qc_status
attributes.description: Current quality control disposition of the library. Determines whether the library is eligible for sequencing run loading. LIFECYCLE_STATUS (MASTER_RESOURCE category). Values: pass — meets all QC thresholds; fail — does not meet thresholds; pending — QC not yet completed; conditional_pass — meets minimum thresholds with caveats; requeue — failed and scheduled for re-preparation.

attributes.name: quantification_method
attributes.description: Analytical method used to measure library concentration and/or size distribution. Affects confidence in concentration accuracy and downstream loading calculations. Common methods: qPCR (most accurate for sequenceable molecules), Bioanalyzer/TapeStation (size + concentration), Qubit (fluorometric mass concentration).

attributes.name: resequencing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this library was prepared as a resequencing attempt for a previously failed or insufficient-coverage library (True = resequencing; False = original preparation). Supports TAT tracking, cost analysis, and failure rate reporting.

attributes.name: storage_temperature_c
attributes.description: Required or actual storage temperature for the library in degrees Celsius (e.g., -20°C for long-term, 4°C for short-term). Supports cold chain compliance, stability monitoring, and deviation investigation.

attributes.name: storage_well_position
attributes.description: Well position (e.g., A01, H12) within the storage plate where the library aliquot is located. Combined with storage_plate_id, provides precise physical location for laboratory retrieval and inventory audits.

attributes.name: strand_specificity
attributes.description: Indicates whether the library preserves strand-of-origin information for RNA-seq or other strand-aware assays. Values: unstranded — no strand information retained; forward — read 1 maps to sense strand; reverse — read 1 maps to antisense strand. Required for correct transcript quantification in RNA-seq pipelines.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; Bioinformatics pipeline standards

attributes.name: target_coverage_depth
attributes.description: Intended sequencing coverage depth (read depth) for this library, expressed as fold-coverage (e.g., 30x for WGS, 100x for WES, 500x for targeted panels). Drives sequencing run planning, flow cell loading calculations, and QC pass/fail thresholds.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; CAP; CLIA; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: target_read_length
attributes.description: Intended sequencing read length in base pairs (e.g., 150 bp for paired-end short-read WGS). Determines sequencing run configuration, instrument chemistry selection, and bioinformatics pipeline parameters.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; LabVantage LIMS

attributes.name: udi_plate_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the unique dual index (UDI) plate from which the index pair was assigned. Enables traceability of index assignments across batches and supports investigation of index hopping or cross-contamination events.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; LabVantage LIMS

attributes.name: udi_well_position
attributes.description: Well position (e.g., A01, B12) on the UDI plate from which the index pair was drawn. Together with udi_plate_id, uniquely identifies the index assignment for demultiplexing and audit purposes.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; LabVantage LIMS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the library record. Supports change tracking, audit trail completeness, and Silver Layer incremental load processing. Aligns with FDA 21 CFR Part 11 electronic record requirements.

attributes.name: volume_remaining_ul
attributes.description: Current volume of library material remaining in storage, measured in microliters (µL). Tracks consumable inventory for re-sequencing eligibility and storage management. Updated after each aliquot event.

products.name: library_prep_run
products.description: Transactional record capturing the execution of a library preparation workflow batch. Tracks prep run ID, protocol version, kit lot number, number of samples processed, start/end timestamps, operator, instrument used (e.g., liquid handler), fragmentation method (enzymatic, mechanical), end-repair and adapter ligation steps, PCR amplification cycles, final pooling volume, batch QC outcome, and any deviations from SOP. Enables traceability from raw sample to sequencing-ready library and supports GxP audit requirements.

attributes.name: library_prep_run_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the library preparation run record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — captures a discrete batch execution event with a full lifecycle from initiation through QC disposition.

attributes.name: validation_study_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.validation_study. Business justification: Library prep runs are used in validation studies (kit validation, protocol verification, robustness testing). Labs track which prep runs contributed to validation data for regulatory documentation and

attributes.name: adapter_dimer_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of adapter dimer contamination detected in the final library by electrophoresis (Bioanalyzer/TapeStation). High adapter dimer content reduces effective sequencing yield and is a key QC failure indicator. Typically must be below 5% for pass disposition.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; ISO 13485 Section 8.2.4

attributes.name: adapter_ligation_method
attributes.description: Method used to ligate sequencing adapters to the end-repaired DNA fragments. Tagmentation (Nextera) combines fragmentation and adapter ligation in a single step. Affects ligation efficiency, adapter dimer formation rate, and overall library yield.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the library preparation run record received formal QA/supervisor approval. Distinct from run completion timestamp. Required for GxP electronic record compliance and regulatory audit trail.
attributes.references: MasterControl; Veeva Vault; GxP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 13485 Section 4.2.5

attributes.name: basespace_run_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub Run ID
attributes.description: Run identifier assigned by Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub for the downstream sequencing run associated with this library preparation batch. Enables end-to-end traceability from library preparation through raw data generation and FASTQ output.

attributes.name: batch_qc_outcome
attributes.description: Overall quality control disposition for the library preparation run batch. Determines whether the batch is approved for sequencing submission. A conditional pass may require additional review or re-quantification before proceeding.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS; SAP S/4HANA QM; ISO 13485 Section 8.2.4; GxP; CLIA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this library preparation run record was first created in the source LIMS system. Supports GxP audit trail and data lineage requirements. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS; GxP; ISO 13485 Section 4.2.5; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: deviation_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of any deviation from the approved SOP observed during this library preparation run. Populated only when sop_deviation_flag is True. Supports GxP deviation management, CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) initiation, and regulatory audit readiness.
attributes.references: MasterControl; Veeva Vault; GxP; ISO 13485 Section 8.5.2; FDA 21 CFR Part 820

attributes.name: end_repair_performed
attributes.description: Indicates whether an end-repair and A-tailing step was performed on the fragmented DNA prior to adapter ligation. End repair is required for blunt-end ligation protocols but may be skipped in tagmentation-based workflows.

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the library preparation run was completed or terminated. Used in conjunction with start_timestamp to compute total run duration and TAT metrics. Nullable if run is still in progress.

attributes.name: final_library_concentration_nm
attributes.description: Measured concentration of the final pooled library in nanomolar (nM), typically quantified by qPCR or fluorometric assay (e.g., Qubit). Used to calculate the dilution factor for optimal flow cell loading and to assess library yield.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; ISO 13485 Section 7.5

attributes.name: final_pooling_volume_ul
attributes.description: Total volume in microliters (µL) of the final pooled library submitted for sequencing. Used to calculate loading concentration for the flow cell and to assess library yield sufficiency for sequencing.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; ISO 13485 Section 7.5

attributes.name: fragmentation_method
attributes.description: DNA/RNA fragmentation approach applied during library preparation. Enzymatic fragmentation uses restriction enzymes or transposases (e.g., Nextera); mechanical fragmentation uses sonication or acoustic shearing (e.g., Covaris). Affects insert size distribution and library quality metrics.

attributes.name: index_collision_check_passed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the selected multiplexing index combinations were verified to have sufficient Hamming distance to prevent index hopping or misassignment during demultiplexing. A failed check requires index reassignment before sequencing.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; LabVantage LIMS; ISO 13485 Section 7.5

attributes.name: input_dna_amount_ng
attributes.description: Total mass of input DNA or RNA (in nanograms) used per sample in this library preparation run. Critical QC parameter — insufficient input material is a leading cause of library preparation failure and low-complexity libraries.

attributes.name: input_material_type
attributes.description: Type of nucleic acid input material used for library preparation (e.g., genomic DNA (gDNA), cell-free DNA (cfDNA), RNA, formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) DNA). Determines applicable protocol, QC acceptance criteria, and downstream analytical interpretation.

attributes.name: library_type
attributes.description: Classification of the sequencing library type prepared in this run. Determines downstream bioinformatics pipeline selection, QC thresholds, and sequencing parameters. Examples: Whole Genome Sequencing (WGS), Whole Exome Sequencing (WES), targeted panel, RNA-seq. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WGS|WES|targeted|RNA-seq|amplicon|ChIP-seq|ATAC-seq|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; Benchling; LabVantage LIMS

attributes.name: lims_run_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Run ID
attributes.description: Native run identifier assigned by the source LabVantage LIMS system. Preserved as a cross-reference key to enable bidirectional traceability between the Databricks Silver Layer and the operational LIMS without relying solely on the surrogate primary key.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS; GxP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: mean_fragment_size_bp
attributes.description: Measured mean fragment size in base pairs (bp) of the final library as determined by Bioanalyzer, TapeStation, or equivalent electrophoresis instrument. Compared against target_insert_size_bp to assess size selection success and protocol adherence.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; ISO 13485 Section 7.5

attributes.name: multiplexing_index_set
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the index/barcode set used for sample multiplexing in this library preparation run (e.g., Illumina TruSeq CD Index Set A, IDT for Illumina 10 bp UDI). Enables demultiplexing of pooled samples post-sequencing and prevents index collision errors.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; LabVantage LIMS; ISO 13485 Section 7.5

attributes.name: pcr_amplification_cycles
attributes.description: Number of PCR amplification cycles applied during library preparation. Excessive PCR cycles introduce duplicate reads and GC bias, reducing library complexity. Zero cycles indicates a PCR-free protocol. Key parameter for library quality assessment and protocol compliance.

attributes.name: protocol_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the library preparation SOP or protocol document applied during this run (e.g., v2.1.0). Critical for GxP compliance to confirm the correct, approved protocol version was followed and to detect protocol drift across runs.
attributes.references: MasterControl; Veeva Vault; GxP; ISO 13485 Section 4.2.3

attributes.name: qc_method
attributes.description: Analytical method used to quantify and assess library quality (e.g., qPCR for accurate molar quantification, Qubit fluorometry for mass concentration, Bioanalyzer/TapeStation for fragment size distribution). Affects the reliability of concentration measurements and QC pass/fail decisions.

attributes.name: run_code
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally-known business identifier for the library preparation run, typically generated by the LIMS (e.g., LP-NGSA-240315). Used for cross-system traceability, SOP deviation tracking, and GxP audit references. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.

attributes.name: run_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operator observations, troubleshooting notes, or contextual comments recorded during or after the library preparation run. Supplements structured deviation documentation and supports root cause analysis.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS; Benchling; GxP; ISO 13485 Section 4.2.4

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the library preparation run. Drives workflow routing, QC gating, and downstream sequencing scheduling. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER LIFECYCLE_STATUS category. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|in_progress|completed|failed|cancelled|on_hold — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sample_count
attributes.description: Total number of biological samples processed in this library preparation run batch. Used for capacity planning, throughput reporting, and cost-per-sample calculations. Represents the principal quantitative result of this transaction.

attributes.name: size_selection_method
attributes.description: Method used to select the target insert size range from the library pool (e.g., SPRI bead-based cleanup, gel excision, Pippin Prep automated electrophoresis). Size selection removes adapter dimers and off-target fragments, improving sequencing efficiency.

attributes.name: sop_deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any deviation from the approved standard operating procedure (SOP) was recorded during this library preparation run. A True value triggers mandatory deviation documentation and review per GxP requirements.
attributes.references: MasterControl; Veeva Vault; GxP; ISO 13485 Section 8.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 820

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the library preparation run was physically initiated in the laboratory. Represents the principal real-world business event time. Used for turnaround time (TAT) calculation and GxP audit trails. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS; GxP; CLIA; ISO 13485 Section 7.5

attributes.name: target_insert_size_bp
attributes.description: Intended DNA insert size in base pairs (bp) for the prepared library, as specified by the protocol. Insert size directly impacts sequencing read overlap, coverage uniformity, and variant calling accuracy. Typical ranges: 150–400 bp for short-read NGS.
attributes.references: Benchling; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; ISO 13485 Section 7.5

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this library preparation run record. Enables change detection, incremental data loading, and GxP audit trail compliance. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS; GxP; ISO 13485 Section 4.2.5; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: use_type
attributes.description: Regulatory use classification of the library preparation run. Research Use Only (RUO) runs are not subject to IVD regulatory controls; In Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) and Laboratory Developed Test (LDT) runs require CLIA/CAP compliance and stricter QC documentation. Drives applicable regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: FDA IVD Regulations; CLIA; CAP; IVDR 2017/746; ISO 13485

attributes.name: workgroup_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the laboratory workgroup or team responsible for executing this library preparation run. Supports capacity planning, workload balancing, and team-level performance reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud HCM; LabVantage LIMS; ISO 13485 Section 6.2

products.name: pool
products.description: Master record for a multiplexed pool of indexed libraries combined for co-sequencing on a single flow cell lane or entire flow cell. Captures pool identity, pooling strategy (equimolar, custom ratio, normalized), number of constituent libraries, total volume (µL), final concentration (nM), loading concentration for the target instrument and flow cell type, pooling date, operator, pool QC status (concentration verification via Qubit/qPCR, fragment size distribution via Bioanalyzer/TapeStation), expected per-library read depth targets, and pool expiry/stability window. Central to multiplexing operations — the pool is what physically gets loaded onto the sequencer and determines per-sample yield allocation.

attributes.name: pool_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the multiplexed library pool record. Primary key for the pool entity in the sequencing domain.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Pooling services for customer samples in multiplexed sequencing. Tracks service delivery, billing, and customer-specific pooling strategies. Essential for multi-customer pool segregation and data acce

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sequencing instrument (e.g., Illumina NovaSeq, NextSeq) onto which this pool is intended to be loaded.

attributes.name: batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.batch. Business justification: Pool preparation uses specific reagent batches (dilution buffers, loading reagents) that must be traceable for QC failure root-cause analysis and supplier recall management. pool.lot_number is a denor

attributes.name: flow_cell_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific flow cell onto which this pool will be or has been loaded for sequencing.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Flow Cell Record

attributes.name: index_set_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sequencing.index_set. Business justification: Pools use specific index sets for multiplexing libraries. pool currently has index_type (string) but no FK to the index_set reference master. Adding index_set_id formalizes the relationship to the con

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reagent.lot. Business justification: Pooling operations use specific reagent lots (loading buffers, normalization reagents); lot traceability is required for QC investigations and recall management. The plain lot_number attribute is a de

attributes.name: nonconformance_id
