attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.oos_investigation. Business justification: Pools with OOS QC results (concentration deviation, fragment size out of range, index imbalance) trigger OOS investigations. Labs track which pool triggered each investigation for root cause analysis

attributes.name: parent_pool_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original pool from which this re-pool was derived, when is_repool is True. Enables lineage tracking and root cause analysis for failed pools.

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the research or clinical project under which this pool was created. Links the pool to project-level objectives, funding, and reporting requirements.
attributes.references: Benchling R&D Notebook — Project Entity; LabVantage LIMS

attributes.name: qc_result_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.qc_result. Business justification: Pools undergo QC testing (concentration, fragment size, index balance, PhiX spike-in verification) before sequencing. QC results determine pool disposition, loading concentration adjustments, and repr

attributes.name: reagent_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reagent.catalog. Business justification: Pooling reagent specification lookups (storage temperature, hazard classification, GMP compliance) require linking pool to reagent.catalog. The existing reagent_catalog_item_id targets product.catalog

attributes.name: reagent_catalog_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.catalog_item. Business justification: Pooling operations use reagents/normalization kits that are catalog items. Needed for cost accounting, protocol compliance, and tracking which commercial products were used for library normalization a

attributes.name: specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.specification. Business justification: Pool QC (loading concentration, fragment size, library count) is evaluated against product specifications. For sequencing run planning and QC investigations, the specification version governing pool a

attributes.name: technical_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.technical_requirement. Business justification: Pool configuration (loading concentration, multiplex count, target read depth, read length) is directly driven by customer technical requirements. This link enables traceability from pooling decisions

attributes.name: basespace_pool_code
attributes.description: External identifier assigned to this pool within Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub. Used for cross-system traceability between the internal LIMS and the BaseSpace sequencing data management platform.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Pool Object

attributes.name: concentration_method
attributes.description: Analytical method used to measure the pool concentration. Qubit and qPCR are preferred for accurate molar quantification; Bioanalyzer and TapeStation provide both concentration and fragment size data.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the pool record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory traceability.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; GxP Audit Trail Requirements; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which the pool is considered expired and should not be loaded onto the sequencer. Determined by the stability window of the pooled libraries under specified storage conditions.
attributes.references: Illumina Library Storage and Stability Guidelines; LabVantage LIMS; GxP

attributes.name: final_concentration_nm
attributes.description: Measured molar concentration of the pool in nanomolar (nM) after pooling, as determined by Qubit fluorometry or qPCR quantification. Used to calculate dilution for loading concentration.
attributes.references: Illumina Sequencing Library QC Guidelines; LabVantage LIMS

attributes.name: flow_cell_lane
attributes.description: Specific lane(s) on the flow cell to which this pool is assigned for loading. A pool may occupy a single lane or the entire flow cell depending on the instrument type and run design.
attributes.references: Illumina Flow Cell Loading Guidelines; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: fragment_size_lower_bp
attributes.description: Lower bound of the acceptable fragment size distribution range in base pairs (bp) for this pool, as defined by the QC specification. Fragments below this threshold indicate adapter contamination or over-fragmentation.
attributes.references: Illumina Library QC Specifications; LabVantage LIMS QC Thresholds

attributes.name: fragment_size_method
attributes.description: Instrument or method used to assess the fragment size distribution of the pool (e.g., Agilent Bioanalyzer, Agilent TapeStation, Advanced Analytical Fragment Analyzer, or gel electrophoresis).
attributes.references: Agilent Technologies QC Standards; Illumina Library QC Guidelines

attributes.name: fragment_size_upper_bp
attributes.description: Upper bound of the acceptable fragment size distribution range in base pairs (bp) for this pool. Fragments above this threshold may indicate incomplete fragmentation or genomic DNA contamination.
attributes.references: Illumina Library QC Specifications; LabVantage LIMS QC Thresholds

attributes.name: index_collision_risk
attributes.description: Assessed risk level of index sequence collision (cross-contamination between demultiplexed samples) within this pool, based on Hamming distance analysis of the index set. Low risk indicates sufficient edit distance between all index pairs.
attributes.references: Illumina Index Diversity Guidelines; Demultiplexing QC Standards

attributes.name: is_repool
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pool is a re-pool created to replace or supplement a previously failed or underperforming pool (True = re-pool, False = original pool). Used for tracking remediation events.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Pool Remediation Tracking; ISO 15189

attributes.name: library_count
attributes.description: Total number of individually indexed libraries combined into this pool. Determines the degree of multiplexing and directly impacts per-library read depth allocation.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Pool Composition; NGS Multiplexing Standards

attributes.name: lims_pool_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Pool ID
attributes.description: Native pool identifier from LabVantage LIMS, used for cross-system reconciliation between the enterprise data lakehouse and the operational LIMS source system.

attributes.name: loading_concentration_pm
attributes.description: Target loading concentration of the diluted pool in picomolar (pM) for the specific instrument and flow cell type. Directly impacts cluster density and sequencing quality.
attributes.references: Illumina Instrument-Specific Loading Guidelines; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: mean_fragment_size_bp
attributes.description: Mean insert fragment size of the pool in base pairs (bp) as measured by Bioanalyzer or TapeStation electrophoresis. Critical for assessing library quality and estimating molar concentration.
attributes.references: Agilent Bioanalyzer/TapeStation QC Standards; Illumina Library QC Guidelines

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for laboratory scientists to record observations, deviations, or special handling instructions associated with this pool that are not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Notes Field; ISO 15189; GxP

attributes.name: phix_spike_in_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of PhiX Control library spiked into the pool prior to sequencing. PhiX is used as an internal sequencing quality control to monitor cluster density, error rate, and base calling performance.
attributes.references: Illumina PhiX Control Guidelines; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: pool_code
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally-known unique alphanumeric code assigned to the pool for tracking across LIMS, BaseSpace, and laboratory worksheets. Used as the business identifier on COAs and run manifests.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Pool Barcode; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: pool_name
attributes.description: Descriptive human-readable name assigned to the pool, typically encoding project, date, and cohort information for easy identification in run planning and reporting.

attributes.name: pool_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the pool. Tracks progression from initial creation through QC verification, loading onto the sequencer, sequencing completion, or expiry. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|qc_in_progress|qc_passed|qc_failed|loaded|sequenced|expired — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: pooling_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the individual libraries were combined to form this pool. Used for traceability, stability window calculation, and laboratory scheduling.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Pool Creation Date; ISO 15189; GxP

attributes.name: pooling_strategy
attributes.description: Method used to combine individual indexed libraries into the pool. Equimolar pools combine equal molar quantities; custom ratio pools use user-defined proportions; normalized pools use concentration normalization prior to combining; volume-based pools combine equal volumes.
attributes.references: Illumina Library Pooling Guidelines; Benchling R&D Protocol

attributes.name: protocol_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) or laboratory protocol used to perform the pooling procedure. Ensures reproducibility and regulatory traceability.
attributes.references: MasterControl — Document Control; ISO 13485; GxP SOP Management

attributes.name: qc_concentration_passed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pool passed the concentration QC threshold check (True = passed, False = failed). A pool must pass concentration QC before it is eligible for loading onto the sequencer.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS QC Module; ISO 15189; GxP QC Standards

attributes.name: qc_date
attributes.description: Date on which QC measurements (concentration and fragment size) were performed on the pool. May differ from pooling date if QC is conducted on a subsequent day.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS QC Module; ISO 15189; GxP

attributes.name: qc_failure_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded description of the reason(s) for QC failure when qc_overall_passed is False. Used for root cause analysis, CAPA initiation, and laboratory troubleshooting.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS QC Module; ISO 13485 CAPA; GxP

attributes.name: qc_fragment_size_passed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Quality Control (QC) Fragment Size Pass Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pool passed the fragment size distribution QC check (True = passed, False = failed). Ensures the pool's insert size profile is within acceptable bounds for the target sequencing application.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS QC Module; ISO 15189; GxP QC Standards

attributes.name: qc_overall_passed
attributes.description: Composite QC pass/fail flag indicating whether the pool has passed all required QC checks (concentration and fragment size) and is approved for sequencer loading. True = all QC checks passed.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS QC Module; ISO 15189; GxP QC Standards

attributes.name: run_type
attributes.description: Intended use classification of the sequencing run for which this pool is prepared. RUO (Research Use Only) pools are not subject to clinical regulatory requirements; IVD and LDT pools require CLIA/CAP compliance.
attributes.references: FDA IVD Regulations; CLIA; CAP; ISO 13485

attributes.name: sequencing_application
attributes.description: Genomic sequencing application type for which this pool was prepared. Determines bioinformatics pipeline routing, QC thresholds, and coverage requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: wgs|wes|targeted_panel|amplicon|rna_seq|chip_seq|atac_seq|methyl_seq — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Illumina Application Notes; NGS Workflow Standards

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Physical storage location identifier (freezer, rack, box, position) where the pool is stored in the laboratory. Used for sample retrieval and inventory management within LIMS.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Sample Storage Module; ISO 15189

attributes.name: storage_temperature_c
attributes.description: Required storage temperature in degrees Celsius for maintaining pool stability and integrity. Typically -20°C for long-term storage or 4°C for short-term use.
attributes.references: Illumina Library Storage Guidelines; LabVantage LIMS; GxP

attributes.name: target_read_depth
attributes.description: Expected average sequencing read depth (coverage depth) per library within the pool, expressed as number of reads. Used for run planning, yield allocation, and per-sample coverage estimation.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run Planning; NGS Coverage Depth Standards

attributes.name: target_read_length
attributes.description: Intended sequencing read length in base pairs (bp) for this pool (e.g., 150 bp paired-end). Determines the sequencing run configuration and impacts data output volume.
attributes.references: Illumina Sequencing Run Configuration Standards; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: total_volume_ul
attributes.description: Total volume of the combined pool in microlitres (µL) after all libraries have been pooled. Used to assess whether sufficient material exists for loading and archival.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Pool Volume Field; Illumina Library Preparation Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the pool record. Used for change tracking, audit trail compliance, and data synchronization between source systems and the lakehouse.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; GxP Audit Trail Requirements; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

products.name: pool_library
products.description: Association entity linking libraries to pools, capturing the multiplexing relationship with its own business data. Records the library-to-pool assignment, index sequence (i7/i5), expected molar fraction (%), actual volume contributed (µL), loading ratio, and any index collision flags. Essential for demultiplexing traceability — enables reconstruction of which library contributed which reads in a pooled run.

attributes.name: pool_library_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the pool-library association record. Primary key for this junction entity linking a sequencing library to a pool.

attributes.name: index_set_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sequencing.index_set. Business justification: pool_library tracks individual library assignments within pools with their specific index sequences. Currently has index_kit_name (string) and index sequences but no FK to index_set. Adding index_set_

attributes.name: library_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sequencing library that has been assigned to this pool. Enables reconstruction of which library contributed reads in a pooled run.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Library Preparation Entity; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: pool_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sequencing pool to which this library has been assigned. Supports demultiplexing traceability back to the originating pool.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Pool Entity

attributes.name: actual_molar_fraction_pct
attributes.description: The measured proportion (%) of this library's molar contribution in the final pool, determined by qPCR or fluorometric quantification. Deviations from expected fraction indicate pipetting or quantification errors.
attributes.references: Illumina Library Quantification Technical Guide; qPCR Quantification SOP

attributes.name: assigned_read_count
attributes.description: Total number of sequencing reads successfully demultiplexed and assigned to this library from the pool run. Populated post-sequencing from demultiplexing output (e.g., bcl2fastq/BCL Convert reports). Used to assess yield per library.
attributes.references: Illumina bcl2fastq/BCL Convert Demultiplexing Report; FASTQ Output Standard

attributes.name: assigned_read_fraction_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of total pool reads assigned to this library after demultiplexing. Compared against expected molar fraction to assess pooling balance and identify over- or under-represented libraries.
attributes.references: Illumina Demultiplexing QC Metrics; NGS Run QC SOP

attributes.name: assigned_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone) when this library was assigned to the pool in the LIMS or BaseSpace Sequence Hub. Serves as the primary business event timestamp for this junction record.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Audit Trail; ISO 13485 Section 4.2; GxP 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the library-to-pool assignment. Tracks whether the library is pending confirmation, actively loaded, failed QC, or removed from the pool.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Sample Workflow Status; ISO 13485 Section 8.3

attributes.name: basespace_dataset_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the FASTQ dataset generated for this library in Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub following demultiplexing. Links the pool-library assignment to the resulting sequencing data artifact for downstream bioinformatics pipeline ingestion.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub API — Dataset Resource; FASTQ Output Standard

attributes.name: cluster_density
attributes.description: Cluster density (in thousands per mm²) on the flow cell lane attributable to this library's loading contribution. Excessively high or low cluster density impacts sequencing quality and read assignment accuracy.
attributes.references: Illumina Flow Cell Metrics; Sequencing Run QC SOP

attributes.name: demultiplex_mismatch_allowed
attributes.description: Number of base mismatches permitted during demultiplexing for this library's index sequence. Typically 0 or 1. Higher values increase sensitivity but risk misassignment between similar indexes.
attributes.references: Illumina bcl2fastq/BCL Convert User Guide; FASTQ Demultiplexing SOP

attributes.name: expected_molar_fraction_pct
attributes.description: The theoretical proportion (%) of this library's molar contribution relative to the total pool. Used to balance sequencing depth across libraries in a multiplexed run. Sum across all libraries in a pool should equal 100%.
attributes.references: Illumina Library Normalization and Pooling Guide; NGS Multiplexing Best Practices

attributes.name: i5_index_sequence
attributes.description: The i5 (read 2 side) barcode index nucleotide sequence assigned to this library for dual-index multiplexing. Required for dual-indexed library pools to prevent index hopping. Typically 6–10 bases.
attributes.references: Illumina Adapter Sequences Document (1000000002694); FASTQ Demultiplexing Standard

attributes.name: i7_index_sequence
attributes.description: The i7 (read 1 side) barcode index nucleotide sequence assigned to this library for multiplexing identification. Used during demultiplexing to assign reads back to the originating library. Typically 6–10 bases.
attributes.references: Illumina Adapter Sequences Document (1000000002694); FASTQ Demultiplexing Standard

attributes.name: index_collision_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this library's index sequence conflicts (collides) with another library's index in the same pool, which would impair demultiplexing accuracy. True = collision detected; False = no collision. Populated by index compatibility checking tools.
attributes.references: Illumina Index Collision Detection; FASTQ Demultiplexing Best Practices

attributes.name: index_distance
attributes.description: Minimum Hamming distance between this library's index sequence and all other index sequences in the same pool. A distance of ≥2 is typically required for reliable demultiplexing with 1 mismatch tolerance. Low values indicate collision risk.
attributes.references: Illumina Index Adapter Sequences; Hamming Distance Demultiplexing Standard

attributes.name: index_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or catalog designation of the index pair (e.g., 'IDT-10nt-UDI-0001', 'TruSeq-D701-D501'). Corresponds to the index kit nomenclature used during library preparation.
attributes.references: Illumina Index Adapter Kits; IDT xGen Dual Index UMI Adapters

attributes.name: insert_size_bp
attributes.description: Mean insert size in base pairs (bp) of this library as measured prior to pooling. Insert size affects read overlap, coverage uniformity, and compatibility with the sequencing run parameters.
attributes.references: Illumina Library QC Metrics; Agilent Bioanalyzer/TapeStation Electropherogram Standard

attributes.name: lane_assignment
attributes.description: The specific flow cell lane(s) to which this library-pool combination is assigned for sequencing (e.g., '1', '1,2', 'all'). Relevant for patterned flow cells with lane-level loading (e.g., Illumina NovaSeq S4 flow cell).
attributes.references: Illumina Flow Cell Lane Assignment Guide; BaseSpace Sequence Hub Run Setup

attributes.name: lims_pool_library_ref
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Pool Library Reference
attributes.description: External reference identifier for this pool-library association record as recorded in LabVantage LIMS. Enables cross-system traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational LIMS source of record.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Pool Library Entity; ISO 13485 Section 4.2

attributes.name: loading_ratio
attributes.description: The ratio of this library's contribution relative to the total pool volume or molar amount at the time of flow cell loading. Used to normalize read depth expectations and assess pooling balance post-sequencing.
attributes.references: Illumina Sequencing System Denature and Dilute Libraries Guide; NGS Pooling SOP

attributes.name: mean_quality_score
attributes.description: Average Phred quality score across all bases in reads assigned to this library. Provides a summary measure of base call accuracy for this library's contribution to the pool run.
attributes.references: Illumina Sequencing Quality Metrics; Phred Score Standard (Ewing & Green 1998)

attributes.name: normalization_tool
attributes.description: Name of the instrument or software tool used to quantify and normalize this library prior to pooling (e.g., 'Qubit 4 Fluorometer', 'Agilent Bioanalyzer 2100', 'Agilent TapeStation 4200', 'KAPA Library Quantification qPCR'). Supports reagent and instrument traceability.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Instrument Tracking; ISO 15189 Section 5.3

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for laboratory operator observations, deviations, or contextual remarks specific to this library's pooling event. Supports GxP batch record documentation and investigation workflows.
attributes.references: GxP Batch Record Requirements; ISO 13485 Section 4.2; LabVantage LIMS — Notes Field

attributes.name: phred_q30_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of bases in reads assigned to this library that meet or exceed Phred quality score Q30 (≥99.9% base call accuracy). Key NGS quality metric; typically ≥80% Q30 is required for clinical-grade sequencing.
attributes.references: Illumina Sequencing Quality Metrics; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CAP NGS Checklist

attributes.name: pooling_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this library was physically added to the pool. Used for traceability, lot expiry checks, and TAT (Turnaround Time) calculations.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Pooling Workflow; ISO 15189 Section 5.4; GxP Batch Record Requirements

attributes.name: pooling_method
attributes.description: Method used to determine the volume of this library added to the pool. Options include equimolar normalization, volume-based, mass-based, qPCR-normalized, or fluorometric quantification-based pooling.
attributes.references: Illumina Library Normalization and Pooling Guide; NGS Pooling SOP

attributes.name: regulatory_use_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory classification of this library's intended use context within the pool. RUO (Research Use Only), IVD (In Vitro Diagnostic), LDT (Laboratory Developed Test), or GxP-governed (GMP/GCP/GLP). Determines applicable compliance requirements for data handling and reporting.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820; IVDR EU 2017/746; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; ISO 13485

attributes.name: removal_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why this library was removed from the pool. Populated only when assignment_status is 'removed' or 'failed'. Supports root cause analysis and CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) workflows.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 8.5 — CAPA; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; GxP Deviation Management SOP

attributes.name: removed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this library was removed or disqualified from the pool, if applicable. Null if the library remains active in the pool. Supports lifecycle tracking and investigation of failed runs.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Audit Trail; ISO 13485 Section 8.3

attributes.name: sample_sheet_position
attributes.description: Row position of this library entry in the Illumina sample sheet (SampleSheet.csv) used to configure the sequencing run and demultiplexing. Ensures correct index-to-sample mapping during BCL conversion.
attributes.references: Illumina SampleSheet.csv Format Specification; bcl2fastq/BCL Convert User Guide

attributes.name: sequencing_application
attributes.description: The NGS application type for which this library was prepared and pooled. Determines expected coverage depth, read length, and bioinformatics pipeline routing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WGS|WES|targeted_panel|amplicon|RNA_seq|ChIP_seq|ATAC_seq|methylation_seq|single_cell — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Illumina Application Notes; NGS Assay Classification SOP

attributes.name: spike_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this library entry represents a spike-in control (e.g., PhiX, synthetic spike-in) rather than a biological sample library. True = spike-in control; False = biological sample. Spike-ins are used for sequencing quality calibration and are excluded from biological analysis.
attributes.references: Illumina PhiX Control v3 Library Guide; NGS Run QC SOP

attributes.name: target_coverage_depth
attributes.description: The intended sequencing coverage depth (×) for this library in the pool (e.g., 30× for WGS, 100× for WES, 500× for targeted panels). Used to calculate required read count and validate pooling balance.
attributes.references: ACMG/AMP Variant Interpretation Guidelines; CAP NGS Checklist; Clinical Sequencing SOP

attributes.name: undetermined_read_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this library contributed a disproportionate number of reads to the undetermined (unassigned) category during demultiplexing, suggesting index sequence issues or contamination. True = flagged; False = within acceptable threshold.
attributes.references: Illumina bcl2fastq QC Metrics; NGS Demultiplexing Failure Investigation SOP

attributes.name: volume_added_ul
attributes.description: Actual volume in microliters (µL) of this library pipetted into the pool. Critical for molar balance calculations and audit of physical pooling operations.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Pooling Workflow; ISO 15189 Section 5.4

products.name: run_lane
products.description: Operational record representing a single lane within a sequencing run on a multi-lane flow cell. Captures lane number, assigned pool or library, loading concentration, cluster density (K/mm²), clusters passing filter (%), PhiX spike-in percentage, lane-level QC status, and lane yield (Gb). Enables per-lane performance monitoring and troubleshooting of lane-specific failures on instruments such as NovaSeq 6000 with S-series flow cells.

attributes.name: run_lane_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a single lane record within a sequencing run on a multi-lane flow cell. Primary key for the run_lane entity. Entity role: TRANSACTION_LINE — represents one lane/line of a sequencing run (TRANSACTION_HEADER), carrying its own QC metrics, yield, and operational state.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; LabVantage LIMS

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sequencing instrument (e.g., NovaSeq 6000, NextSeq 2000) on which this lane was sequenced. Supports instrument utilization tracking, maintenance scheduling, and cross-instrument performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: deviation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.deviation. Business justification: Run lane failures (lane_qc_status, lane_failure_reason on run_lane) require deviation records in GxP sequencing labs. run_lane has no existing quality FKs. A GxP genomics QA expert expects direct trac

attributes.name: flow_cell_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical flow cell consumable loaded on the instrument for this run. Links lane-level performance data to the specific flow cell lot and type (e.g., NovaSeq 6000 S4 flow cell). Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE category: RESOURCE_REFERENCE.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: library_pool_id
attributes.description: Reference to the multiplexed library pool or individual library loaded onto this lane. Enables traceability from lane-level sequencing output back to the sample preparation and library construction records in the LIMS.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: sequencing_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent sequencing run (TRANSACTION_HEADER) that this lane belongs to. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE category: HEADER_REFERENCE — the lane is a line-level record within the run.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; LabVantage LIMS

attributes.name: specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.specification. Business justification: Run lane QC (lane_qc_status) is evaluated against product specifications for target cluster density and yield. Columns target_cluster_density_k_per_mm2 and target_yield_gb are denormalized from produc

attributes.name: basecalling_software
attributes.description: Name and version of the base calling software used to convert raw intensity signals to nucleotide sequences (FASTQ) for this lane (e.g., Illumina RTA 3.4.4, DRAGEN). Critical for data provenance, reproducibility, and regulatory traceability of genomic data.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; GxP; ISO 15189; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: basecalling_software_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the base calling software used for this lane. Required for GxP audit trails and bioinformatics reproducibility; version changes may affect base quality scores and downstream variant calling results.
attributes.references: GxP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 15189; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: basespace_lane_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this lane as recorded in Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub, the primary system of record for sequencing data management. Enables direct linkage between the enterprise data lakehouse and the BaseSpace platform for data retrieval and audit.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; GxP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: cluster_density_k_per_mm2
attributes.description: Number of clusters generated per square millimeter on this lane, expressed in thousands (K/mm²). A key sequencing performance metric; values outside the instrument-specific acceptable range indicate over- or under-clustering, leading to reduced data quality or yield.
attributes.references: Illumina NovaSeq 6000 System Guide; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: clusters_passing_filter_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of clusters on this lane that pass the Illumina chastity filter, indicating the proportion of high-quality reads retained for downstream analysis. Industry benchmark is typically ≥75–80%. Low values indicate poor library quality, phasing issues, or flow cell defects.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; ISO 15189; CAP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this run lane record was first created in the system, typically upon run initiation or lane assignment. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE category: RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED. Required for data lineage, GxP audit trail, and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: GxP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 15189; ISO 27001

attributes.name: demultiplexing_status
attributes.description: Current status of the demultiplexing process for this lane, which separates pooled sample reads by index barcode to generate per-sample FASTQ files. Tracks whether the bioinformatics demultiplexing step has been initiated, completed, or encountered errors.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; LabVantage LIMS

attributes.name: error_rate_pct
attributes.description: Sequencing error rate for this lane, expressed as a percentage, calculated from PhiX alignment. Reflects the per-base mismatch rate against the PhiX reference and is a key indicator of instrument and reagent performance. Typical acceptable threshold is <1%.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; ISO 15189; CAP

attributes.name: fastq_output_path
attributes.description: File system or cloud storage path (e.g., AWS S3 URI or BaseSpace project path) where the demultiplexed FASTQ files for this lane are stored. Enables downstream bioinformatics pipelines to locate and consume the raw sequencing data output.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; AWS; ISO 27001

attributes.name: index_read_length_i1
attributes.description: Length of Index Read 1 (i7 index) in base pairs used for demultiplexing samples on this lane. Defines the barcode length for sample identification in multiplexed sequencing runs.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; Illumina Multiplexing Guidelines

attributes.name: index_read_length_i2
attributes.description: Length of Index Read 2 (i5 index) in base pairs used for dual-index demultiplexing on this lane. Null for single-index runs. Dual indexing reduces index hopping and improves sample assignment accuracy in high-multiplex runs.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; Illumina Multiplexing Guidelines

attributes.name: lane_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when sequencing completed on this lane. Together with lane_start_timestamp, enables calculation of lane-level sequencing duration and instrument cycle time for operational efficiency reporting.

attributes.name: lane_failure_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded description of the root cause when a lane fails QC (lane_qc_status = 'fail'). Captures failure categories such as low cluster density, high error rate, low Q30, PhiX misalignment, or reagent lot issues. Used for root cause analysis, CAPA, and instrument troubleshooting.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CAP; CLIA; GxP; Veeva Vault QMS

attributes.name: lane_number
attributes.description: Physical lane position number on the flow cell (e.g., 1–8 for NovaSeq 6000 S4 flow cell). Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE category: LINE_SEQUENCE — the ordinal position of this lane within the flow cell/run.
attributes.references: Illumina NovaSeq 6000 System Guide; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: lane_qc_status
attributes.description: Overall Quality Control (QC) disposition for this lane based on cluster density, clusters passing filter, PhiX alignment, and yield thresholds. Drives downstream bioinformatics pipeline gating and sample release decisions. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE category: LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pass|fail|warning|pending|under_review|cancelled — promote to reference product if additional statuses are required]
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CLIA; CAP; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: lane_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when sequencing commenced on this lane. Used for Turnaround Time (TAT) calculation, instrument utilization reporting, and scheduling of downstream bioinformatics processing. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE category: BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; ISO 15189; CLIA

attributes.name: lane_yield_gb
attributes.description: Total sequencing output (data yield) generated from this lane, expressed in gigabases (Gb). Primary throughput metric for lane-level performance assessment and SLA compliance. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE category: LINE_QUANTITY.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; ISO 15189; CAP

attributes.name: lims_lane_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Lane Reference
attributes.description: External identifier for this lane record as assigned by the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS), such as LabVantage. Enables cross-system traceability between the Databricks Silver Layer analytical record and the operational LIMS source of record.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS; GxP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: loading_concentration_pm
attributes.description: Concentration of the library or pool loaded onto this lane, expressed in picomolar (pM). Critical operational parameter that directly influences cluster density and sequencing quality. Deviations from the target loading concentration are a primary root cause of lane failures.
attributes.references: Illumina Library Preparation and Sequencing SOPs; ISO 15189

attributes.name: mean_phred_q30_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of bases on this lane with a Phred quality score ≥30 (Q30), indicating a base call accuracy of 99.9% or higher. Industry-standard quality threshold for NGS data; Illumina specifies Q30 ≥75–80% as a minimum acceptance criterion for most applications.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; ISO 15189; CAP; CLIA

attributes.name: mean_phred_score
attributes.description: Average Phred base quality score across all bases sequenced on this lane. Provides a single summary quality metric complementing the Q30 percentage for lane-level quality trending and instrument performance monitoring.

attributes.name: num_samples_multiplexed
attributes.description: Count of individual samples multiplexed (pooled) and loaded onto this lane. Determines the expected per-sample read depth after demultiplexing and is a key parameter for capacity planning and SLA compliance per sample.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; LabVantage LIMS

attributes.name: phix_alignment_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of reads on this lane that aligned to the PhiX reference genome. Used to validate the PhiX spike-in and assess lane-level sequencing error rate. Significant deviation from the expected PhiX spike-in percentage indicates a lane-level quality issue.

attributes.name: phix_spike_in_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of PhiX Control v3 library spiked into this lane for sequencing quality monitoring and calibration. PhiX is an Illumina-standard internal control used to assess error rate, base quality, and instrument performance per lane.
attributes.references: Illumina PhiX Control v3 Guide; ISO 15189; CAP

attributes.name: qc_review_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the QC review of this lane was completed and the QC disposition (pass/fail/warning) was recorded. Required for GxP audit trail and regulatory submission traceability.
attributes.references: GxP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 15189; CAP; CLIA

attributes.name: qc_reviewed_by
attributes.description: Reference to the Quality Control (QC) scientist or analyst who reviewed and approved or rejected the lane QC results. Required for GxP electronic signature compliance and audit trail integrity under FDA 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: GxP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 15189; CAP; MasterControl

attributes.name: read_length_r1
attributes.description: Length of Read 1 in base pairs (bp) for this lane, as configured in the sequencing run setup. Determines the sequencing mode (e.g., 150 bp paired-end) and directly impacts the genomic applications supported (WGS, WES, targeted panels).
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; Illumina Run Setup Documentation

attributes.name: read_length_r2
attributes.description: Length of Read 2 in base pairs (bp) for paired-end sequencing on this lane. Null for single-read runs. Together with read_length_r1, defines the paired-end read configuration (e.g., 2×150 bp) used for library insert size estimation and alignment accuracy.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; Illumina Run Setup Documentation

attributes.name: reads_passing_filter
attributes.description: Number of reads on this lane that passed the Illumina chastity filter and are available for downstream bioinformatics processing. Directly determines the effective sequencing depth available for variant calling and genomic analysis.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; ISO 15189; CAP

attributes.name: requeue_count
attributes.description: Number of times this lane has been requeued for resequencing due to QC failure or insufficient yield. Tracks repeat failure patterns for root cause analysis and supports escalation decisions when a lane repeatedly fails.

attributes.name: requeue_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lane requires resequencing (requeue) due to QC failure or insufficient yield. Triggers downstream sample management and scheduling workflows in the LIMS to prioritize reruns and maintain customer SLA commitments.

attributes.name: run_mode
attributes.description: Sequencing run mode for this lane: paired-end (reads generated from both ends of the DNA fragment) or single-read (reads generated from one end only). Determines FASTQ file structure and alignment strategy for downstream bioinformatics processing.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; Illumina Run Setup Documentation

attributes.name: sequencing_application
attributes.description: Genomic sequencing application type assigned to this lane (e.g., Whole Genome Sequencing (WGS), Whole Exome Sequencing (WES), targeted panel, RNA-seq). Determines QC thresholds, coverage requirements, and downstream bioinformatics pipeline routing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WGS|WES|targeted_panel|amplicon|RNA_seq|methylation|other — promote to reference product if additional application types are required]
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; ISO 15189; CAP; CLIA

attributes.name: total_reads
attributes.description: Total number of sequencing reads generated from this lane before quality filtering. Provides a raw throughput count used alongside yield (Gb) for per-lane performance benchmarking and capacity planning.

attributes.name: undetermined_reads_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of reads on this lane that could not be assigned to a sample index during demultiplexing. High undetermined read rates indicate index contamination, index hopping, or sample sheet errors. Typically acceptable threshold is <5–10%.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this run lane record was last modified, such as when QC metrics were populated post-run or when the QC status was updated. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE category: RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED. Required for data lineage and GxP audit trail.
attributes.references: GxP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 15189; ISO 27001

products.name: run_qc_metric
products.description: Transactional record storing quantitative quality metrics for sequencing runs at multiple granularity levels: run-level, lane-level, and per-library. Instrument-level metrics include Q30%, mean Phred score, error rate, cluster density, clusters passing filter, yield (Gb), PhiX alignment and error rate, and undetermined index rate. Per-library coverage metrics include mean/median coverage depth (X), coverage uniformity (%), fraction of bases at ≥10X/≥20X/≥30X/≥100X thresholds, on-target rate (% for WES/targeted), duplication rate (%), insert size statistics, and GC bias. Each metric row is attributed to a run, optionally a lane, and optionally a library — enabling both run-level pass/fail determination and per-library coverage adequacy assessment. Sourced from Illumina InterOp files, BaseSpace, bcl2fastq stats, and alignment tools (Picard, samtools). Supports instrument performance trending, assay-specific coverage thresholds, and GxP compliance reporting.

attributes.name: run_qc_metric_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each run QC metric record. Serves as the primary key for this transactional entity capturing quantitative quality measurements at run, lane, or library granularity. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — stores discrete QC measurement events with a clear lifecycle and multiple metric dimensions sourced from Illumina InterOp, BaseSpace, bcl2fastq, Picard, and samtools.

attributes.name: library_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.test_catalog. Business justification: QC metrics are evaluated against test-catalog-specific acceptance criteria (minimum Q30, minimum coverage depth, error rate thresholds). Linking run_qc_metric to test_catalog enables per-assay QC tren

attributes.name: alignment_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of reads that successfully aligned to the reference genome. Low alignment rates may indicate sample contamination, wrong species, or library preparation failures. Sourced from samtools flagstat or DRAGEN alignment metrics.

attributes.name: assay_type
attributes.description: Classification of the sequencing assay type performed: Whole Genome Sequencing (WGS), Whole Exome Sequencing (WES), targeted panel, amplicon, RNA-seq, or other. Determines applicable coverage thresholds and QC pass/fail criteria for the run or library.
attributes.references: CLIA; CAP; ISO 15189; FDA IVD guidance

attributes.name: cluster_density_k_per_mm2
attributes.description: Number of clusters per square millimeter on the flow cell surface, expressed in thousands (K/mm²). Optimal cluster density is critical for sequencing quality; too high causes overcrowding and quality degradation, too low reduces yield. Sourced from Illumina InterOp.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; ISO 13485; GMP

attributes.name: clusters_passing_filter_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of clusters that pass Illumina's chastity filter, indicating the proportion of high-quality reads retained after filtering. A key run-level QC metric; typically ≥75–85% is expected for acceptable run quality. Sourced from Illumina InterOp.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; ISO 15189; CLIA

attributes.name: coverage_uniformity_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of target bases covered at ≥20% of the mean coverage depth, measuring how evenly reads are distributed across the target region. High uniformity indicates consistent library preparation and sequencing performance. Sourced from Picard or samtools.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this QC metric record was first created in the system, typically upon automated ingestion from the source QC tool (InterOp, BaseSpace, Picard, or samtools). Supports audit trail requirements under GxP and FDA 21 CFR Part 11.

attributes.name: duplication_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of reads identified as PCR or optical duplicates, which are removed prior to variant calling. High duplication rates reduce effective coverage and indicate over-amplification during library preparation. Sourced from Picard MarkDuplicates.

attributes.name: error_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of base calls that do not match the reference sequence, typically measured using PhiX control spike-in. Reflects sequencing chemistry and instrument performance. Lower values indicate higher accuracy. Sourced from Illumina InterOp.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; ISO 15189; CLIA

attributes.name: gc_bias_index
attributes.description: Quantitative measure of GC content bias in sequencing coverage, indicating the degree to which GC-rich or GC-poor regions are over- or under-represented relative to expected coverage. Values near 0 indicate minimal bias. Sourced from Picard CollectGcBiasMetrics.

attributes.name: insert_size_std_dev_bp
attributes.description: Standard deviation of the insert size distribution in base pairs. High standard deviation indicates heterogeneous fragmentation, which can affect alignment accuracy and coverage uniformity. Sourced from Picard CollectInsertSizeMetrics.

attributes.name: mean_coverage_depth
attributes.description: Average number of times each base in the target region (genome, exome, or panel) is covered by sequencing reads, expressed as fold-coverage (X). Primary metric for assessing whether sufficient sequencing depth was achieved for reliable variant calling. Populated for library-level records. Sourced from Picard or samtools.

attributes.name: mean_insert_size_bp
attributes.description: Average size of the DNA fragment inserted between sequencing adapters, in base pairs. Reflects library preparation quality; deviations from expected insert size indicate degradation, over-fragmentation, or adapter contamination. Sourced from Picard CollectInsertSizeMetrics.

attributes.name: mean_phred_score
attributes.description: Average Phred quality score across all bases in the run or lane, representing overall base call accuracy. A Phred score of 30 corresponds to 99.9% accuracy. Used for instrument performance benchmarking and run-level QC trending.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; ISO 15189; CLIA

attributes.name: median_coverage_depth
attributes.description: Median fold-coverage across the target region, less sensitive to outliers than mean coverage. Used alongside mean_coverage_depth to assess coverage uniformity and detect regions of extreme over- or under-representation. Sourced from Picard or samtools.

attributes.name: metric_granularity_level
attributes.description: Indicates the level of aggregation at which this QC metric record applies: 'run' for instrument-wide metrics, 'lane' for per-lane flow cell metrics, or 'library' for per-library/per-sample coverage metrics. Determines which metric fields are populated and how the record is used in QC workflows.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; bcl2fastq; ISO 15189

attributes.name: metric_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the upstream tool or system from which this QC metric record was derived: Illumina InterOp files, BaseSpace, bcl2fastq demultiplexing stats, Picard alignment tools, samtools, DRAGEN, or other. Supports data lineage tracking and metric reproducibility audits. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: InterOp|BaseSpace|bcl2fastq|Picard|samtools|DRAGEN|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; GxP; ISO 27001

attributes.name: on_target_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of aligned reads that map to the intended target region (exome capture or targeted panel). Applicable for WES and targeted sequencing assays. Low on-target rates indicate poor library enrichment or capture efficiency. Sourced from Picard CollectHsMetrics.

attributes.name: pct_bases_at_100x
attributes.description: Fraction of target bases covered at a minimum depth of 100X, expressed as a percentage. Used for high-depth targeted sequencing panels, somatic variant calling, and liquid biopsy applications requiring high sensitivity at low allele frequencies. Sourced from Picard or samtools.

attributes.name: pct_bases_at_10x
attributes.description: Fraction of target bases covered at a minimum depth of 10X, expressed as a percentage. Used as a coverage adequacy threshold for low-depth applications and as a QC gate for variant calling sensitivity. Sourced from Picard CollectHsMetrics or samtools depth.

attributes.name: pct_bases_at_20x
attributes.description: Fraction of target bases covered at a minimum depth of 20X, expressed as a percentage. Standard coverage threshold for WES clinical assays; used to assess whether sufficient depth was achieved for reliable heterozygous variant detection. Sourced from Picard or samtools.

attributes.name: pct_bases_at_30x
attributes.description: Fraction of target bases covered at a minimum depth of 30X, expressed as a percentage. Common coverage threshold for WGS clinical applications; used to confirm adequate depth for high-confidence variant calling across the genome. Sourced from Picard or samtools.

attributes.name: pf_reads
attributes.description: Number of reads passing Illumina's chastity filter (PF reads), representing high-quality reads used in downstream alignment and variant calling. Distinct from total_reads which includes all raw clusters. Sourced from Illumina InterOp or bcl2fastq.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; ISO 15189; CLIA

attributes.name: phix_alignment_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of reads that align to the PhiX bacteriophage control genome, which is spiked into sequencing runs as an internal quality control standard. Used to validate sequencing chemistry performance and calibrate error rate measurements.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; ISO 15189; CLIA

attributes.name: phix_error_rate_percent
attributes.description: Sequencing error rate calculated from PhiX control reads, providing an unbiased measure of instrument and chemistry accuracy independent of sample biology. Sourced from Illumina InterOp. Used for instrument performance trending and GxP compliance.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; ISO 15189; CLIA; GxP

attributes.name: q30_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of bases with a Phred quality score of 30 or higher (Q30), indicating ≥99.9% base call accuracy. Industry-standard instrument performance metric; Illumina typically requires ≥75–80% Q30 for run acceptance. Sourced from Illumina InterOp or BaseSpace.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; ISO 15189; CLIA; CAP

attributes.name: qc_failure_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or structured description of the reason(s) for QC failure or warning status, such as 'Q30 below threshold', 'high duplication rate', or 'low on-target rate'. Populated when qc_status is 'fail' or 'warning'. Supports root-cause analysis and corrective action tracking.

attributes.name: qc_reviewed_by
attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the scientist or QA analyst who performed the manual QC review and sign-off for this metric record. Required for GxP audit trail and electronic signature compliance under FDA 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; GxP; ISO 15189; CLIA

attributes.name: qc_reviewed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the QC review and sign-off was completed for this metric record. Supports GxP audit trail, turnaround time (TAT) tracking, and regulatory submission documentation.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; GxP; ISO 15189; CLIA

attributes.name: qc_status
attributes.description: Overall QC determination for this metric record: 'pass' indicates all applicable thresholds met, 'fail' indicates one or more critical thresholds breached, 'warning' indicates marginal performance requiring review, 'pending_review' indicates awaiting manual QC sign-off, 'invalidated' indicates the run or library was voided. Central to GxP compliance reporting and run release decisions.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CLIA; CAP; GxP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: read_length_bp
attributes.description: Length of sequencing reads in base pairs (bp) for this run or library (e.g., 150 bp for paired-end 150). Determines the resolution of variant calling and structural variant detection. Sourced from run configuration in Illumina BaseSpace.

attributes.name: read_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sequencing run used single-end or paired-end read chemistry. Paired-end reads provide improved alignment accuracy and structural variant detection. Affects coverage calculation and bioinformatics pipeline configuration.

attributes.name: run_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the sequencing run was initiated. Used as the principal business event date for instrument performance trending, throughput reporting, and time-series QC analysis.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; ISO 15189; CLIA

attributes.name: total_reads
attributes.description: Total number of sequencing reads generated for the run, lane, or library before quality filtering. Used to assess raw sequencing throughput and as the denominator for percentage-based QC metrics such as clusters passing filter and undetermined index rate.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; bcl2fastq; ISO 15189

attributes.name: undetermined_index_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of reads that could not be assigned to a sample index during demultiplexing, indicating index hopping, contamination, or library preparation issues. High undetermined rates may trigger run failure or sample reprocessing. Sourced from bcl2fastq demultiplexing stats.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; bcl2fastq; ISO 15189; CLIA

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this QC metric record was last modified, such as when a QC status was updated following manual review or when a metric value was corrected. Required for GxP audit trail and data integrity compliance.

attributes.name: yield_gb
attributes.description: Total sequencing output in gigabases (Gb) for the run, lane, or library. Represents the volume of sequence data generated and is used to assess whether sufficient data was produced to meet coverage requirements for the assay type. Sourced from Illumina BaseSpace or bcl2fastq.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; ISO 15189; CLIA

products.name: demux_result
products.description: Transactional record capturing the output of the demultiplexing process (bcl2fastq / DRAGEN BCL Convert) for each library within a pooled sequencing run. Records library ID, run ID, lane, index sequence matched, read count assigned, percentage of reads assigned, undetermined read count, mismatch tolerance used, demux software version, demux completion timestamp, and demux QC pass/fail status. Provides the authoritative link between a sequencing run and the resulting per-sample FASTQ files.

attributes.name: demux_result_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each demultiplexing result record. Primary key for the demux_result data product. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — captures the discrete business event of demultiplexing a pooled sequencing run into per-sample FASTQ outputs.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Demultiplexing Result Object

While demux_result links to sample_specimen_id, the clinical_specimen carries accession number and chain of custody. Direct link enables CL

attributes.name: original_demux_result_id

attributes.name: run_lane_id

attributes.name: sequencing_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sequencing run from which this demultiplexing result was produced. Links the demux output back to the originating instrument run and flow cell.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run Object; LabVantage LIMS — Run Record

attributes.name: service_agreement_id

Direct linkage enables automated compliance checking

attributes.name: software_release_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.software_release. Business justification: Demultiplexing results are produced by specific software versions. Columns demux_software and demux_software_version are denormalized from product.software_release. For data provenance, regulatory sub

attributes.name: test_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.test_order. Business justification: Demultiplexing results are produced per-sample as part of a clinical test order workflow. Linking demux_result to test_order enables direct traceability from raw demux output to the clinical order for

attributes.name: assigned_read_count
attributes.description: Total number of sequencing reads assigned to this library after demultiplexing. Primary quantitative outcome of the demux process. Used to assess library representation and coverage depth adequacy for downstream analysis.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Read Count Metric; NGS QC Standards

attributes.name: assigned_read_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of total reads in the lane assigned to this library (assigned_read_count / total lane reads × 100). Indicates library balance within the pool. Values significantly deviating from expected multiplexing ratio trigger QC review.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Demux Metrics; NGS Multiplexing QC Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this demux result record was first captured in the data platform. Audit trail field for data lineage and GxP compliance.
attributes.references: GxP (21 CFR Part 11 — Electronic Records); ISO 27001 — Audit Logging

attributes.name: data_release_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the FASTQ files produced by this demux result have been formally released for downstream bioinformatics processing or delivery to the customer/requester. True = released; False = held (pending QC review or approval). Supports data governance and release management workflows.
attributes.references: ISO 15189 — Result Release Authorization; CLIA — Result Reporting; HIPAA — PHI Release Controls

attributes.name: demux_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the demultiplexing process completed for this library within the sequencing run. Principal business event timestamp. Used for turnaround time (TAT) calculation and SLA monitoring.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Job Completion Time; ISO 15189 — TAT Monitoring

attributes.name: demux_run_identifier
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the demultiplexing execution job, as assigned by the demux software (e.g., bcl2fastq job ID or DRAGEN BCL Convert run name). Used for cross-referencing with Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub and bioinformatics pipeline logs.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Demux Job Identifier; bcl2fastq / DRAGEN BCL Convert

attributes.name: demux_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the demultiplexing process was initiated for this run. Used in conjunction with demux_completion_timestamp to calculate demux processing duration for performance monitoring.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Job Start Time

attributes.name: demux_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the demultiplexing job for this library-run combination. 'completed' indicates successful assignment; 'partial' indicates some reads assigned but below threshold; 'failed' indicates job error or no reads assigned.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Job Status; LabVantage LIMS — Workflow Status

attributes.name: fastq_i1_path
attributes.description: Storage path or URI to the FASTQ file containing Index Read 1 (i7 index) sequences. Generated when index reads are retained in FASTQ format. Used for index QC validation and troubleshooting demultiplexing failures.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Index FASTQ; bcl2fastq Documentation

attributes.name: fastq_r1_path
attributes.description: Storage path or URI to the FASTQ file containing Read 1 (forward reads) generated for this library after demultiplexing. Provides the authoritative link between the demux result and the resulting FASTQ output file for downstream bioinformatics pipeline ingestion.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — FASTQ File Object; FASTQ Format Specification (Cock et al., 2010)

attributes.name: fastq_r2_path
attributes.description: Storage path or URI to the FASTQ file containing Read 2 (reverse reads) generated for this library after demultiplexing. Populated only for paired-end sequencing runs. Null for single-end runs.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — FASTQ File Object; FASTQ Format Specification (Cock et al., 2010)

attributes.name: index_mismatch_count
attributes.description: Number of reads assigned to this library that contained one or more base mismatches in the index sequence relative to the expected index, within the allowed mismatch tolerance. Elevated counts may indicate index synthesis errors or library contamination.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Demux Mismatch Metrics; bcl2fastq Documentation

attributes.name: index_sequence
attributes.description: The nucleotide index sequence (i7 and optionally i5 dual-index) matched to assign reads to this library during demultiplexing. Supports single-index (e.g., ACGTACGT) and dual-index (e.g., ACGTACGT+TTGGCCAA) formats. Critical for multiplexing validation and index collision analysis.
attributes.references: Illumina Index Adapter Sequences; NGS Library Preparation Standards

attributes.name: instrument_platform
attributes.description: The sequencing instrument platform model used for the run (e.g., NovaSeq 6000, NovaSeq X, NextSeq 2000, MiSeq). Determines flow cell format, lane count, and applicable demux parameters. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NovaSeq_6000|NovaSeq_X|NextSeq_2000|MiSeq|HiSeq_4000|PromethION|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Illumina Instrument Specifications; LabVantage LIMS — Instrument Registry

attributes.name: lane_number
attributes.description: The physical lane number on the flow cell from which reads were demultiplexed. Flow cells may contain 1, 2, 4, or 8 lanes depending on instrument type (e.g., NovaSeq, HiSeq). Required for per-lane QC analysis and troubleshooting.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Lane Metrics; Illumina Flow Cell Specification

attributes.name: mean_phred_score_r1
attributes.description: Mean Phred quality score across all bases in Read 1 for this library. Phred score (Q score) represents base call accuracy (Q30 = 99.9% accuracy). A key NGS QC metric; values below Q30 threshold may trigger QC failure.
attributes.references: Phred Quality Score Standard (Ewing & Green, 1998); Illumina BaseSpace QC Metrics; CLIA — Analytical Quality Requirements

attributes.name: mean_phred_score_r2
attributes.description: Mean Phred quality score across all bases in Read 2 for this library. Typically lower than R1 due to signal degradation in paired-end sequencing. Null for single-end runs.
attributes.references: Phred Quality Score Standard (Ewing & Green, 1998); Illumina BaseSpace QC Metrics

attributes.name: min_read_count_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum number of assigned reads required for this library to pass QC, as defined by the applicable assay protocol or SOP. Stored at the record level to capture the threshold in effect at the time of demultiplexing, supporting historical QC audits.
attributes.references: ISO 15189 — QC Acceptance Criteria; CAP — NGS Checklist; Internal SOP

attributes.name: mismatch_tolerance
attributes.description: Number of allowable base mismatches permitted when matching a read's index sequence to the expected library index during demultiplexing. Typically 0 or 1. Higher values increase assignment rate but risk index cross-contamination between libraries.
attributes.references: bcl2fastq User Guide; DRAGEN BCL Convert Documentation; Illumina Demultiplexing Best Practices

attributes.name: pct_q30_r1
attributes.description: Percentage of Read 1 bases with a Phred quality score of 30 or higher (≥Q30). Industry-standard NGS QC threshold; Illumina specifies ≥75–80% Q30 as passing for most platforms. Used in run-level and library-level QC reporting.
attributes.references: Illumina Sequencing Quality Metrics; CLIA — Analytical Performance Standards; CAP — NGS Checklist

attributes.name: pct_q30_r2
attributes.description: Percentage of Read 2 bases with a Phred quality score of 30 or higher (≥Q30). Null for single-end runs. Compared against run-specific QC thresholds for paired-end quality assessment.
attributes.references: Illumina Sequencing Quality Metrics; CAP — NGS Checklist

attributes.name: qc_failure_reason
attributes.description: Descriptive reason for QC failure when qc_pass_flag = False. Examples include: 'low_read_count', 'high_undetermined_rate', 'index_collision', 'low_q30'. Populated by automated QC rules or manual review. Null when qc_pass_flag = True.
attributes.references: ISO 15189 — Non-Conformance Documentation; CLIA — QC Failure Reporting; CAP — NGS QC Checklist

attributes.name: qc_pass_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the demultiplexing result for this library passed all defined QC thresholds (read count, percentage assigned, undetermined rate). True = QC passed; False = QC failed. Authoritative gate for downstream bioinformatics pipeline processing.
attributes.references: ISO 15189 — Quality Control; CLIA — Laboratory QC Requirements; Illumina BaseSpace QC Metrics

attributes.name: read_length_r1
attributes.description: Length in base pairs (bp) of Read 1 sequences produced for this library. Determined by the sequencing run configuration. Critical for downstream alignment and variant calling pipeline compatibility.
attributes.references: Illumina Sequencing Run Parameters; NGS Read Length Standards

attributes.name: read_length_r2
attributes.description: Length in base pairs (bp) of Read 2 sequences produced for this library. Null for single-end runs. Used to confirm paired-end symmetry and pipeline input validation.
attributes.references: Illumina Sequencing Run Parameters; NGS Read Length Standards

attributes.name: reprocessing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this demux result was generated by reprocessing a previously demultiplexed run (e.g., due to sample sheet correction, software update, or QC failure remediation). True = reprocessed; False = original demux. Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: GxP (21 CFR Part 11 — Audit Trail); ISO 15189 — Corrective Action Records

attributes.name: run_use_type
attributes.description: Intended use classification of the sequencing run from which this demux result originates. RUO (Research Use Only), IVD (In Vitro Diagnostic), LDT (Laboratory Developed Test), clinical_validation, or research. Governs applicable regulatory requirements and data handling obligations.
attributes.references: FDA — IVD Regulation; IVDR (EU) 2017/746; CLIA — Test Classification; CAP Accreditation

attributes.name: sample_sheet_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the sample sheet used to configure the demultiplexing run. The sample sheet defines library-to-index mappings and run parameters. Versioning ensures traceability and supports reprocessing with corrected configurations.
attributes.references: Illumina Sample Sheet Specification; LabVantage LIMS — Sample Sheet Management

attributes.name: sequencing_type
attributes.description: Classification of the sequencing assay type for this library (e.g., WGS — Whole Genome Sequencing, WES — Whole Exome Sequencing, targeted panel, amplicon, RNA-seq). Determines applicable QC thresholds and downstream bioinformatics pipeline routing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WGS|WES|targeted|amplicon|RNA-seq|single-cell|metagenomics|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; CAP — NGS Checklist; CLIA — Test Classification

attributes.name: total_lane_read_count
attributes.description: Total number of reads generated in the flow cell lane from which this library was demultiplexed. Used as the denominator for calculating assigned_read_pct and undetermined_read_pct. Enables per-lane yield assessment.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Lane Metrics; Illumina Run QC Documentation

attributes.name: undetermined_read_count
attributes.description: Number of reads in the lane that could not be assigned to any library due to index mismatch or ambiguity. High undetermined counts indicate index contamination, library preparation issues, or incorrect sample sheet configuration.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Undetermined Reads Metric; bcl2fastq Documentation

attributes.name: undetermined_read_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of total lane reads that were unassigned (undetermined_read_count / total lane reads × 100). A key QC metric; values exceeding the defined threshold (typically >5%) trigger run-level QC failure investigation.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Demux QC Metrics; NGS QC Thresholds

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this demux result record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking and data lineage auditing.
attributes.references: GxP (21 CFR Part 11 — Electronic Records); ISO 27001 — Audit Logging

products.name: fastq_file
products.description: Master record representing a FASTQ output file generated from demultiplexing. Captures file name, file path (cloud storage URI on BaseSpace/S3), file size (bytes), read number (R1/R2/I1/I2), total read count, mean read length (bp), compression format (gzip), MD5 checksum, generation timestamp, associated library and run, BaseSpace dataset ID, retention policy, and data classification (PHI/non-PHI). SSOT for raw sequencing data file inventory — the primary output artifact of the sequencing domain.

attributes.name: fastq_file_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the FASTQ file record in the sequencing data inventory. Primary key for this master resource entity representing a raw sequencing output file.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Dataset Object Model

attributes.name: assay_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.assay_version. Business justification: FASTQ files are generated under a specific assay version's sequencing parameters (read length, pipeline version, quality thresholds). CLIA labs must document which assay version governed the sequencin

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sequencing instrument (e.g., Illumina NovaSeq, NextSeq, MiSeq) that generated the raw data for this FASTQ file. Enables instrument-level performance tracking, maintenance correlation, and QC trend analysis.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Instrument Management; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Instrument Registry

attributes.name: clinical_specimen_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.clinical_specimen. Business justification: FASTQ files are derived from a clinical specimen. While fastq_file links to sample_specimen_id, the clinical_specimen carries accession number, chain of custody, and consent status. Direct link enable

attributes.name: experiment_id

attributes.name: extraction_id

attributes.name: flow_cell_id
attributes.description: Reference to the flow cell consumable used in the sequencing run that produced this FASTQ file. Enables flow cell-level QC analysis, lot traceability for reagent investigations, and consumable performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Consumable Tracking; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run Metadata; ISO 13485

attributes.name: library_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sequencing library (prepared sample) from which this FASTQ file was generated. Enables traceability from raw data back to library preparation and upstream sample management.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Library Preparation Module; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.license_entitlement. Business justification: FASTQ file storage and processing consume license entitlements (storage_quota_gb, data_processing_limit_gb). For license compliance reporting and usage-based billing in cloud genomics platforms, files

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bioinformatics.bioinformatics_pipeline_run. Business justification: FASTQ files are the direct input consumed by bioinformatics pipeline runs. Data management systems must track which pipeline run processed each FASTQ for reprocessing decisions, data release gating, a

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the research or clinical project under which this FASTQ file was generated. Enables project-level data aggregation, access control scoping, and cost allocation for sequencing activities.
attributes.references: Benchling — Project Management; LabVantage LIMS — Project Module; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: qc_result_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.qc_result. Business justification: FASTQ files undergo formal QC assessment (qc_status, qc_failure_reason on fastq_file). In regulated clinical genomics (CLIA/CAP), the QC result for each FASTQ file must be formally documented and trac

attributes.name: research_protocol_id
attributes.description: The IRB protocol identifier under which human subject samples associated with this FASTQ file were collected and sequenced. Required for clinical and research genomics data governance, consent verification, and regulatory audit trails.
attributes.references: IRB Regulations 45 CFR Part 46 (Common Rule); FDA 21 CFR Part 56; HIPAA Research Exemptions; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: run_lane_id
