Adding sequencin

attributes.name: sequencing_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sequencing run that this sample sheet configures. Links the sample sheet to the parent run record in the sequencing domain.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run Management

attributes.name: software_release_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.software_release. Business justification: Sample sheets specify the demultiplexing software version to be used. Columns demultiplexing_software and demultiplexing_software_version are denormalized from product.software_release. For GxP-contro

attributes.name: technical_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.technical_requirement. Business justification: Sample sheets are configured to fulfill customer technical requirements (read length, index strategy, override cycles, application type). This link enables validation that the sample sheet correctly i

attributes.name: test_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.test_catalog. Business justification: A run sample sheet is generated for a specific clinical test catalog entry. The test_catalog defines the assay parameters that populate the sample sheet. Linking enables traceability from the sample s

attributes.name: validation_study_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.validation_study. Business justification: Sample sheet formats and demultiplexing software versions require validation studies in GxP genomics (validation_status on run_sample_sheet). Direct FK to validation_study enables traceability from a

attributes.name: adapter_read1
attributes.description: The adapter sequence to be trimmed from the 3' end of Read 1 during BCLConvert processing (e.g., AGATCGGAAGAGCACACGTCTGAACTCCAGTCA for TruSeq). Correct adapter specification is critical for accurate read trimming and downstream alignment quality.
attributes.references: Illumina Adapter Sequences Document; Illumina BCLConvert User Guide

attributes.name: adapter_read2
attributes.description: The adapter sequence to be trimmed from the 3' end of Read 2 in paired-end runs (e.g., AGATCGGAAGAGCGTCGTGTAGGGAAAGAGTGT for TruSeq). Null for single-end runs. Must match the library preparation kit adapter chemistry.
attributes.references: Illumina Adapter Sequences Document; Illumina BCLConvert User Guide

attributes.name: application_type
attributes.description: The genomic sequencing application configured for this run. Drives pipeline selection, adapter trimming, and analysis settings. Examples: WGS (Whole Genome Sequencing), WES (Whole Exome Sequencing), Targeted Panel, Amplicon, RNA-Seq, Methylation, 16S rRNA. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WGS|WES|Targeted Panel|Amplicon|RNA-Seq|Methylation|16S rRNA|Custom — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Illumina Application Notes; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CAP Genomics Checklist

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the sample sheet received final approval (electronic signature) for use in a GxP-controlled sequencing run. Distinct from submission timestamp; captures the authorization event in the document lifecycle.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GxP Audit Trail; Veeva Vault Quality Management; ISO 13485 Section 4.2

attributes.name: basespace_run_code
attributes.description: The unique run identifier assigned by Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub upon run registration or upload. Enables direct cross-reference between the internal data platform record and the BaseSpace cloud environment for FASTQ retrieval and run monitoring.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub API; Illumina Run Monitoring Documentation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this run sample sheet record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking per GxP and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GxP Electronic Records; ISO 27001

attributes.name: electronic_signature
attributes.description: The electronic signature identifier or hash of the authorized signatory who approved this sample sheet for GxP-controlled runs. Required under 21 CFR Part 11 for electronic records in regulated environments. Stored as a reference token, not the raw signature credential.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 — Electronic Records and Signatures; GxP Document Control; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: experiment_name
attributes.description: The experiment identifier or label captured in the [Header] section of the Illumina sample sheet. Provides a human-readable label for the run experiment, used for BaseSpace project organization and LIMS cross-referencing.
attributes.references: Illumina Sample Sheet Header Specification; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: flow_cell_type
attributes.description: The specific flow cell cartridge type loaded on the instrument for this run (e.g., SP, S1, S2, S4 for NovaSeq; P1, P2, P3 for NovaSeq X; High Output, Mid Output for NextSeq). Determines lane count, cluster density, and total output capacity.
attributes.references: Illumina Flow Cell Specifications; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: gxp_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sample sheet is subject to GxP (Good Practice Regulations) document control requirements, including version control, electronic signature, and audit trail obligations under 21 CFR Part 11 and applicable GMP/GLP/GCP frameworks.
attributes.references: GxP (GMP/GLP/GCP); 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Electronic Records; ISO 13485 Section 4.2

attributes.name: index1_cycles
attributes.description: Number of cycles for Index 1 (i7 index read) used in multiplexed library demultiplexing. Typically 8 or 10 cycles. Determines the length of the i7 barcode sequence read during the indexing phase.
attributes.references: Illumina Dual-Index Sequencing Guide; Illumina Sample Sheet v2 Specification

attributes.name: index2_cycles
attributes.description: Number of cycles for Index 2 (i5 index read) used in dual-indexed multiplexed library demultiplexing. Typically 8 or 10 cycles. Null for single-indexed runs. Required for dual-index demultiplexing workflows.
attributes.references: Illumina Dual-Index Sequencing Guide; Illumina Sample Sheet v2 Specification

attributes.name: index_adapter_kit
attributes.description: The specific index adapter kit used for multiplexing (e.g., IDT for Illumina DNA/RNA UD Indexes, Nextera DNA CD Indexes). Defines the index sequence set and ensures correct barcode assignment during demultiplexing.
attributes.references: Illumina Index Adapter Kit Documentation; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: instrument_platform
attributes.description: The Illumina sequencing instrument platform model for which this sample sheet is configured. Determines supported flow cell types, read lengths, and chemistry parameters. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NovaSeq 6000|NovaSeq X|NextSeq 550|NextSeq 2000|MiSeq|HiSeq 4000|iSeq 100 — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Illumina Instrument Specifications; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: investigator_name
attributes.description: Name of the principal investigator or study lead responsible for the samples in this run. Captured in the [Header] section of the Illumina sample sheet. Used for accountability, reporting, and GxP traceability.
attributes.references: Illumina Sample Sheet Header Specification; GxP Audit Trail; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493

attributes.name: lane_count
attributes.description: Number of flow cell lanes configured in this sample sheet. Determines how samples are distributed across lanes for multiplexing. Varies by flow cell type (e.g., 2 lanes for SP, 4 lanes for S2/S4 on NovaSeq 6000).
attributes.references: Illumina Flow Cell Lane Configuration Guide; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: library_prep_kit
attributes.description: The name and version of the library preparation kit used to prepare samples for sequencing (e.g., Illumina DNA Prep, TruSeq DNA PCR-Free, Nextera DNA Flex). Determines adapter sequences, index compatibility, and recommended run parameters.
attributes.references: Illumina Library Prep Kit Documentation; LabVantage LIMS — Library Preparation Workflow

attributes.name: lims_request_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Request ID
attributes.description: The work order or sequencing request identifier from LabVantage LIMS that initiated this sample sheet. Provides bidirectional traceability between the sample sheet and the originating laboratory workflow request.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Sequencing Request Management; ISO 15189 Section 5.4

attributes.name: mask_short_reads
attributes.description: The MaskShortReads BCLConvert setting specifying the read length threshold below which reads are masked (replaced with Ns) rather than discarded. Complements minimum_trimmed_read_length to control short-read handling behavior in FASTQ output.
attributes.references: Illumina BCLConvert User Guide — MaskShortReads Parameter

attributes.name: minimum_trimmed_read_length
attributes.description: The MinimumTrimmedReadLength BCLConvert setting specifying the minimum acceptable read length (in base pairs) after adapter trimming. Reads shorter than this threshold are discarded. Impacts FASTQ output quality and downstream alignment performance.
attributes.references: Illumina BCLConvert User Guide — MinimumTrimmedReadLength Parameter

attributes.name: override_cycles_string
attributes.description: The OverrideCycles parameter string in Illumina sample sheet v2 format (e.g., 'Y151;I8;I8;Y151') that explicitly defines the cycle allocation for each read and index segment. Overrides default cycle settings and is used by BCLConvert for precise demultiplexing configuration.
attributes.references: Illumina BCLConvert User Guide; Illumina Sample Sheet v2 Specification

attributes.name: project_name
attributes.description: The project or study name associated with the samples in this sample sheet. Used for grouping FASTQ output files by project in BaseSpace and downstream bioinformatics pipelines. Maps to the 'Sample_Project' column in the sample manifest.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Project Management; LabVantage LIMS

attributes.name: read1_cycles
attributes.description: Number of sequencing cycles for Read 1 (forward read). Directly determines the read length in base pairs for the primary read. Typical values range from 50 to 300 cycles depending on application and instrument platform.
attributes.references: Illumina Sample Sheet v2 Specification — [Reads] Section; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: read2_cycles
attributes.description: Number of sequencing cycles for Read 2 (reverse read) in paired-end runs. Null for single-end runs. Must match Read 1 cycles for symmetric paired-end configurations or may differ for asymmetric designs.
attributes.references: Illumina Sample Sheet v2 Specification — [Reads] Section; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: read_type
attributes.description: Specifies whether the sequencing run is configured as single-end (one read direction) or paired-end (forward and reverse reads). Paired-end reads improve alignment accuracy and are standard for WGS and WES applications.
attributes.references: Illumina Sequencing Technology Guide; NGS Best Practices

attributes.name: run_sample_sheet_description
attributes.description: Free-text description field from the [Header] section of the Illumina sample sheet. May include run purpose, special instructions, or notes relevant to the sequencing configuration. Supports operational context for lab staff.

attributes.name: sample_count
attributes.description: Total number of samples listed in the sample manifest section of this sample sheet. Represents the multiplexing depth for the run. Used for capacity planning, lane loading calculations, and demultiplexing validation.
attributes.references: Illumina Multiplexing Guidelines; LabVantage LIMS — Sample Tracking

attributes.name: sample_sheet_format_version
attributes.description: Version of the Illumina sample sheet format used (v1 or v2). v2 supports multi-section configuration including [Header], [Reads], [BCLConvert_Settings], and [BCLConvert_Data] sections. Determines downstream demultiplexing compatibility and parser behavior.
attributes.references: Illumina Sample Sheet v2 Specification; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: sample_sheet_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title assigned to the sample sheet file, typically following the Illumina naming convention (e.g., SampleSheet_RunID_YYYYMMDD). Serves as the externally-known business identifier for this document. Aligns with Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub sample sheet naming standards.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Sample Sheet Specification

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when the sample sheet was submitted to the instrument or uploaded to Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub. This is the principal business event timestamp for this transaction.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; GxP Audit Trail Requirements; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this run sample sheet record. Supports change tracking and GxP audit trail requirements for controlled documents.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GxP Electronic Records; ISO 13485 Section 4.2

attributes.name: use_type
attributes.description: Regulatory intended use classification for the samples in this run. RUO (Research Use Only) indicates non-clinical research; IVD (In Vitro Diagnostic) indicates regulated diagnostic use; LDT (Laboratory Developed Test) indicates a lab-specific validated test; GMP indicates manufacturing-grade production run.
attributes.references: FDA IVD Regulations 21 CFR Part 809; IVDR EU 2017/746; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; ISO 13485

attributes.name: validation_error_summary
attributes.description: Free-text summary of validation errors or warnings identified during automated sample sheet validation (e.g., index collision detected, invalid cycle count, missing required fields). Populated when validation_status is 'failed_validation'. Supports rapid troubleshooting by lab operators.
attributes.references: Illumina BCLConvert Validation Rules; LabVantage LIMS QC Workflow; GxP Non-Conformance Handling

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle and validation state of the sample sheet. 'draft' indicates in-preparation; 'pending_validation' awaiting automated or manual QC check; 'validated' passed all checks and approved for run execution; 'failed_validation' contains errors blocking run start; 'superseded' replaced by a corrected version; 'cancelled' withdrawn before use. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_validation|validated|failed_validation|superseded|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GxP Document Control; ISO 13485 Section 4.2; 21 CFR Part 11; Veeva Vault Quality Management

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Document version number of this sample sheet (e.g., v1.0, v1.1, v2.0). Incremented upon each revision or correction. Supports GxP document version control and supersession tracking. The combination of sample_sheet_name and version_number uniquely identifies a document revision.
attributes.references: GxP Document Control; ISO 13485 Section 4.2; 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl Document Control

domains.name: sample
domains.description: Authoritative SSOT for biological sample identity, chain-of-custody, and lifecycle tracking across accessioning, aliquoting, storage, and disposal. Manages sample metadata, IRB consent linkage, PHI de-identification flags, specimen types, collection metadata, and LIMS-driven workflow assignments in LabVantage. Underpins traceability for clinical, research, and QC specimens.

products.name: sample_specimen
products.description: Core master entity representing a biological specimen collected from a subject (human, animal, or environmental source). Captures specimen identity, type classification (blood, tissue, saliva, FFPE, cfDNA, etc.), collection site, collection date/time, collection method, volume/mass, matrix type, PHI de-identification flag and tier, IRB protocol linkage, consent status, current lifecycle status (accessioned, in-processing, extracted, archived, depleted, disposed), and LIMS accession number from LabVantage. This is the SSOT for all biological material entering the genomics workflow and the anchor entity for chain-of-custody traceability.
products.reference: HL7 FHIR Specimen Resource / ISBER Best Practices

attributes.name: sample_specimen_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the biological specimen record in the Genomics Biotech data lakehouse. Primary key for all chain-of-custody and traceability references. Role: MASTER_RESOURCE.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Specimens originate from customer accounts (research institutions, hospitals, biotech companies). Essential for billing, consent compliance, regulatory reporting, and data use agreement enforcement. C

attributes.name: batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.batch. Business justification: Specimen processing uses supply materials from specific batches (processing reagents, stabilizers). GMP traceability requires linking specimens to the supply batch of processing material used, enablin

attributes.name: change_control_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.change_control. Business justification: Change controls may affect specimens (e.g., storage location changes, new handling procedures). Labs link change controls to affected specimens for traceability and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: collection_kit_catalog_item_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Collection Kit Catalog Item Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.catalog_item. Business justification: Specimens are collected using specific collection kit products. LIMS systems track kit SKU for regulatory compliance (21 CFR Part 11), lot traceability, and QC correlation. Essential for genomics oper

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.quality_deviation. Business justification: Specimens trigger quality deviations (failed QC, contamination, handling errors). Labs link specimens to deviations for root cause analysis, CAPA, and regulatory compliance. Essential for GxP traceabi

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_header. Business justification: Specimens are collected and processed to fulfill customer sequencing/testing service orders. Essential for tracking which specimens support which commercial transactions, TAT compliance, and revenue r

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material. Business justification: Specimens are processed using specific materials (extraction kits, culture media, reagents). Real-world LIMS systems track material lot numbers for regulatory traceability, recall management, and CoA

attributes.name: parent_specimen_sample_specimen_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the parent specimen from which this specimen was derived (e.g., an aliquot derived from a primary blood draw, or an extracted DNA specimen derived from a tissue biopsy). Enables hierarchical specimen lineage and chain-of-custody traceability.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS; ISO 15189; HL7 FHIR R4 Specimen.parent; CAP Chain-of-Custody Standards

attributes.name: processing_reagent_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reagent.lot. Business justification: Specimens are processed using specific reagent lots for nucleic acid extraction, library preparation, and quality control. Critical for batch effect analysis, regulatory traceability (21 CFR Part 11),

attributes.name: production_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.production_batch. Business justification: GMP batch traceability: QA must identify which production batch processed a specimen for batch disposition, recall, and deviation investigation. In genomics biotech, specimens are processed in discret

attributes.name: research_protocol_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Institutional Review Board (IRB) protocol under which this specimen was collected and is authorized for use. Mandatory for all human-derived specimens used in research. Ensures regulatory traceability to the governing ethics approval.
attributes.references: 45 CFR Part 46 (Common Rule); FDA 21 CFR Part 56; ICH E6(R2) GCP; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the biological subject (human patient, research participant, animal, or environmental source) from whom the specimen was collected. Links to the subject master record for IRB consent and PHI management. Classified as restricted due to potential re-identification risk.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; GDPR Article 9; IRB 45 CFR Part 46; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.submission. Business justification: Clinical specimens used in 510k or CE-IVD submissions require traceability to regulatory dossiers for FDA/notified body audits and validation evidence packages. Essential for IVD product regulatory co

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supplier. Business justification: When specimens are received from external biobanks, CROs, or collaborating institutions, tracking the supplier is critical for specimen provenance, quality management, audit trails, and vendor perform

attributes.name: validation_study_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.validation_study. Business justification: Validation studies use real specimens as test samples to demonstrate assay performance. Labs track which specimens were used in each validation for regulatory submissions and audit trails.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.work_order. Business justification: Specimens are processed through manufacturing work orders for library preparation, sequencing runs, and array-based assays. This link enables tracking specimen-to-manufacturing traceability required f

attributes.name: a260_a280_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of absorbance at 260 nm to 280 nm as measured by NanoDrop spectrophotometer, indicating nucleic acid purity. Acceptable range is 1.8–2.0 for DNA and ~2.0 for RNA. Values outside this range indicate protein or solvent contamination.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CLSI MM13-A; NanoDrop Application Notes; LabVantage LIMS

attributes.name: aliquot_number
attributes.description: Sequential number identifying this specimen as a specific aliquot derived from a parent specimen (e.g., aliquot 3 of 8 from a primary blood draw). Used for inventory management, depletion tracking, and ensuring equitable distribution of limited specimens across assays.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS; ISO 20387; CAP Biorepository Checklist

attributes.name: collection_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country in which the specimen was collected (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Required for GDPR cross-border data transfer compliance, biospecimen import/export regulatory tracking, and population genomics stratification.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; GDPR Chapter V; Nagoya Protocol (CBD); NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: collection_method
attributes.description: Standardized method used to collect the specimen from the subject. Influences pre-analytical variability, QC acceptance criteria, and downstream genomic assay performance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: venipuncture|finger_prick|biopsy|swab|saliva_collection|urine_void|bone_marrow_aspirate|surgical_resection|liquid_biopsy|environmental_swab|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CLSI GP41-A6 (Venipuncture); CLSI GP44-A4; ISO 15189 Section 5.4; CAP Checklist

attributes.name: collection_site_code
attributes.description: Coded identifier for the anatomical site or environmental location from which the specimen was collected (e.g., left_arm_antecubital, liver_biopsy_segment_VI, tumor_margin). Aligns with SNOMED CT body site codes. Critical for oncology and multi-site clinical studies.
attributes.references: SNOMED CT Body Structure Hierarchy; HL7 FHIR R4 Specimen.collection.bodySite; ISO 15189

attributes.name: collection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the specimen was physically collected from the subject, recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Critical for pre-analytical stability calculations, TAT (Turnaround Time) tracking, and time-sensitive assay validity windows (e.g., cfDNA stability). Serves as the MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE temporal anchor for this resource.
attributes.references: ISO 15189 Section 5.4; CLSI EP10-A3; HL7 FHIR R4 Specimen.collection.collectedDateTime; HIPAA

attributes.name: concentration_ng_ul
attributes.description: Concentration of extracted nucleic acid (DNA or RNA) in nanograms per microliter (ng/µL), measured post-extraction by fluorometric or spectrophotometric methods (e.g., Qubit, NanoDrop). Used for library preparation input normalization and QC pass/fail determination.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CLSI MM13-A; LabVantage LIMS; Illumina Library Prep Guidelines

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Current status of the subject's informed consent for use of this specimen in research or clinical testing. Governs permissible downstream uses of the specimen and derived genomic data. Mandatory for all human-derived specimens under IRB, HIPAA, and GDPR requirements.
attributes.references: 45 CFR Part 46 (Common Rule); HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; GDPR Article 7 & 9; ICH E6(R2); NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: container_type
attributes.description: Type of physical container or tube in which the specimen is stored (e.g., EDTA tube, SST tube, PAXgene tube, cryovial, FFPE block). Affects pre-analytical processing requirements and downstream assay compatibility. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EDTA_tube|SST_tube|PAXgene_tube|cryovial|FFPE_block|microcentrifuge_tube|96_well_plate|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CLSI GP41-A6; ISO 15189; CAP Checklist; LabVantage LIMS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the specimen record was first created in LabVantage LIMS and ingested into the Genomics Biotech data lakehouse. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and SLA tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; GxP; SOX; ISO 27001; LabVantage LIMS

attributes.name: disposal_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the specimen was permanently disposed of or destroyed, recorded in LabVantage LIMS. Populated only when lifecycle_status is 'disposed'. Required for biorepository inventory reconciliation, regulatory audit trails, and biohazardous waste compliance documentation.
attributes.references: ISO 20387; ISO 15189; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CAP Biorepository Checklist; GxP; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1030

attributes.name: dna_integrity_number
attributes.description: DNA Integrity Number (DIN) score on a scale of 1-10 as measured by TapeStation, indicating genomic DNA quality and fragmentation level. Used for WGS and WES library preparation QC gating. Null for non-DNA specimens.
attributes.references: Agilent TapeStation DIN Standard; ISO 15189; CLSI MM13-A; Illumina WGS/WES Guidelines

attributes.name: external_specimen_code
attributes.description: Specimen identifier assigned by the submitting institution, clinic, or partner laboratory prior to receipt at Genomics Biotech. Used for cross-referencing with external Laboratory Information Systems (LIS) and Electronic Medical Records (EMR). May differ from the internal LIMS accession number.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Specimen Resource; ISO 15189 Section 5.4

attributes.name: freeze_thaw_count
attributes.description: Number of freeze-thaw cycles the specimen has undergone since collection. Excessive freeze-thaw cycles degrade nucleic acid integrity and protein stability, impacting assay performance. Tracked in LabVantage LIMS for QC and specimen integrity assessment.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CLSI EP25-A; CAP Biorepository Checklist; ISO 20387

attributes.name: hazard_classification
attributes.description: Biosafety Level (BSL) classification of the specimen per CDC/NIH biosafety guidelines, indicating the containment requirements for safe handling, processing, and disposal. Drives PPE requirements, laboratory access controls, and waste disposal procedures.
attributes.references: CDC/NIH Biosafety in Microbiological and Biomedical Laboratories (BMBL); ISO 15190; GxP; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1030

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Human-readable label printed on the specimen container or tube, typically matching the LIMS accession number or a barcode-encoded identifier. Used for physical identification during laboratory handling, storage, and retrieval. Serves as the IDENTITY_LABEL category for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS; ISO 15189 Section 5.4.3; CAP Specimen Labeling Standards

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current state of the specimen within the Genomics Biotech laboratory workflow lifecycle. Drives LIMS workflow routing, storage management, and chain-of-custody audit events. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS category for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: accessioned|in_processing|extracted|archived|depleted|disposed|rejected|on_hold — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS; ISO 15189; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CAP Checklist

attributes.name: lims_accession_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Accession Number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique accession number assigned by LabVantage LIMS at the point of specimen receipt. This is the primary business identifier used across laboratory workflows, requisition forms, and chain-of-custody documentation. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CAP Accreditation Standards; ISO 15189 Section 5.4

attributes.name: mass_mg
attributes.description: Mass of the specimen in milligrams (mg) at the time of accessioning or most recent measurement. Applicable to solid specimens (tissue biopsies, FFPE blocks, dried blood spots). Null for liquid specimens where volume_ul is used instead.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CLSI; LabVantage LIMS; CAP Checklist

attributes.name: matrix_type
attributes.description: Physical matrix or medium in which the specimen is preserved or suspended (e.g., aqueous buffer, FFPE paraffin block, dried blood spot, frozen tissue). Determines storage temperature requirements, extraction chemistry, and analytical method compatibility. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: aqueous|solid|semi-solid|dried|fixed|frozen|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CAP Specimen Handling Guidelines; CLSI EP25-A

attributes.name: nucleic_acid_type
attributes.description: Type of nucleic acid present in or extracted from the specimen. Determines compatible sequencing library preparation protocols (e.g., WGS, WES, RNA-Seq, ctDNA panel). Null or not_applicable for unextracted specimens. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: gDNA|cfDNA|RNA|total_RNA|mRNA|ctDNA|not_applicable — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CLSI MM13-A; Illumina BaseSpace; LabVantage LIMS

attributes.name: passage_count
attributes.description: Number of times the specimen or derived cell line has been sub-cultured or passaged. Relevant for cell-based specimens and primary cultures. Higher passage counts may indicate genomic drift and affect assay validity.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; ATCC Cell Line Standards; Benchling R&D Notebook

attributes.name: phi_deidentification_tier
attributes.description: Specifies the de-identification method applied to this specimen record per HIPAA standards: Safe Harbor (removal of 18 identifiers), Expert Determination (statistical certification), Pseudonymisation (GDPR Article 4(5)), or Identified (PHI present). Drives data access tier controls and downstream sharing permissions.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164.514; GDPR Article 4(5); NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; ISO 27001

attributes.name: phi_deidentified
attributes.description: Indicates whether Protected Health Information (PHI) has been removed or de-identified from this specimen record in accordance with HIPAA Safe Harbor or Expert Determination methods. When True, the record may be used in broader research contexts without individual consent restrictions.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164.514 (De-identification); GDPR Article 4(5) Pseudonymisation; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Processing priority assigned to the specimen, governing TAT (Turnaround Time) SLA targets and workflow queue position in LabVantage LIMS. STAT specimens require immediate processing; routine specimens follow standard scheduling.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CAP Accreditation; LabVantage LIMS; ISO 15189

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the specimen was received and accessioned into the Genomics Biotech laboratory, recorded in LabVantage LIMS. Used to calculate transit time, pre-analytical cold-chain compliance, and TAT (Turnaround Time) SLA metrics.
attributes.references: ISO 15189 Section 5.4; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493.1241; CAP Accreditation; LabVantage LIMS

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Coded reason for specimen rejection at accessioning or QC review. Populated only when lifecycle_status is 'rejected'. Used for pre-analytical quality monitoring, root cause analysis, and SOP improvement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: insufficient_volume|hemolyzed|lipemic|clotted|wrong_container|mislabeled|temperature_excursion|expired|contaminated|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 15189 Section 5.4.6; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493.1241; CAP Checklist; CLSI GP44-A4

attributes.name: rin_score
attributes.description: RNA Integrity Number (RIN) score on a scale of 1-10 as measured by Bioanalyzer or TapeStation, indicating RNA quality. A RIN score ≥7 is typically required for RNA-Seq library preparation. Null for non-RNA specimens.
attributes.references: Agilent Bioanalyzer RIN Standard; ISO 15189; CLSI MM13-A; Illumina RNA-Seq Guidelines

attributes.name: specimen_type
attributes.description: Classification of the biological material type collected from the subject. Drives downstream workflow routing, extraction protocols, and storage conditions in LabVantage LIMS. Serves as the CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE category for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: blood|tissue|saliva|urine|plasma|cfDNA|FFPE|bone_marrow|buccal_swab|stool|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SNOMED CT Specimen Hierarchy; HL7 FHIR R4 Specimen.type; ISO 15189; CAP Checklist

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Coded identifier for the physical storage location of the specimen within the biorepository (e.g., freezer ID, rack, shelf, box, position). Enables physical retrieval, inventory management, and chain-of-custody tracking in LabVantage LIMS.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS; ISO 20387 (Biobanking); CAP Biorepository Checklist

attributes.name: storage_temperature_c
attributes.description: Required or actual storage temperature for the specimen in degrees Celsius (e.g., -80, -20, 4, 25). Used for cold-chain compliance monitoring, specimen integrity assessment, and deviation management.
attributes.references: ISO 20387; ISO 15189; CAP Biorepository Checklist; CLSI GP44-A4

attributes.name: subtype
attributes.description: Further granular classification of the specimen within its primary type (e.g., for blood: whole_blood, PBMC, serum; for tissue: fresh_frozen, FFPE_block, FFPE_section; for cfDNA: cell_free_plasma). Enables precise protocol selection and QC thresholds in bioinformatics pipelines.
attributes.references: SNOMED CT; HL7 FHIR R4 Specimen.type; CAP Checklist; ISO 15189

attributes.name: tumor_content_pct
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of tumor cells (neoplastic cellularity) in the specimen as assessed by pathology review. Critical for somatic variant calling sensitivity, LOD (Limit of Detection) calculations, and clinical oncology reporting. Null for non-oncology specimens.
attributes.references: CAP Oncology Checklist; ISO 15189; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; College of American Pathologists

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the specimen record was most recently modified in LabVantage LIMS or the data lakehouse. Used for change data capture (CDC), audit trail compliance, and Silver layer incremental processing in Databricks.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; GxP; SOX; ISO 27001; LabVantage LIMS; Databricks Delta Lake

attributes.name: use_restriction_code
attributes.description: Coded data use restriction applicable to this specimen and its derived genomic data, aligned with GA4GH Data Use Ontology (DUO) codes (e.g., GRU: General Research Use, HMB: Health/Medical/Biomedical, DS: Disease-Specific). Governs permissible downstream research and data sharing activities.
attributes.references: GA4GH Data Use Ontology (DUO); NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; GDPR Article 9; HIPAA

attributes.name: use_type
attributes.description: Intended use classification for the specimen: clinical diagnostic testing (IVD), research (RUO), internal QC (Quality Control), assay validation, proficiency testing (CAP/CLIA), or Research Use Only (RUO). Determines applicable regulatory framework, data handling requirements, and reporting obligations.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CAP Accreditation; ISO 13485; IVDR 2017/746

attributes.name: volume_ul
attributes.description: Volume of the specimen in microliters (µL) at the time of accessioning or most recent measurement. Used for aliquot planning, minimum volume QC checks, and assay feasibility assessment. Applicable to liquid specimens (blood, plasma, urine, saliva, cfDNA). Null for solid specimens where mass_mg is used instead.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CLSI EP25-A; LabVantage LIMS; CAP Checklist

products.name: aliquot
products.description: Represents a physical sub-division of a parent specimen created during aliquoting workflows, including the container holding it. Tracks aliquot volume, concentration, unit of measure, container identity (barcode, type, manufacturer, lot number, material, volume capacity), position in storage rack/plate/well, aliquot purpose (sequencing, QC, archive, backup), current lifecycle status, and container status (in-use, empty, discarded). Maintains parent-child lineage back to the originating specimen and supports multi-level aliquot hierarchies (aliquot-of-aliquot). Also serves as the master record for empty container inventory when pre-registered in LabVantage. Managed with barcode-driven tracking.
products.reference: ISBER Best Practices for Repositories / LabVantage Aliquot Module

attributes.name: aliquot_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the aliquot record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for the aliquot data product within the sample domain. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — represents a physical sub-divided specimen unit managed as an independent trackable resource in LabVantage LIMS.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.catalog_item. Business justification: Aliquots are created using specific reagent kits (extraction, library prep). Business need: protocol compliance verification, batch effect analysis in sequencing QC, reagent lot traceability for faile

attributes.name: hierarchy_level

attributes.name: initial_volume_ul

attributes.name: specimen_type

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the subject record in the data platform, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental pipeline processing, and GxP audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: GxP (21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records); HIPAA Security Rule; GDPR Article 5(2) Accountability; ISO 27001

attributes.name: use_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory use classification for data and specimens derived from this subject. RUO (Research Use Only) specimens are not intended for clinical diagnosis; IVD (In Vitro Diagnostic) specimens are used in validated clinical assays; LDT (Laboratory Developed Test) specimens are used in laboratory-developed clinical tests. Drives regulatory handling, labeling, and data access controls.
attributes.references: FDA IVD Guidance 21 CFR Part 809; IVDR 2017/746; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; ISO 13485

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject formally withdrew consent or was removed from the study. Triggers downstream data use restriction workflows per HIPAA and GDPR right-to-erasure requirements. Populated only when subject_status is 'withdrawn'.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.508; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Reason for subject withdrawal from the study or clinical program, recorded when subject_status transitions to 'withdrawn'. Supports regulatory audit trails, protocol deviation reporting, and IRB annual review documentation. Populated only when applicable.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 45 CFR Part 46; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Veeva Vault Regulatory Document

attributes.name: year_of_birth
attributes.description: Four-digit birth year of the subject. Stored instead of full date of birth (DOB) to comply with HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification requirements (45 CFR §164.514(b)(2)(i)), which prohibit retention of specific birth dates. Enables age-range calculations and cohort age-stratification for population genomics without re-identification risk.
attributes.references: HIPAA Safe Harbor 45 CFR §164.514(b)(2)(i); GDPR Article 89 Research Exemption

products.name: collection_event
products.description: Transactional record of the physical specimen collection activity. Captures collection date/time, collection site (anatomical location or environmental site), collection method (venipuncture, biopsy, swab, saliva kit, liquid biopsy), collector ID, collection kit lot number, pre-analytical conditions (fasting status, time from collection to processing), and any collection deviations. Provides the pre-analytical metadata critical for NGS data quality interpretation.

attributes.name: collection_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the specimen collection event record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this transactional entity. Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Collection events occur at customer sites. Essential for site-specific protocol compliance monitoring, collection kit logistics coordination, site performance metrics, and regulatory audit trails. Rea

attributes.name: batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.batch. Business justification: Collection kit batch traceability is a GMP requirement — knowing which supply batch of collection kit material was used at each collection event enables batch recalls and deviation investigations. col

attributes.name: collection_kit_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reagent.reagent_catalog. Business justification: Collection events use specific collection kit products (PAXgene, Tempus, saliva kits). Critical for tracking kit performance across collection sites, supplier quality monitoring, and correlating pre-a

attributes.name: collection_kit_catalog_item_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Collection Kit Catalog Item Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.catalog_item. Business justification: Collection events use specific collection kit products. Currently denormalized as collection_kit_sku. Business need: kit lot traceability for regulatory compliance, collection protocol compliance veri

attributes.name: collection_kit_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reagent.lot. Business justification: GMP/GLP collection kit lot traceability: collection_kit_lot_number is a plain text denormalization. Regulatory requirements (CAP, CLIA, ISO 15189) mandate linking collection events to specific reagent

attributes.name: controlled_document_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) document in MasterControl that governed this collection event. Ensures traceability to the approved procedure version used, supporting GxP compliance and audit readiness.
attributes.references: MasterControl — Document Control; GxP (GLP/GCP); ISO 13485:2016 §4.2.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.40

attributes.name: deviation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.deviation. Business justification: Collection events with protocol deviations (wrong tube, collection outside time window, fasting protocol violated) require formal deviation records. The plain attributes deviation_flag/description/typ

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.header. Business justification: Collection events are initiated by service orders in genomics biotech; linking to order.header enables TAT reporting, billing reconciliation, and order-to-collection traceability. collection_order_num

attributes.name: lab_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sample.lab_site. Business justification: collection_event has a collection_site_code column typed as BIGINT — this is semantically a reference to a lab_site rather than a free-text code. lab_site is the authoritative master for laboratory an

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material. Business justification: Collection kits are materials with SKUs and lot numbers. Linking enables kit inventory management, automated consumption tracking, lot traceability for specimen provenance, and recall management. Remo

attributes.name: nonconformance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.nonconformance. Business justification: Collection nonconformances (hemolysis at collection, insufficient volume collected, wrong anatomical site) trigger NCRs distinct from deviations. Genomics labs require direct linkage from collection e

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the research study, clinical trial, or diagnostic project under which this collection event was performed. Enables cohort-level aggregation and study-specific pre-analytical QC reporting.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Study Module; ICH E6(R2) GCP; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: research_protocol_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Institutional Review Board (IRB) approved protocol under which this collection event was conducted. Mandatory for research specimens; ensures regulatory traceability of consent and ethical approval.
attributes.references: IRB Protocol Requirements; 45 CFR Part 46 (Common Rule); FDA 21 CFR Part 50; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: sample_consent_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the informed consent record obtained from the subject prior to collection. Links to the IRB consent management entity. Mandatory for research and clinical genomics specimens; supports HIPAA, GDPR, and NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.508; GDPR Article 7; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; 45 CFR Part 46

attributes.name: sample_specimen_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary biological sample record created as a result of this collection event. Links to the sample master entity in the Sample Management domain for downstream LIMS workflow assignments, aliquoting, and storage tracking.

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.study. Business justification: Collection events occur within studies — study-level collection tracking is required for enrollment monitoring, protocol deviation reporting, and collection timeline analysis. collection_event links t

attributes.name: subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the human subject, patient, or research participant from whom the specimen was collected. Links to the subject/patient master record. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER PARTY_REFERENCE category. Classified restricted/pii_identifier as it directly identifies a research or clinical participant.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; GDPR Article 4; IRB Protocol Requirements; LabVantage LIMS — Subject Module

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.submission. Business justification: In clinical trial genomics, collection events are performed under a regulatory submission (IND, IDE, PMA clinical study). collection_event.irb_protocol_number signals regulated context. Linking to sub

attributes.name: test_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.test_order. Business justification: A specimen collection event is directly triggered by a clinical test order. This link enables collection-to-order traceability for TAT calculation, recollection workflows, and regulatory audit trails.

attributes.name: training_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.training_record. Business justification: Training records document that collectors are qualified to perform collections. Labs link training to collection events for regulatory compliance and audit trails.

attributes.name: anatomical_site
attributes.description: Standardized anatomical location from which the specimen was collected (e.g., left antecubital vein, right breast core, nasopharynx). Encoded using SNOMED CT or ICD-10 topography codes where applicable. Critical for oncology and clinical genomics interpretation.
attributes.references: SNOMED CT Anatomy Hierarchy; ICD-10-CM Topography; HL7 FHIR Specimen.collection.bodySite; CAP Cancer Protocols

attributes.name: collection_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the country where the specimen was collected. Required for international regulatory compliance (GDPR, IVDR), cross-border data transfer governance, and geographic cohort stratification.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; GDPR Article 44 (Cross-border transfers); IVDR 2017/746

attributes.name: collection_date
attributes.description: Calendar date (yyyy-MM-dd) on which the specimen was collected. Stored separately from collection_timestamp to support date-level partitioning, reporting, and cases where only the date (not exact time) is known or required.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Collection Event; ISO 15189:2022; HIPAA Safe Harbor De-identification

attributes.name: collection_event_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally-known business identifier for the collection event, assigned by LabVantage LIMS at accessioning. Used for chain-of-custody documentation, deviation reports, and cross-system traceability. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.

attributes.name: collection_method
attributes.description: Standardized method used to obtain the biological specimen. Drives pre-analytical QC interpretation and NGS library preparation protocol selection. Values: venipuncture (blood draw), biopsy (tissue), swab (mucosal/surface), saliva_kit (self-collected saliva), liquid_biopsy (cell-free DNA from blood), fine_needle_aspiration (FNA cytology).
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Collection Method Reference; CLSI GP33; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4.3

attributes.name: collection_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional collector observations, special circumstances, or contextual notes recorded at the time of collection that do not fit into structured fields. Supports clinical interpretation and deviation investigation.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Collection Event Notes; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4

attributes.name: collection_sop_version
attributes.description: Version number of the SOP document used at the time of collection (e.g., v1.2, v3.0). Stored alongside the SOP ID to capture the exact approved version in effect, as SOP versions change over time.

attributes.name: collection_temperature_c
attributes.description: Ambient or transport temperature in degrees Celsius at the time of or immediately following specimen collection. Used to assess cold-chain compliance and pre-analytical stability. Critical for cfDNA liquid biopsy and RNA specimens.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Pre-Analytical Conditions; CLSI; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4.5

attributes.name: collection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) at which the physical specimen was collected from the subject or environment. This is the principal real-world event time and is critical for pre-analytical time calculations (e.g., time-to-processing, cold-chain compliance). Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Collection Event; CLIA 42 CFR §493.1241; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4.4

attributes.name: collection_tube_count
attributes.description: Number of collection tubes or containers used during the collection event. Relevant for blood draw events with multiple tube types (EDTA, SST, Streck cfDNA). Supports aliquot planning and chain-of-custody reconciliation.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Collection Event; CLSI H3-A6

attributes.name: collection_urgency
attributes.description: Priority classification of the collection event that governs Turnaround Time (TAT) expectations and workflow prioritization in LabVantage LIMS. 'stat' = immediate priority; 'urgent' = same-day; 'routine' = standard TAT.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Workflow Priority; SLA Management; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4

attributes.name: collection_volume_ml
attributes.description: Volume of specimen collected, expressed in millilitres (mL). Used for pre-analytical QC assessment (e.g., short draw detection), yield estimation, and aliquot planning. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER QUANTITATIVE_RESULT category (non-monetary transaction).
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Collection Metrics; CLSI H3-A6 (Venipuncture); ISO 15189:2022 §5.4

attributes.name: collection_volume_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the collection volume field. Typically mL for liquid specimens; mg or g for solid tissue specimens; uL for micro-volume collections.

attributes.name: collector_certification_number
attributes.description: Professional certification or license number of the individual who performed the collection (e.g., phlebotomy certification, nursing license). Required for CLIA and CAP compliance documentation and chain-of-custody integrity.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR §493.1489; CAP Accreditation Standards; ISO 15189:2022 §5.1

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the collection event record was first created in LabVantage LIMS. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SLA tracking. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Audit Trail; ISO 27001; GxP 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the collection event workflow. 'scheduled' = collection planned but not yet performed; 'in_progress' = collector has initiated; 'completed' = specimen successfully collected and handed off; 'cancelled' = event voided before collection; 'deviated' = completed with documented pre-analytical deviation. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Workflow State Machine; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4

attributes.name: fasting_status
attributes.description: Pre-analytical fasting status of the subject at the time of collection. Relevant for metabolomics, lipid panels, and certain genomic assays where fasting state affects analyte stability and downstream data quality interpretation.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Pre-Analytical Conditions; CLSI EP7; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4.2

attributes.name: hemolysis_index
attributes.description: Semi-quantitative assessment of hemolysis in the collected blood specimen, graded on a standardized scale (none, 1+ to 4+). Hemolysis is a key pre-analytical variable that degrades DNA/RNA quality and affects NGS library preparation success rates.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Specimen QC; CLSI EP7; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4.6

attributes.name: lims_accession_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Accession Number
attributes.description: Accession number assigned by LabVantage LIMS at the time of specimen receipt and registration. Serves as the primary LIMS-side identifier for chain-of-custody tracking and workflow assignment.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Accessioning Module; CLIA 42 CFR §493.1241; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4.4

attributes.name: phi_deidentified
attributes.description: Indicates whether Protected Health Information (PHI) associated with this collection event has been de-identified per HIPAA Safe Harbor or Expert Determination method. True = de-identified; False = identifiable PHI present. Governs data access controls and downstream sharing permissions.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; GDPR Article 89; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the specimen was received at the processing laboratory. Used to calculate time-in-transit and total pre-analytical time (collection to receipt). Critical for TAT reporting and cold-chain compliance verification.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Specimen Receipt; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4.4; CLIA 42 CFR §493.1241

attributes.name: scheduled_collection_date
attributes.description: Planned calendar date for the collection event as defined in the study protocol or clinical order. Compared against collection_date to calculate collection compliance and protocol adherence metrics.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Study Schedule; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Clinical Trial Protocol

attributes.name: specimen_type
attributes.description: Biological specimen type collected. Determines downstream processing protocols, storage conditions, and applicable NGS assay types (e.g., WGS, WES, liquid biopsy ctDNA). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: whole_blood|plasma|serum|buffy_coat|saliva|tissue_ffpe|tissue_fresh_frozen|buccal_swab|urine|csf|stool|bone_marrow|amniotic_fluid — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Specimen Type Reference; SNOMED CT; HL7 FHIR Specimen Resource; ISO 15189:2022

attributes.name: time_to_processing_minutes
attributes.description: Elapsed time in minutes between specimen collection timestamp and the start of primary processing (e.g., centrifugation, nucleic acid extraction). A critical pre-analytical variable for NGS data quality; exceeding thresholds may trigger QC flags or deviation records.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Pre-Analytical Metrics; CLSI H18-A4; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4.5

attributes.name: transport_condition
attributes.description: Required transport temperature condition for the collected specimen from collection site to processing laboratory. Drives cold-chain logistics and is compared against actual temperature readings for pre-analytical QC.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Transport Conditions; IATA P650 (Biological Substances); ISO 15189:2022 §5.4.5

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the collection event record in LabVantage LIMS. Supports audit trail requirements and Silver Layer incremental load detection. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Audit Trail; GxP 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 27001

attributes.name: use_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory use classification of the specimen collected. RUO = Research Use Only; IVD = In Vitro Diagnostic; LDT = Laboratory Developed Test; clinical_trial = collected under an approved clinical trial protocol; quality_control = internal QC specimen. Determines applicable regulatory framework (FDA, CLIA, CAP) and data handling requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 809 (IVD); CLIA 42 CFR §493; CAP Accreditation; ISO 13485:2016

products.name: extraction
products.description: Records the nucleic acid extraction process applied to a specimen or aliquot — producing DNA, RNA, cfDNA, gDNA, or total nucleic acid. Captures extraction method (column-based, magnetic bead, manual, automated), instrument used, extraction kit lot number, input material type and volume, elution volume, yield (ng/µL), purity ratios (A260/A280, A260/A230), extraction date, operator, and pass/fail QC determination. Critical pre-analytical step linking specimen to library preparation in the NGS workflow.

attributes.name: extraction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the nucleic acid extraction record. Primary key.

attributes.name: aliquot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sample.aliquot. Business justification: In genomics workflows, nucleic acid extractions are frequently performed on aliquots (physical sub-divisions of a specimen) rather than the original specimen directly. extraction already has sample_sp

attributes.name: approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.approval. Business justification: Nucleic acid extraction in GxP/IVD genomics labs must be performed under a validated, regulatory-approved method. The extraction record must reference the approval governing the extraction kit/method

attributes.name: assay_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.assay_version. Business justification: Nucleic acid extraction protocols are specified per assay version in genomics labs. Linking extraction to assay_version enables protocol compliance verification, version-specific yield/purity trending

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the automated extraction instrument used (e.g., QIAcube, KingFisher Flex). Null if manual extraction.

attributes.name: batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.batch. Business justification: GMP extraction processes require traceability of the specific supply batch of extraction kit material used. Enables batch recall impact assessment and deviation investigations. Complements existing ma

attributes.name: change_control_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.change_control. Business justification: Change controls may affect extraction methods (e.g., new kits, protocol updates). Labs link change controls to affected extractions for traceability and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: clinical_specimen_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.clinical_specimen. Business justification: A nucleic acid extraction is performed on a specific clinical specimen. This link enables end-to-end clinical traceability from specimen receipt through extraction to genomic result, required for CLIA

attributes.name: deviation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.quality_deviation. Business justification: Extraction failures (low yield, contamination, protocol deviations) are common quality events. Labs link extractions to deviations for process improvement and regulatory documentation.

attributes.name: experiment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.experiment. Business justification: Extractions execute experimental protocols. Linking extraction to experiment enables protocol compliance verification, data lineage for publications, assay validation documentation, and regulatory sub

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_header. Business justification: Extractions are performed as part of customer service orders (sequencing, genotyping). Links lab processing steps to commercial transactions for billing, quality tracking, and regulatory documentation

attributes.name: kit_catalog_item_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Extraction Kit Catalog Item Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.catalog_item. Business justification: Extraction uses specific kit products. Currently denormalized as extraction_kit_name. Business need: kit lot traceability for regulatory audits, cost-per-extraction calculation for pricing models, inv

attributes.name: kit_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reagent.lot. Business justification: Extraction uses specific reagent kit lots. Essential for correlating extraction yield/quality with reagent lot performance, investigating out-of-specification results, and maintaining GxP traceability

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material. Business justification: Extraction kits are materials with material numbers in ERP/LIMS systems. Linking enables inventory consumption tracking, automated reordering, kit lot traceability for regulatory submissions, and CoA

attributes.name: nonconformance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.nonconformance. Business justification: Extraction failures (contamination_flag=true, yield below spec, RIN score failure) trigger nonconformance records. Genomics labs require direct linkage from the extraction record to the NCR for batch

attributes.name: production_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.production_batch. Business justification: Extracted nucleic acid is a direct input to manufacturing production batches. GMP batch records must document which extraction was used. Traceability from extraction to production batch is required fo

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reagent.storage_location. Business justification: Chain-of-custody for extracted nucleic acids: extraction.storage_location is a plain text denormalization of the storage location entity. Linking to reagent.storage_location.storage_location_id enable

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.study. Business justification: Extractions are performed to support specific studies (e.g., genomic DNA extraction for a clinical genomics study). Study-level extraction traceability is required for regulatory submissions, study cl

attributes.name: training_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.training_record. Business justification: Training records document that operators are qualified to perform extractions. Labs link training to extraction activities for audit trails and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: validation_study_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.validation_study. Business justification: Extraction method validations use real extraction runs to demonstrate performance. Labs track which extractions were part of validation studies for regulatory submissions and method qualification.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.work_order. Business justification: Nucleic acid extraction is a controlled manufacturing operation executed via work orders in GMP/GLP environments. This link supports batch record documentation, process validation, deviation tracking,

attributes.name: a260_a230_ratio
attributes.description: Absorbance ratio at 260nm and 230nm wavelengths, indicating contamination by organic compounds or chaotropic salts. Expected range is 2.0-2.2 for pure nucleic acid.
attributes.references: ISO 20166-3 Molecular In Vitro Diagnostic Examinations

attributes.name: a260_a280_ratio
attributes.description: Absorbance ratio at 260nm and 280nm wavelengths, indicating nucleic acid purity. Pure DNA typically has ratio ~1.8, pure RNA ~2.0. Lower values indicate protein contamination.
attributes.references: ISO 20166-3 Molecular In Vitro Diagnostic Examinations

attributes.name: barcode
attributes.description: Unique barcode identifier assigned to the extracted nucleic acid aliquot for tracking and traceability.

attributes.name: concentration_ng_per_ul
attributes.description: Concentration of extracted nucleic acid measured in nanograms per microliter (ng/µL), typically measured by spectrophotometry or fluorometry.
attributes.references: ISO 20395 Biotechnology Requirements for Evaluating Performance of Quantification Methods

attributes.name: contamination_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether contamination was detected during or after extraction (True = contamination detected, False = no contamination).
attributes.references: ISO 15189 Laboratory Quality Management - Quality Control

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this extraction record was first created in the LIMS system, in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format.
attributes.references: ISO 15189 Laboratory Quality Management - Information Management

attributes.name: dv200_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of RNA fragments greater than 200 nucleotides, used as quality metric for degraded RNA samples (e.g., FFPE). Values >30% are typically acceptable for NGS.
attributes.references: ISO 20166-3 Molecular In Vitro Diagnostic Examinations

attributes.name: elution_volume_ul
attributes.description: Final elution volume of the extracted nucleic acid, measured in microliters (µL).
attributes.references: ISO 20166-3 Molecular In Vitro Diagnostic Examinations

attributes.name: extraction_date
attributes.description: Date when the nucleic acid extraction was performed, in yyyy-MM-dd format.
attributes.references: ISO 15189 Laboratory Quality Management - Pre-analytical Process Documentation

attributes.name: extraction_method
attributes.description: The nucleic acid extraction methodology applied to the specimen (e.g., column-based, magnetic bead, phenol-chloroform, manual, automated, salting-out).
attributes.references: ISO 20166-3 Molecular In Vitro Diagnostic Examinations

attributes.name: extraction_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the extraction process was completed, in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format.
attributes.references: ISO 15189 Laboratory Quality Management - Pre-analytical Process Documentation

attributes.name: input_mass_mg
attributes.description: Mass of input material used for extraction (applicable for solid tissue specimens), measured in milligrams (mg).
attributes.references: ISO 20166-3 Molecular In Vitro Diagnostic Examinations

attributes.name: input_material_type
attributes.description: Type of biological specimen used as input for extraction (e.g., whole blood, plasma, serum, tissue, saliva, buccal swab, urine, cerebrospinal fluid, FFPE, fresh frozen). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: whole_blood|plasma|serum|tissue|saliva|buccal_swab|urine|csf|ffpe|fresh_frozen — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 20166-1 Molecular In Vitro Diagnostic Examinations - Pre-examination Processes

attributes.name: input_volume_ul
attributes.description: Volume of input material used for extraction, measured in microliters (µL).
attributes.references: ISO 20166-3 Molecular In Vitro Diagnostic Examinations

attributes.name: intended_use
attributes.description: Intended downstream application for the extracted nucleic acid (e.g., NGS library preparation, qPCR, array, ddPCR, storage, research, clinical testing). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ngs_library_prep|qpcr|array|ddpcr|storage|research|clinical_testing — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 15189 Laboratory Quality Management - Test Request Management

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this extraction record was last modified in the LIMS system, in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format.
attributes.references: ISO 15189 Laboratory Quality Management - Information Management

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operator notes, observations, or deviations from standard protocol during the extraction process.

attributes.name: nucleic_acid_type
attributes.description: Type of nucleic acid extracted: DNA (deoxyribonucleic acid), RNA (ribonucleic acid), cfDNA (cell-free DNA), gDNA (genomic DNA), total nucleic acid, or mRNA (messenger RNA).
attributes.references: ISO 20395 Biotechnology Requirements for Evaluating Performance of Quantification Methods

attributes.name: protocol_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) or protocol used for extraction, ensuring traceability to documented procedures.
attributes.references: ISO 15189 Laboratory Quality Management - Document Control

attributes.name: qc_failure_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the extraction failed QC criteria (e.g., low yield, poor purity ratios, degradation). Null if QC passed.
attributes.references: ISO 15189 Laboratory Quality Management - Nonconforming Event Management

attributes.name: qc_status
attributes.description: Quality control determination for the extraction: pass (meets all QC criteria), fail (does not meet QC criteria), pending (QC not yet complete), conditional_pass (marginal quality, proceed with caution).
attributes.references: ISO 15189 Laboratory Quality Management - Quality Control

attributes.name: quantification_method
attributes.description: Method used to quantify the extracted nucleic acid (e.g., NanoDrop spectrophotometry, Qubit fluorometry, Bioanalyzer, TapeStation, qPCR, PicoGreen).
attributes.references: ISO 20395 Biotechnology Requirements for Evaluating Performance of Quantification Methods

attributes.name: rin_score
attributes.description: RNA Integrity Number score (1-10 scale) indicating RNA quality and degradation level. Applicable only for RNA extractions. Higher scores indicate better integrity.
attributes.references: ISO 20166-3 Molecular In Vitro Diagnostic Examinations

attributes.name: run_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the batch or run in which this extraction was performed, linking multiple extractions processed together.

attributes.name: storage_temperature_c
attributes.description: Storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the extracted nucleic acid (e.g., -20°C for DNA, -80°C for RNA).
attributes.references: ISO 20166-1 Molecular In Vitro Diagnostic Examinations - Pre-examination Processes

products.name: run_sample
products.description: This association product represents the operational assignment of a biological specimen to a specific instrument sequencing run. In genomics operations, multiple specimens are routinely multiplexed into a single sequencing run (8-96+ specimens per run), and individual specimens may be re-sequenced across multiple runs for additional coverage, validation, or QC failure recovery. Each record captures the lane assignment, index sequences for demultiplexing, loading concentration, per-specimen read counts, quality metrics, and QC status for each specimen-run pairing. This is the core operational entity that enables multiplexed sequencing workflows and per-specimen quality tracking across the sequencing lifecycle.. Existence Justification: In genomics sequencing operations, specimens and instrument runs have a genuine many-to-many relationship. Multiple specimens (8-96+) are routinely multiplexed into a single sequencing run to maximize instrument utilization and reduce per-specimen cost. Individual specimens are frequently re-sequenced across multiple runs when initial runs fail QC, when additional coverage is needed, or for validation purposes. The business actively manages these specimen-run assignments as operational entities with specific lane assignments, index sequences, loading concentrations, and per-specimen quality metrics.
