attributes.description: Actual average sequencing coverage depth achieved for this specimen in this run, calculated from actual_reads_generated and reference genome size. Compared against target_coverage_depth to assess run success.

attributes.name: actual_reads_generated
attributes.description: Total number of sequencing reads (or read pairs for paired-end) generated for this specimen in this run, as determined by demultiplexing. Used to calculate actual coverage and assess run balance. Identified in detection phase as relationship data.

attributes.name: assigned_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this specimen was assigned to this run in the LIMS system. Captures when the multiplexing decision was made.

attributes.name: demultiplexed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when demultiplexing completed for this specimen, producing specimen-specific FASTQ files. Marks when per-specimen data became available.

attributes.name: duplicate_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of reads identified as PCR duplicates for this specimen. High duplicate rates indicate over-amplification during library prep or low library complexity.

attributes.name: fastq_file_path
attributes.description: File system path or cloud storage URI to the demultiplexed FASTQ files for this specimen from this run. Links sequencing data to downstream bioinformatics pipelines.

attributes.name: index_sequence
attributes.description: Unique index barcode sequence (or dual-index pair) assigned to this specimen for multiplexed sequencing. Used by demultiplexing software to separate reads by specimen. Format: single index (ACGTACGT) or dual index (ACGTACGT+TGCATGCA). Identified in detection phase as relationship data.

attributes.name: lane_number
attributes.description: Physical lane number on the flow cell where this specimen was loaded (1-8 for HiSeq/NovaSeq). Critical for demultiplexing and per-lane quality assessment. Identified in detection phase as relationship data.

attributes.name: loading_concentration_nm
attributes.description: Molar concentration (nanomolar, nM) of this specimen's library at the time of loading into the sequencing run. Influences cluster density and read balance across multiplexed specimens. Identified in detection phase as relationship data.

attributes.name: mean_insert_size
attributes.description: Average insert size (distance between paired-end reads) for this specimen's library in base pairs. Used to assess library preparation quality and detect size selection issues.

attributes.name: percent_aligned
attributes.description: Percentage of this specimen's reads that successfully aligned to the reference genome. Low alignment rates indicate contamination, adapter issues, or sample quality problems.

attributes.name: percent_q30
attributes.description: Percentage of bases with Phred quality score of 30 or higher (≥99.9% accuracy) for this specimen's reads in this run. Key quality metric for per-specimen QC assessment. Identified in detection phase as relationship data.

attributes.name: pool_position
attributes.description: Position or slot number of this specimen within the multiplexed pool loaded into the lane. Used for tracking specimen order during library pooling. Identified in detection phase as relationship data.

attributes.name: qc_reviewed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when QC review was completed and run_qc_status was assigned for this specimen-run pairing.

attributes.name: resequencing_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this specimen requires re-sequencing due to insufficient coverage, quality issues, or run failure. Drives downstream workflow decisions.

attributes.name: run_qc_status
attributes.description: Quality control status for this specimen in this run: pass (meets quality thresholds), fail (requires re-sequencing), warning (marginal quality), pending (QC not yet complete). Drives re-sequencing decisions. Identified in detection phase as relationship data.

attributes.name: target_coverage_depth
attributes.description: Planned average sequencing coverage depth (e.g., 30X for WGS, 100X for WES) for this specific specimen in this run. May differ from the run-level target if specimens have different coverage requirements. Identified in detection phase as relationship data.

attributes.description: Estimated sequencing error rate as a percentage, typically calculated from PhiX control spike-in. Lower values indicate higher accuracy.

attributes.description: Version number of the instrument control software or firmware used to execute the run, critical for reproducibility and troubleshooting.

attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this run was performed under Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) or In Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) regulatory requirements (True) or for Research Use Only (RUO) purposes (False).

attributes.name: is_paired_end
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the run used paired-end sequencing (True) or single-end sequencing (False). Applicable to NGS runs only.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this instrument run record was last updated, capturing status changes, QC updates, or data corrections.

attributes.name: mean_quality_score
attributes.description: Average Phred quality score across all bases in the run, indicating base-calling accuracy. Phred score of 30 corresponds to 99.9% accuracy.
attributes.references: NCBI Sequence Read Archive (SRA) Quality Standards

attributes.name: multiplexing_index_strategy
attributes.description: Indexing strategy used for sample multiplexing: single index (one barcode), dual index (two barcodes), unique dual index (UDI for collision avoidance), or none (single sample run).

attributes.name: number_of_samples
attributes.description: Total count of biological samples multiplexed and processed in this instrument run. For single-sample runs, value is 1.
attributes.references: ISO 15189 - Medical Laboratories Quality and Competence

attributes.name: output_data_location
attributes.description: File system path or cloud storage URI (e.g., Amazon Web Services (AWS) S3 bucket, BaseSpace project path) where raw output data (FASTQ, BAM, or array intensity files) is stored.
attributes.references: NCBI Sequence Read Archive (SRA) Submission Guidelines

attributes.name: output_file_format

attributes.references: NCBI Sequence Read Archive (SRA) Data Format Standards

attributes.name: percent_aligned_to_phix
attributes.description: Percentage of reads that aligned to the PhiX control genome, confirming the expected spike-in concentration (typically 1%).

attributes.name: percent_pf_clusters
attributes.description: Percentage of clusters passing Illumina chastity filter, indicating the proportion of high-quality clusters. Typical target is >80%.

attributes.name: percent_q30_bases
attributes.description: Percentage of bases with Phred quality score of 30 or higher (≥99.9% accuracy). Industry standard quality threshold for clinical and research sequencing.
attributes.references: NCBI Sequence Read Archive (SRA) Quality Standards

attributes.name: phix_error_rate
attributes.description: Error rate measured specifically from PhiX control library spike-in, used as internal quality control for sequencing accuracy.

attributes.name: qc_review_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the quality control review was completed and the run QC status was finalized.

attributes.name: qc_status
attributes.description: Overall quality control assessment of the run: passed (meets all quality thresholds), failed (does not meet minimum quality), warning (marginal quality requiring review), or not-evaluated (QC pending).
attributes.references: ISO 15189 - Medical Laboratories Quality and Competence

attributes.name: read_length
attributes.description: Length of sequencing reads in base pairs (bp) for NGS runs, e.g., 150 bp paired-end. Null for non-sequencing assays.

attributes.name: regulatory_classification

attributes.name: run_mode
attributes.description: Operational mode or workflow configuration selected for the run: standard (default protocol), rapid (accelerated turnaround), high-throughput (maximum sample capacity), low-throughput (small batch), or custom (user-defined parameters).

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the instrument run: queued (scheduled but not started), in-progress (actively running), completed (finished successfully), failed (terminated due to error), aborted (manually stopped by operator), or under-review (completed but awaiting quality control approval).

attributes.name: run_type
attributes.description: Type of genomic assay or experiment performed: Whole Genome Sequencing (WGS), Whole Exome Sequencing (WES), targeted sequencing panel, RNA sequencing, ChIP sequencing, array-based genotyping, gene expression array, quantitative Polymerase Chain Reaction (qPCR), droplet digital PCR (ddPCR), CRISPR screening, or library quality control. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WGS|WES|targeted_sequencing|RNA_seq|ChIP_seq|array_genotyping|array_expression|qPCR|ddPCR|CRISPR_screen|library_QC — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.description: Planned date and time when the run was scheduled to begin, as recorded in the instrument scheduling system or LIMS.

attributes.description: Planned average sequencing coverage depth (e.g., 30X for WGS, 100X for WES) as specified in the run protocol. Null for non-sequencing assays.
attributes.references: NCBI Sequence Read Archive (SRA) Metadata Standards

attributes.name: total_reads_generated
attributes.description: Total number of sequencing reads (or read pairs for paired-end) generated by the run. Null for non-sequencing assays.
attributes.references: NCBI Sequence Read Archive (SRA) Metadata Standards

attributes.name: total_yield_gb
attributes.description: Total sequencing yield in gigabases (Gb) produced by the run, calculated as total reads multiplied by read length. Null for non-sequencing assays.

attributes.description: Date when the customer and service provider executed the service contract agreement. Used for contract age analysis and renewal forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP SD Service Contract Document Date

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the service contract: draft (not yet active), active (coverage in force), suspended (temporarily paused), expired (end date passed), cancelled (terminated early), renewed (replaced by successor contract).

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the service entitlement: manufacturer standard warranty (included with purchase), extended warranty, comprehensive service contract (parts, labor, PM), parts-only coverage, time-and-materials agreement, or preventive maintenance only.

attributes.name: coverage_scope
attributes.description: Defines which subsystems and components of the instrument are covered: full system, optics module only, fluidics subsystem, electronics, software updates, or exclusions such as consumables.

attributes.name: coverage_territory
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where this service contract is valid. Instruments moved outside this territory may void coverage. Critical for field service dispatch and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this service contract record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: Fixed amount the customer must pay per service incident before contract coverage applies. Common in lower-tier contracts. Null if no deductible.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when the service contract coverage expires. Nullable for perpetual or lifetime warranties. Triggers renewal workflow 90 days prior.
attributes.references: SAP SD Service Contract Validity Period

attributes.name: included_pm_visits
attributes.description: Number of on-site preventive maintenance visits included in the contract term at no additional charge. Typically 1-4 per year depending on instrument type and SLA tier.

attributes.name: labor_coverage_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether field service engineer labor (on-site and remote) is included at no additional charge. True for comprehensive and labor-only contracts, false for parts-only.
attributes.references: SAP SD Service Contract Item Categories

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this service contract record. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: loaner_instrument_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether a temporary replacement instrument is provided during extended repairs (typically >5 business days downtime). Available only in platinum and gold tiers.

attributes.name: max_claims_per_year
attributes.description: Maximum number of service incidents that can be claimed under this contract within a 12-month period. Null for unlimited. Exceeding this cap triggers time-and-materials billing.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional contract details, special terms, customer-specific accommodations, or operational notes for field service engineers. Not visible to customer.
attributes.references: SAP SD Service Contract Header Text

attributes.name: parts_coverage_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether replacement parts (optics, sensors, pumps, valves, circuit boards) are included at no additional charge. True for comprehensive and parts-only contracts, false for labor-only or time-and-materials.
attributes.references: SAP SD Service Contract Item Categories

attributes.name: pm_visit_frequency_months
attributes.business_glossary_term: Preventive Maintenance (PM) Visit Frequency in Months
attributes.description: Scheduled interval in months between preventive maintenance visits (e.g., 3 for quarterly, 6 for semi-annual, 12 for annual). Drives field service scheduling.

attributes.name: priority_parts_shipping
attributes.description: Indicates whether replacement parts are shipped via expedited carrier (overnight or same-day) at no additional charge. Standard for platinum/gold, optional upgrade for silver/bronze.

attributes.name: remote_support_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether 24/7 remote diagnostics, troubleshooting, and software support via secure VPN connection are included. Standard for all tiers except bronze.

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days before contract end date when renewal notification is sent to the customer. Typically 90, 60, or 30 days depending on contract value and complexity.

attributes.name: renewal_terms
attributes.description: Defines how the contract renews at expiration: automatic renewal unless cancelled, manual renewal requiring customer action, non-renewable (one-time coverage), opt-in (customer must confirm), opt-out (customer must cancel).
attributes.references: SAP SD Service Contract Renewal Logic

attributes.name: response_time_hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours from service request submission to field service engineer dispatch or remote support initiation, as committed in the SLA tier.

attributes.name: service_provider
attributes.description: Entity responsible for delivering service under this contract: manufacturer (Genomics Biotech), authorized service partner, third-party maintenance organization, or customer self-service with remote support.

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: Service level tier defining response time commitments, uptime guarantees, and priority: platinum (4-hour response, 99.5% uptime), gold (8-hour, 98%), silver (next business day, 95%), bronze (48-hour), standard (best effort).

attributes.name: software_updates_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether instrument control software, firmware, and bioinformatics pipeline updates are included. Critical for maintaining regulatory compliance (FDA 21 CFR Part 11, IVDR) and performance optimization.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when the service contract coverage becomes effective. For manufacturer warranties, typically the instrument installation qualification (IQ) completion date.
attributes.references: SAP SD Service Contract Validity Period

attributes.name: travel_expenses_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether field service engineer travel costs (airfare, mileage, lodging, meals) are included in the contract or billed separately. Typically true for platinum/gold tiers, false for bronze/standard.

attributes.name: uptime_guarantee_percent
attributes.description: Contractually guaranteed instrument availability percentage over the measurement period (typically monthly or quarterly). Failure to meet this may trigger service credits.

domains.name: reagent
domains.description: Governs the lifecycle of reagents, consumables, and biochemical inputs — including library preparation kits, flow cells, CRISPR reagents, PCR/qPCR master mixes, enzymes, buffers, and array hybridization chips. Owns LOT traceability, COA records, SDS documentation, expiry management, storage requirements, usage tracking, and GMP-compliant release status.
domains.references: GxP, GMP, ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR Part 820

products.name: catalog
products.description: Master catalog of all reagents, consumables, and biochemical inputs managed by Genomics Biotech — including library preparation kits, flow cells, CRISPR reagents, PCR/qPCR master mixes, enzymes, buffers, and array hybridization chips. Captures product identity, reagent type classification (enzyme, buffer, kit, flow cell, CRISPR component, consumable), category hierarchy, classification (RUO vs IVD), intended application (NGS, WGS, WES, CRISPR, qPCR, array), storage requirements (temperature range, humidity limits, light sensitivity, freeze-thaw limits, special handling), hazard classification, regulatory status, and lifecycle stage. This is the SSOT for reagent product definitions and their storage condition profiles.

attributes.name: concentration

attributes.name: freeze_thaw_cycle_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of freeze-thaw cycles the reagent can withstand before degradation. Critical for maintaining reagent performance and ensuring reproducible results.

attributes.name: intended_application

attributes.name: introduction_date
attributes.description: Date when the reagent product was first introduced to the catalog and made available for sale. Used for product lifecycle tracking and portfolio management.

attributes.name: quality_control_tested_flag

attributes.references: ISO 13485, GMP Guidelines, CAP Laboratory Accreditation

attributes.name: reagent_category
attributes.description: Secondary hierarchical category classification for the reagent. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: library_prep|sequencing|pcr_qpcr|gene_editing|array_hybridization|sample_prep|quality_control|storage_transport — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reagent_type
attributes.description: Primary classification of the reagent product type. Categorizes reagents into major functional groups for inventory and usage tracking.

attributes.name: shelf_life_months

attributes.references: ISO 13485, GMP Guidelines, ICH Q1A Stability Testing

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any special handling, storage, or safety requirements not covered by standard storage parameters. May include instructions for reconstitution, mixing, or hazardous material handling.
attributes.references: ISO 13485, GMP Guidelines, OSHA Hazard Communication Standard

attributes.name: sterility_requirement
attributes.description: Sterility classification of the reagent. Sterile indicates validated sterile manufacturing; non_sterile indicates no sterility requirement; aseptic indicates aseptic processing without terminal sterilization.

attributes.name: storage_humidity_max_percent
attributes.description: Maximum relative humidity requirement for storage as a percentage. Prevents moisture-related degradation of reagent components.
attributes.references: ISO 13485, GMP Guidelines, ICH Q1A Stability Testing

attributes.name: storage_humidity_min_percent
attributes.description: Minimum relative humidity requirement for storage as a percentage. Ensures reagent stability in controlled environmental conditions.
attributes.references: ISO 13485, GMP Guidelines, ICH Q1A Stability Testing

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum storage temperature requirement in degrees Celsius. Exceeding this threshold may compromise reagent integrity and invalidate quality assurance.

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum storage temperature requirement in degrees Celsius. Critical for maintaining reagent stability and ensuring GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 13485, GMP Guidelines, ICH Q1A Stability Testing

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for the reagent quantity. Used for inventory management, ordering, and usage tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ml|l|mg|g|kg|units|reactions|tests|each — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: lot
products.description: GMP-compliant lot (batch) master record for every manufactured or received reagent lot. Captures lot number, manufacturing date, expiry date, quantity produced, GMP release status, quarantine flags, retest date, originating work order or supplier shipment, supplier lot number, supplier COA reference, country of origin, and supplier quality grade. Includes immutable status audit trail recording all lifecycle transitions (quarantine → QC testing → released → restricted → disposed) with triggering event, operator ID, timestamp, and supporting document reference. SSOT for lot traceability across the reagent lifecycle. Supports FDA 21 CFR Part 211, ISO 13485, and GxP requirements.

attributes.name: retest_date

attributes.name: sds_reference

attributes.name: sterilization_date

attributes.name: sterilization_method

attributes.name: temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum temperature in degrees Celsius recorded during the inventory transaction or transfer. Used for cold chain monitoring and temperature-sensitive reagent quality assurance.

attributes.name: total_transaction_value
attributes.description: Total financial value of the inventory transaction calculated as quantity multiplied by unit cost. Used for financial reporting, inventory valuation, and cost accounting.

attributes.name: transaction_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments providing additional context about the inventory transaction, such as special handling instructions, deviation explanations, or operational observations.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique transaction number or document number assigned to this inventory movement event. Used for traceability and audit purposes.

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the inventory transaction was executed in the operational system. Represents the actual business event time of the inventory movement.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inventory movement type. Goods receipt represents incoming stock from suppliers or manufacturing. Goods issue represents outbound movements. Transfer posting represents internal location changes. Consumption represents usage in experiments or production. Adjustment represents inventory corrections. attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit in which the transaction quantity is expressed, such as milliliters (mL), grams (g), units (EA), kits (KIT), or flow cells (FC). Must align with the reagent catalog base unit or approved alternate units.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that created this inventory transaction record. Audit field for accountability and compliance.

domains.name: bioinformatics
domains.description: Owns the computational pipeline ecosystem for genomic data processing — alignment (BAM), variant calling (VCF), annotation pipelines, CNV/SNP analysis, MAF calculations, and HPC/cloud (AWS) job orchestration. Manages pipeline versions, algorithm parameters, run parameters, compute resource consumption, reference genome linkages, and data lineage from raw FASTQ to interpreted genomic results.

Captures pipeline name, version, algorithm parameters, supported assay types (WGS, WES, targeted), reference genome compatibility, GxP validation status, and pipeline owner. This is the authoritative catalog of all pipeline definitions.

attributes.name: algorithm_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary algorithm or tool used by the pipeline (e.g., 'BWA-MEM', 'STAR', 'GATK HaplotypeCaller', 'DeepVariant', 'VEP', 'ANNOVAR'). Identifies the computational engine for reproducibility and regulatory documentation.

attributes.name: algorithm_parameters
attributes.description: JSON-serialized string of key algorithm configuration parameters used by the pipeline (e.g., GATK HaplotypeCaller ploidy, BWA-MEM seed length, DeepVariant model type). attributes.name: algorithm_version

attributes.references: GxP 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Guidance on Software as a Medical Device (SaMD); ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: annotation_database
attributes.description: Name and version of the variant annotation database(s) used by the pipeline (e.g., 'ClinVar 2024-01', 'gnomAD v3.1.2', 'dbSNP 156', 'COSMIC v97'). Determines the clinical and population-level context applied to called variants.
attributes.references: ClinVar (NCBI); gnomAD; dbSNP (NCBI); COSMIC; FDA Guidance on NGS-Based IVDs

attributes.name: assay_type
attributes.description: Supported sequencing assay type(s) for which this pipeline is designed (e.g., WGS — Whole Genome Sequencing, WES — Whole Exome Sequencing, targeted panel, amplicon, RNA-seq). Determines pipeline applicability to incoming sample runs.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CAP Accreditation Standards; ISO 15189

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Documented reason for the creation of this pipeline version (e.g., 'Updated reference genome to GRCh38', 'Algorithm parameter tuning for improved sensitivity', 'Bug fix in CNV caller'). Required for GxP change control and audit trail.
attributes.references: GxP 21 CFR Part 11 — Audit Trail; ICH Q10; ISO 13485 Section 8.5 — Corrective Action

attributes.name: cnv_detection_supported
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pipeline includes Copy Number Variation (CNV) detection capability. CNV analysis identifies genomic regions with abnormal copy numbers, relevant for oncology and rare disease diagnostics.
attributes.references: CAP Molecular Pathology Checklist; FDA Guidance on NGS-Based IVDs; IVDR 2017/746

attributes.name: container_image
attributes.description: Docker or Singularity container image reference (repository:tag) used to package and execute the pipeline (e.g., 'genomics-biotech/bwa-pipeline:1.0.0'). Ensures reproducibility and environment consistency across HPC and cloud runs.
attributes.references: GxP 21 CFR Part 11 — Software Validation; ISO 13485 Section 7.3

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pipeline record was first created in the master registry. Supports audit trail requirements under GxP 21 CFR Part 11 and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: GxP 21 CFR Part 11 — Audit Trail; ISO 13485 Section 4.2; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this pipeline version is approved and available for production use. Pipelines should not be used in production runs before this date. Supports GxP change control and regulatory traceability.
attributes.references: GxP 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 13485 Section 4.2; Veeva Vault — Document Lifecycle

attributes.name: estimated_runtime_hours
attributes.description: Estimated wall-clock runtime in hours for a standard pipeline execution on a typical input dataset. Used for TAT (Turnaround Time) planning, SLA commitments, and HPC/cloud job scheduling.
attributes.references: SLA Management; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run Metrics

attributes.name: execution_environment
attributes.description: Compute environment where the pipeline is designed to execute (HPC — High-Performance Computing cluster, AWS cloud, on-premise servers, hybrid, or Databricks). Drives infrastructure provisioning and cost allocation.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 — Cloud Security; AWS Well-Architected Framework

attributes.name: gxp_validation_status
attributes.description: GxP validation status of the pipeline indicating whether it has been formally validated for use in regulated (GMP/GLP/GCP) environments. Pipelines used in IVD or clinical assay workflows must be validated per FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and ISO 13485 requirements.
attributes.references: GxP 21 CFR Part 11; FDA 21 CFR Part 820; ISO 13485 Section 7.6; IVDR 2017/746

attributes.name: input_data_format
attributes.description: Primary input file format accepted by the pipeline (e.g., FASTQ for raw sequencing reads, BAM — Binary Alignment Map for aligned reads, CRAM, VCF — Variant Call Format). Defines upstream data dependencies and ingestion requirements.
attributes.references: SAM/BAM Format Specification (hts-specs); FASTQ Format Standard; GA4GH

attributes.name: intended_use
attributes.description: Regulatory intended use classification of the pipeline: RUO (Research Use Only), IVD (In Vitro Diagnostic), LDT (Laboratory Developed Test), research, clinical, or manufacturing QC. Determines applicable regulatory framework and validation requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 809 (IVD); IVDR 2017/746; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CAP Accreditation

attributes.name: is_parallelizable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pipeline supports parallel execution across multiple compute nodes or shards (e.g., scatter-gather parallelism in WDL). Parallelizable pipelines can be scaled horizontally on HPC or AWS for reduced TAT.
attributes.references: AWS Well-Architected Framework; HPC Parallel Computing Standards

attributes.name: maf_threshold
attributes.description: Minor Allele Frequency (MAF) threshold used by the pipeline to filter common variants from rare variant analysis. Variants with MAF above this threshold may be excluded from clinical reporting. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.01 = 1%).
attributes.references: gnomAD Population Database; ClinVar; FDA Guidance on NGS-Based IVDs

attributes.name: max_cpu_cores
attributes.description: Maximum number of CPU cores allocated per pipeline execution job. Used for HPC/AWS resource planning, cost estimation, and job scheduling configuration.
attributes.references: AWS Well-Architected Framework; HPC Resource Management Standards

attributes.name: max_memory_gb
attributes.description: Maximum RAM memory in gigabytes (GB) required per pipeline execution job. Critical for HPC cluster and AWS instance type selection and cost management.
attributes.references: AWS Well-Architected Framework; HPC Resource Management Standards

attributes.name: min_coverage_depth
attributes.description: Minimum sequencing coverage depth (read depth, expressed as integer fold-coverage, e.g., 30x) required for the pipeline to produce reliable results. Used in QC gating and assay validation documentation.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CAP NGS Checklist; ISO 15189; FDA Guidance on NGS-Based IVDs

attributes.name: min_phred_score
attributes.description: Minimum Phred quality score threshold applied during pipeline execution for base quality filtering. Phred scores represent the probability of an incorrect base call; higher values indicate higher quality. Typical threshold is Q20 or Q30.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; CAP NGS Checklist; FDA Guidance on NGS-Based IVDs

attributes.name: min_read_length
attributes.description: Minimum sequencing read length in base pairs (bp) required for this pipeline to function correctly. Ensures compatibility with sequencing instrument output and library preparation protocols.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run Parameters; CAP NGS Checklist

attributes.name: multiplexing_supported
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pipeline supports multiplexed sample processing (multiple samples pooled on a single flow cell and demultiplexed during processing). True if multiplexing/demultiplexing is handled within the pipeline.

attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this pipeline version record. Required for change control auditing and data lineage tracking in GxP-regulated environments. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GxP 21 CFR Part 11 — Audit Trail; ISO 13485 Section 4.2.4

attributes.name: lod_sensitivity
attributes.description: Analytical Limit of Detection (LOD) expressed as the minimum variant allele fraction detectable by this pipeline version at a defined confidence level. A key analytical performance characteristic for clinical and IVD-validated pipelines, reported in regulatory submissions and validation documentation.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Analytical Validation of NGS-Based IVDs; CLSI EP17-A2 — LOD Estimation; CAP NGS Checklist

attributes.name: maf_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum Minor Allele Frequency (MAF) cutoff applied during variant filtering in this pipeline version. Variants with MAF below this threshold may be classified as rare or filtered depending on pipeline configuration. Critical parameter for population genetics and clinical variant interpretation.
attributes.references: gnomAD Population Database; ACMG/AMP Variant Classification Guidelines; CAP NGS Checklist

attributes.name: min_coverage_depth
attributes.description: Minimum sequencing coverage depth (read depth, expressed as integer fold-coverage, e.g., 30x) required for this pipeline version to produce a valid result. Values below this threshold trigger QC failure flags in pipeline runs. A key quality parameter for WGS and WES assays.
attributes.references: GATK Best Practices — Coverage Requirements; ISO 15189 Section 5.5; CAP NGS Checklist

attributes.name: min_cpu_cores
attributes.description: Minimum number of CPU cores required to execute this pipeline version. Used for compute resource planning, job scheduling, and cost estimation on HPC/AWS infrastructure.
attributes.references: AWS Batch Compute Environment Specifications; Genomics Biotech HPC Resource Standards

attributes.name: min_memory_gb
attributes.description: Minimum RAM in gigabytes required to execute this pipeline version. Critical for HPC/AWS job scheduling, instance type selection, and preventing out-of-memory failures during large WGS runs.
attributes.references: AWS Batch Compute Environment Specifications; Genomics Biotech HPC Resource Standards

attributes.name: min_phred_score
attributes.description: Minimum Phred quality score threshold applied during base quality filtering in this pipeline version. Phred scores represent the probability of an incorrect base call (Q20 = 1% error rate, Q30 = 0.1% error rate). Directly impacts variant calling sensitivity and specificity.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace — Quality Metrics; GATK Best Practices; CAP NGS Checklist NGS.09

attributes.name: output_format
attributes.description: Primary file format produced as the final output of this pipeline version. VCF = Variant Call Format; BAM = Binary Alignment Map; FASTQ = raw sequence data; CRAM = compressed BAM; GVCF = Genomic VCF for joint genotyping. Determines downstream compatibility with analysis tools and data consumers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: VCF|BAM|FASTQ|CRAM|BED|TSV|GVCF — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAMtools/HTSlib Format Specifications; GA4GH File Format Standards; Illumina BaseSpace

attributes.name: owning_team
attributes.description: Name of the bioinformatics or R&D team responsible for developing and maintaining this pipeline version (e.g., 'Clinical Bioinformatics', 'Research Genomics', 'Array Analysis'). Used for organizational accountability, resource planning, and support routing.
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud HCM — Organizational Structure; ISO 13485 Section 5.5

attributes.name: pipeline_category
attributes.description: Functional classification of the pipeline by its primary computational purpose. Drives routing logic, validation requirements, and reporting groupings. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: alignment|variant_calling|annotation|cnv_analysis|maf_calculation|array_processing|demultiplexing|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Genomics Biotech Bioinformatics Domain Taxonomy; ISO 15189 Section 5.5

attributes.name: pipeline_owner
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the bioinformatics scientist or team lead who is the designated owner and accountable party for this pipeline version. Responsible for validation, change control, and scientific integrity of the pipeline.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 5.5 — Responsibility and Authority; GxP Organizational Accountability

attributes.name: pipeline_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this specific pipeline version. 'draft' = under development; 'active' = approved and in production use; 'deprecated' = superseded by a newer version but still permitted for legacy runs; 'retired' = no longer permitted for new pipeline runs; 'under_review' = undergoing validation or change control review.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control — Lifecycle States; GxP 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 13485 Section 4.2.3

attributes.name: reference_genome_build
attributes.description: Primary reference genome assembly version this pipeline version is configured to align against (e.g., GRCh38, T2T-CHM13). Critical for reproducibility, variant calling accuracy, and cross-study comparability. Determines coordinate system for BAM/VCF outputs.
attributes.references: NCBI Reference Sequence Database (RefSeq); NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; GATK Best Practices

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_ids
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of regulatory submission identifiers (FDA 510(k), PMA, De Novo, EMA IVDR submission numbers) in which this pipeline version is referenced or cited (e.g., 'K240001,DEN230045'). Enables traceability between pipeline versions and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 807 — 510(k) Submissions; IVDR EU 2017/746; EMA Submission Guidelines

attributes.name: semantic_version
attributes.description: Semantic versioning string (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH) for this pipeline release, following SemVer 2.0 conventions (e.g., '3.2.1'). MAJOR increments indicate breaking algorithm changes; MINOR indicate new features; PATCH indicate bug fixes. Enables reproducibility tracking from FASTQ to final genomic output.
attributes.references: SemVer 2.0.0 (semver.org); GxP 21 CFR Part 11 — Software Version Control

attributes.name: source_repository_url
attributes.description: URL of the version-controlled source code repository (e.g., GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket) for this pipeline version, including the specific branch or tag reference (e.g., 'https://github.com/genomicsbiotech/pipelines/tree/v3.2.1'). Enables full code reproducibility and supports IP management.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 — Source Code Management; GxP 21 CFR Part 11; Genomics Biotech IP Policy

attributes.name: supported_assay_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of genomic assay types this pipeline version is designed and validated to process (e.g., 'WGS,WES,targeted_panel'). Assay types include WGS (Whole Genome Sequencing), WES (Whole Exome Sequencing), targeted panel, array-based, amplicon, RNA-Seq, single-cell. Drives compatibility checks at pipeline run initiation.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Assay Compatibility Matrix; ISO 15189 Section 5.5

attributes.name: use_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory use classification governing how this pipeline version may be deployed. RUO = Research Use Only; IVD = In Vitro Diagnostic (FDA-cleared/approved); LDT = Laboratory Developed Test; CE-IVD = Conformité Européenne In Vitro Diagnostic (EU market). Determines permissible clinical and commercial applications.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 809 — IVD Labeling; IVDR EU 2017/746; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493

attributes.name: validation_date
attributes.description: Date on which formal validation of this pipeline version was completed and documented. Required for IVD, LDT, and GxP-controlled pipelines. Supports regulatory submission timelines and audit readiness.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820 — Design Validation; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CAP Accreditation; ISO 13485 Section 7.3.6

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Regulatory validation classification of this pipeline version. 'unvalidated' = no formal validation performed; 'ruo_validated' = validated for Research Use Only (RUO) applications; 'ivd_validated' = validated as an In Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) per FDA/IVDR requirements; 'clinical_validated' = validated for clinical reporting under CLIA/CAP standards.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820 — Software Validation; IVDR EU 2017/746; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CAP Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: variant_caller_tool
attributes.description: Name and version of the primary variant calling algorithm/tool used in this pipeline version (e.g., 'GATK HaplotypeCaller 4.4.0', 'DeepVariant 1.5', 'Strelka2 2.9.10'). Directly determines the VCF output format and variant calling characteristics. Essential for reproducibility and regulatory documentation.
attributes.references: GATK Best Practices; FDA Guidance on NGS-Based IVDs; ISO 15189 Section 5.5

Central operational log for all pipeline executions supporting SLA tracking, failure triage, batch-level monitoring, cost attribution, and cohort-level result delivery.

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the pipeline run reached a terminal state (completed, failed, or cancelled). Used to calculate wall-clock duration, TAT (Turnaround Time), and SLA compliance reporting.

attributes.name: compute_environment

attributes.name: cpu_core_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Central Processing Unit (CPU) Core Hours Consumed
attributes.description: Total CPU core-hours consumed by this pipeline run across all compute nodes. Primary metric for cloud/HPC cost attribution, capacity planning, and per-sample computational cost reporting.
attributes.references: AWS Cost Explorer Compute Metrics; HPC Job Accounting Standards; Genomics Biotech Cost Attribution Policy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this pipeline_run record was first created in the data platform. Serves as the audit record creation timestamp for GxP electronic record compliance and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: GxP 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; ISO 13485 Section 4.2.4; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity

attributes.name: error_category
attributes.description: Standardized classification of the failure type when a pipeline run does not complete successfully. Enables systematic failure triage, root cause analysis, and trend reporting on pipeline reliability.
attributes.references: ServiceNow Incident Classification; ISO 13485 Section 8.3 Nonconforming Output; Genomics Biotech Bioinformatics SOP

attributes.name: error_message_summary
attributes.description: Truncated human-readable summary of the error message or exception captured at pipeline failure. Supports first-level failure triage without requiring access to full log files. Maximum 2000 characters.
attributes.references: ServiceNow Incident Management; Genomics Biotech Bioinformatics Failure Triage SOP

attributes.name: estimated_compute_cost_usd
attributes.description: Estimated monetary cost in US Dollars for the compute resources consumed by this pipeline run, derived from CPU core-hours, memory, and storage metrics against cloud/HPC pricing. Used for per-sample cost attribution, project budget tracking, and COGS reporting.
attributes.references: AWS Cost Explorer; Genomics Biotech Finance Cost Attribution Policy; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: exit_code
attributes.description: Numeric exit code returned by the pipeline process upon termination. Exit code 0 indicates successful completion; non-zero codes indicate specific failure modes. Used for automated failure classification and triage routing.
attributes.references: POSIX Exit Code Standard; Nextflow/Snakemake Pipeline Exit Code Convention

attributes.name: input_fastq_path
attributes.business_glossary_term: Input FASTQ (Fast All Quality) File Path
attributes.description: Cloud or HPC storage path to the input FASTQ file(s) consumed by this pipeline run. FASTQ is the raw sequencing data format produced by NGS instruments. Required for data lineage tracking, reprocessing, and audit trail from raw data to result.
attributes.references: NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.312 Data Integrity; ISO 27001 Information Asset Management

attributes.name: mean_coverage_depth
attributes.description: Average number of sequencing reads aligned to each base position in the target region or genome. A key QC metric indicating sequencing depth adequacy. Minimum thresholds vary by assay type (e.g., 30x for WGS, 100x for targeted panels).
attributes.references: CAP NGS Checklist; FDA Guidance on NGS-Based IVD Tests; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; ISO 15189

attributes.name: output_bam_path
attributes.business_glossary_term: Output BAM (Binary Alignment Map) File Path
attributes.description: Cloud or HPC storage path to the output BAM (Binary Alignment Map) file produced by alignment pipeline runs. BAM is the standard compressed binary format for aligned sequencing reads. Used for downstream variant calling and data lineage.
attributes.references: SAM/BAM Format Specification (hts-specs); NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.312

attributes.name: output_report_path
attributes.description: Cloud or HPC storage path to the final analytical report or summary output artifact (e.g., QC report, annotation summary, CNV report) generated by this pipeline run. Used for result delivery to downstream consumers and regulatory documentation.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Document Management; ISO 13485 Section 4.2.4 Document Control; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493

attributes.name: output_vcf_path
attributes.business_glossary_term: Output VCF (Variant Call Format) File Path
attributes.description: Cloud or HPC storage path to the output VCF (Variant Call Format) file produced by variant calling pipeline runs. VCF is the standard format for representing SNPs, indels, and structural variants. Central artifact for clinical and research genomic interpretation.
attributes.references: VCF Format Specification v4.3 (hts-specs); FDA Guidance on NGS-Based IVD Tests; IVDR EU 2017/746

attributes.name: peak_memory_gb
attributes.description: Maximum RAM (in gigabytes) consumed at any point during this pipeline run. Used for resource right-sizing, out-of-memory failure diagnosis, and HPC/cloud instance type optimization.
attributes.references: AWS EC2 Instance Sizing Guidelines; HPC Resource Management Best Practices

attributes.name: percent_bases_above_q30
attributes.business_glossary_term: Percentage of Bases Above Phred Score Q30
attributes.description: Percentage of sequencing bases with a Phred quality score of 30 or higher, indicating 99.9% base call accuracy. A primary sequencing QC metric used to assess run quality before downstream analysis. Industry standard threshold is ≥80%.
attributes.references: Illumina Sequencing Quality Metrics; CAP NGS Checklist; FDA Guidance on NGS-Based IVD Tests; Phred Score Standard

attributes.name: percent_reads_mapped
attributes.description: Percentage of total sequencing reads that successfully aligned to the reference genome. A key alignment QC metric; low mapping rates indicate sample quality issues, contamination, or reference genome mismatch.
attributes.references: SAMtools Alignment Statistics; CAP NGS Checklist; ISO 15189 Section 5.5

attributes.name: pipeline_type
attributes.description: Classification of the bioinformatics pipeline category executed in this run. Drives downstream routing, result schema expectations, and domain-specific SLA thresholds. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: alignment|variant_calling|annotation|cnv_analysis|snp_genotyping|methylation|rna_seq|gene_editing_qc — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Genomics England Bioinformatics Pipeline Classification; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: qc_failure_reason
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the specific QC metric(s) that caused this pipeline run to fail QC assessment (e.g., 'Mean coverage depth 18x below 30x threshold', 'Mapping rate 62% below 80% threshold'). Populated only when qc_pass_flag is False.
attributes.references: CAP NGS Checklist; ISO 13485 Section 8.3 Nonconforming Output; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493

attributes.name: qc_pass_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this pipeline run passed all defined QC thresholds (coverage depth, mapping rate, Phred score, variant count sanity checks). Drives automated downstream routing — only QC-passed runs proceed to clinical or research reporting.
attributes.references: CAP NGS Checklist; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; ISO 13485 Section 8.2.4; FDA Guidance on NGS-Based IVD Tests

attributes.name: regulatory_use_classification

IVD (In Vitro Diagnostic) runs are subject to FDA/IVDR validation requirements; RUO (Research Use Only) runs have different compliance obligations. Drives audit trail depth and result release controls.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820 IVD Regulations; IVDR EU 2017/746; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; ISO 13485

attributes.name: reprocessing_flag

attributes.name: run_accession_number

attributes.name: run_status

attributes.name: sequencing_assay_type
