attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.validation_study. Business justification: Alignment results generated during pipeline validation studies must be linked to the quality.validation_study for traceability. Regulatory submissions require demonstrating which alignment results sup

attributes.name: aligner_tool
attributes.description: Name of the alignment software tool used to produce this result (e.g., BWA-MEM, BWA-MEM2, DRAGEN, STAR, Bowtie2, minimap2). The choice of aligner affects sensitivity, specificity, and computational cost. Required for reproducibility and regulatory method validation documentation.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; Bioinformatics Pipeline Validation Guidelines

attributes.name: aligner_version
attributes.description: Semantic version string of the aligner tool used (e.g., 0.7.17, 2.2.1). Version tracking is mandatory for bioinformatics method validation, regulatory submissions (FDA, EMA), and reproducibility of clinical genomic results. A version change may require re-validation under ISO 15189 and CLIA.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 15189; ICH E6 GCP; GxP Software Validation

attributes.name: alignment_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the alignment job completed and the BAM/CRAM output file was finalized. Represents the principal real-world business event time for this record. Used for Turnaround Time (TAT) calculations, SLA monitoring, and pipeline performance analytics. Satisfies BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CLIA TAT Requirements; GxP ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: chimeric_read_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of reads flagged as chimeric (reads where the two ends map to different chromosomes or distant genomic locations). Elevated chimeric rates indicate library preparation artifacts, structural variant signals, or sequencing errors. Monitored as a QC metric in clinical WGS and structural variant detection workflows.
attributes.references: STAR Aligner Documentation; Picard CollectAlignmentSummaryMetrics; ACMG/AMP Sequencing QC Guidelines

attributes.name: compute_platform
attributes.description: Compute infrastructure platform on which the alignment job was executed: AWS (Amazon Web Services), on-premise High-Performance Computing (HPC) cluster, Azure, GCP, or Illumina DRAGEN server. Required for cost allocation, performance benchmarking, and infrastructure capacity planning.
attributes.references: AWS Well-Architected Framework; ISO 27001; GxP Cloud Computing Guidelines (EMA/ISPE)

attributes.name: compute_runtime_seconds
attributes.description: Wall-clock time in seconds taken to complete the alignment job from job start to job completion. Used for pipeline performance monitoring, SLA compliance tracking, HPC/cloud resource optimization, and cost modeling. Enables identification of performance regressions across aligner versions or reference genome builds.
attributes.references: AWS Cost Management; HPC Job Scheduler Logs; GxP Computerized Systems Validation

attributes.name: coverage_uniformity_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of target bases covered at ≥20% of the mean coverage depth, measuring the uniformity of sequencing coverage across the target region. High uniformity indicates consistent library preparation and sequencing performance. Low uniformity may indicate GC bias or capture inefficiency in WES/panel assays.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub QC Metrics; ACMG/AMP Sequencing QC Guidelines

attributes.name: cpu_cores_used
attributes.description: Number of CPU cores allocated and used for the alignment job. Together with compute_runtime_seconds and memory_used_gb, enables accurate cloud compute cost attribution per alignment result and supports capacity planning for HPC/AWS infrastructure.
attributes.references: AWS Cost Management; HPC Resource Management Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this alignment result record was first ingested into the Silver Layer data lakehouse. Distinct from alignment_timestamp (job completion time). Used for data lineage, audit trails, and ETL monitoring. Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.
attributes.references: GxP ALCOA+ Principles; ISO 27001; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: duplicate_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of mapped reads flagged as PCR or optical duplicates (duplicate_reads / mapped_reads × 100). High duplicate rates reduce effective coverage depth and can introduce variant calling bias. Typically assessed using Picard MarkDuplicates or equivalent. Threshold violations trigger QC warning or failure.
attributes.references: Picard Tools Documentation; ACMG/AMP Sequencing QC Guidelines; ISO 15189

attributes.name: gc_content_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of guanine (G) and cytosine (C) bases in the aligned reads. GC content deviating significantly from the expected genomic average (~41% for human) indicates GC bias in library preparation or PCR amplification, which can cause uneven coverage and affect Copy Number Variation (CNV) analysis accuracy.
attributes.references: FastQC Quality Control Tool; ACMG/AMP Sequencing QC Guidelines; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: insert_size_std_dev_bp
attributes.description: Standard deviation of the insert size distribution in base pairs. A narrow distribution indicates consistent library preparation; a wide distribution may indicate mixed fragment populations or library quality issues. Used alongside median_insert_size_bp for comprehensive library QC assessment.
attributes.references: Picard CollectInsertSizeMetrics; Illumina Library Preparation QC Standards

attributes.name: intended_use
attributes.description: Regulatory intended use classification for this alignment result: Research Use Only (RUO), In Vitro Diagnostic (IVD), Laboratory Developed Test (LDT), clinical research, agricultural genomics, or companion diagnostic. Determines applicable regulatory framework (FDA, IVDR, CLIA) and data handling requirements including PHI/HIPAA obligations.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820; EU IVDR 2017/746; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; HIPAA 45 CFR Parts 160 and 164

attributes.name: is_reanalysis
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this alignment result is a reanalysis of a previously aligned sample (True) or an original first-pass alignment (False). Reanalyses may be triggered by reference genome updates, aligner version upgrades, QC failures, or clinical reinterpretation requests. Supports data lineage and version management.
attributes.references: GxP Data Integrity Guidelines; ISO 15189; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493

attributes.name: mapped_reads
attributes.description: Number of sequencing reads that successfully mapped to the reference genome. Together with total_reads, this is used to compute the mapping rate. Low mapped read counts may indicate sample contamination, library preparation failure, or reference genome mismatch.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub QC Metrics; SAMtools Flagstat Specification

attributes.name: mapping_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of total reads that successfully mapped to the reference genome (mapped_reads / total_reads × 100). A primary alignment QC metric; typical acceptable thresholds are ≥90% for human WGS. Values below threshold trigger QC failure and potential re-sequencing.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub QC Metrics; ACMG/AMP Sequencing QC Guidelines; ISO 15189

attributes.name: mean_base_quality_score
attributes.description: Mean Phred Score across all bases in the aligned reads. The Phred Score is a logarithmic measure of base call accuracy (Q30 = 99.9% accuracy). A key sequencing run quality metric; Q30 ≥ 80% is a standard threshold for clinical-grade sequencing. Directly impacts variant calling sensitivity and specificity.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub QC Metrics; Phred Quality Score Standard (Ewing & Green 1998); ISO 15189

attributes.name: mean_coverage_depth
attributes.description: Average number of sequencing reads covering each base position in the target region or genome (Coverage Depth). Expressed as a fold value (e.g., 30×, 100×). A fundamental QC metric determining the statistical power for variant detection; minimum thresholds vary by application (e.g., 30× for WGS, 100× for somatic panels).
attributes.references: ACMG/AMP Sequencing QC Guidelines; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; ISO 15189; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493

attributes.name: median_insert_size_bp
attributes.description: Median length of the DNA fragment insert in base pairs (bp) as measured from the aligned paired-end reads. Insert size distribution is a key library preparation QC metric; unexpected values indicate library degradation, adapter contamination, or incorrect size selection. Affects read overlap and variant calling accuracy.
attributes.references: Picard CollectInsertSizeMetrics; Illumina Library Preparation QC Standards

attributes.name: memory_used_gb
attributes.description: Peak memory (RAM) consumed in gigabytes during the alignment job execution. Memory usage varies significantly by aligner (e.g., BWA-MEM2 requires ~60 GB for human WGS). Used for cloud instance type selection, cost optimization, and pipeline resource configuration management.
attributes.references: AWS Cost Management; HPC Resource Management Standards; Bioinformatics Pipeline Optimization Guidelines

attributes.name: pct_bases_above_10x
attributes.business_glossary_term: Percentage of Bases at ≥10× Coverage Depth
attributes.description: Percentage of target bases covered at a minimum depth of 10× reads. A standard coverage adequacy metric used in clinical genomics reporting to confirm that the majority of the target region has sufficient depth for reliable variant calling. Commonly reported in clinical assay validation and CAP/CLIA compliance.
attributes.references: CAP Accreditation Standards; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; ACMG/AMP Sequencing QC Guidelines

attributes.name: pct_bases_above_30x
attributes.business_glossary_term: Percentage of Bases at ≥30× Coverage Depth
attributes.description: Percentage of target bases covered at a minimum depth of 30× reads. The 30× threshold is the standard minimum for clinical Whole Genome Sequencing (WGS) and is required by many regulatory and accreditation bodies. Distinct from pct_bases_above_10x as it represents a higher stringency clinical threshold.
attributes.references: ACMG/AMP WGS Guidelines; CAP Accreditation Standards; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493

attributes.name: pct_q30_bases
attributes.business_glossary_term: Percentage of Bases with Phred Score ≥Q30
attributes.description: Percentage of sequenced bases with a Phred Score of 30 or higher (≥Q30), indicating ≥99.9% base call accuracy. The Q30 percentage is the primary sequencing run quality KPI reported by Illumina instruments and BaseSpace. Minimum thresholds (typically ≥75–80%) are defined in clinical assay SOPs and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; Phred Quality Score Standard; FDA IVD Submission Guidelines; ISO 15189

attributes.name: properly_paired_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of read pairs where both reads mapped to the reference genome in the expected orientation and within the expected insert size range. Low properly paired rates indicate library preparation issues, adapter contamination, or reference genome incompatibility. A standard SAMtools flagstat metric.
attributes.references: SAMtools Flagstat Specification; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub QC Metrics; ISO 15189

attributes.name: qc_review_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by a bioinformatics scientist or QC reviewer during manual review of this alignment result. Captures the rationale for QC status overrides, observations about anomalous metrics, or instructions for downstream processing. Required for GxP audit trail and CLIA/CAP documentation.
attributes.references: GxP ALCOA+ Principles; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CAP Accreditation Standards; ISO 15189

attributes.name: qc_status
attributes.description: Overall Quality Control (QC) pass/fail/warning determination for this alignment result based on evaluation of all QC metrics against defined thresholds. Drives downstream workflow routing: pass results proceed to variant calling; fail results trigger re-sequencing or sample rejection. Satisfies LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CAP Accreditation Standards; GxP Data Integrity

attributes.name: read_length_bp
attributes.description: Length of sequencing reads in base pairs (e.g., 150 bp for standard Illumina short-read, 10,000+ bp for long-read platforms). Read length affects alignment accuracy, variant detection capability (especially for structural variants and repeat regions), and computational resource requirements.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; ACMG/AMP Sequencing QC Guidelines

attributes.name: reference_genome_build
attributes.description: Human-readable label of the reference genome assembly build used for alignment (e.g., GRCh38/hg38, T2T-CHM13). Stored denormalized here for rapid querying and reporting without joining to the reference genome dimension. Critical for clinical interpretation — variant coordinates are build-specific.
attributes.references: NCBI RefSeq; Genome Reference Consortium (GRC); ACMG Variant Interpretation Guidelines

attributes.name: result_identifier
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally referenceable business identifier for this alignment result (e.g., ALN-2024-00123456). Used in LIMS reports, bioinformatics dashboards, and regulatory submissions to uniquely identify an alignment output without exposing surrogate keys. Satisfies BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.

attributes.name: sequencing_platform
attributes.description: Sequencing instrument platform used to generate the raw reads (e.g., Illumina NovaSeq, PacBio Revio, Oxford Nanopore PromethION). Platform determines read characteristics (length, error profile), applicable alignment tools, and QC thresholds. Required for method validation documentation and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: FDA IVD Submission Guidelines; ISO 15189; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: sequencing_type
attributes.description: Classification of the sequencing assay type for which this alignment was performed: Whole Genome Sequencing (WGS), Whole Exome Sequencing (WES), targeted panel, RNA-seq, amplicon, or metagenomics. Determines applicable QC thresholds, coverage requirements, and downstream analysis workflows. Satisfies CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE category.
attributes.references: ACMG/AMP Sequencing Guidelines; ISO 15189; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; FDA IVD Submission Guidelines

attributes.name: strand_balance_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of reads mapping to the forward strand versus the reverse strand (forward_reads / total_mapped_reads). Expected value is approximately 0.5 for unstranded libraries. Significant deviation indicates strand bias, which can introduce systematic variant calling errors, particularly for SNP and indel detection.
attributes.references: Picard CollectAlignmentSummaryMetrics; ACMG/AMP Sequencing QC Guidelines

attributes.name: total_reads
attributes.description: Total number of sequencing reads in the input FASTQ file(s) submitted for alignment. Reflects sequencing depth and library complexity. Used to assess whether sufficient input data was provided for the intended application (e.g., WGS, WES, targeted panel). Key QC input metric.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub QC Metrics; ACMG/AMP Sequencing QC Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this alignment result record was last modified, such as when QC status was updated after manual review or when supplementary metrics were appended. Supports audit trail and data governance requirements. Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category.
attributes.references: GxP ALCOA+ Principles; ISO 27001; SOX Section 404

products.name: variant_call_result
products.description: Unified output record for all variant detection and genotyping results per sample per pipeline run — covering NGS variant calling (WGS/WES/targeted), array-based SNP genotyping, and targeted genotyping panels. Captures VCF/genotype file path, caller tool and version, call method discriminator (NGS variant calling, array genotyping, targeted panel), total variants/genotypes called, SNP/INDEL counts, individual genotype calls (rsID, chromosome, position, REF/ALT, zygosity, quality score, array probe ID where applicable), Ti/Tv ratio, dbSNP concordance, call rate, coverage at locus, QC pass/fail status, and filtering criteria applied. Supports GWAS, pharmacogenomics, oncology, clinical interpretation, ancestry, and agricultural genomics workflows.

attributes.name: variant_call_result_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each variant call result record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete genomic analysis event (variant detection/genotyping run output) with a clear lifecycle from raw FASTQ to interpreted result.

attributes.name: accession_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sample.accession. Business justification: Clinical variant call results must be linked to the originating accession for result reporting, TAT compliance tracking, and clinical order fulfillment. This is a fundamental requirement in CLIA-certi

attributes.name: aliquot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sample.aliquot. Business justification: Variant calls are derived from a specific aliquot. Clinical variant reporting and chain-of-custody documentation require unambiguous traceability from variant result to physical aliquot. Multiple aliq

attributes.name: deviation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.deviation. Business justification: Variant call results with unexpected performance (e.g., dbSNP concordance below validated threshold, unexpected CNV count) trigger deviations in GxP genomics operations. No existing FK from variant_ca

attributes.name: extraction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sample.extraction. Business justification: Variant call quality metrics (call rate, coverage depth, Ti/Tv ratio) are influenced by extraction quality. Bioinformatics QC investigations and CAP/CLIA audit trails require linking variant results t

attributes.name: genomic_artifact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bioinformatics.genomic_artifact. Business justification: variant_call_result is METADATA about variant calling (QC metrics, counts, statistics). The actual VCF file is a genomic_artifact. variant_call_result has vcf_file_path and genotype_file_path as STRIN

attributes.name: library_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sequencing.library. Business justification: Variant calls are generated per library, essential for clinical reporting and sample identification. This link enables library-level variant QC, contamination detection, and sample swap identification

attributes.name: library_prep_reagent_catalog_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Library Prep Reagent Catalog Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reagent.reagent_catalog. Business justification: Variant calling sensitivity and Ti/Tv ratio vary by library prep chemistry (PCR-free vs. PCR-plus kits have different error profiles). Clinical validation studies stratify analytical performance by re

attributes.name: model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to instrument.model. Business justification: Variant calling performance (sensitivity, specificity, Ti/Tv ratio) is tracked per instrument model for regulatory method validation and IVD submissions. Clinical genomics labs must demonstrate assay

attributes.name: nonconformance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.nonconformance. Business justification: Variant call results failing QC thresholds (call rate, ti/tv ratio outside spec) trigger nonconformance records in GxP diagnostic labs. This link enables formal disposition (reject/reprocess/release w

attributes.name: oos_investigation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.oos_investigation. Business justification: Variant call results outside validated performance specifications (sensitivity, specificity, call rate) trigger OOS investigations in CLIA/CAP-accredited genomics labs. This link is required for GxP O

attributes.name: order_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.line. Business justification: Variant call results are the primary analytical deliverable for genomic analysis service orders. Linking result to order line enables service completion confirmation, result release workflows, custome

attributes.name: pipeline_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the bioinformatics pipeline run that produced this variant call result. Links the result to the specific computational execution context, HPC/cloud job, and algorithm parameters used.

attributes.name: prior_result_variant_call_result_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous variant call result record that this result supersedes or is a reanalysis of. Enables data lineage chain tracking from original to reanalyzed results. Null for original (non-reanalysis) results.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 15189; GxP Data Integrity Guidelines

attributes.name: sample_specimen_id
attributes.description: Reference to the biological sample that was analyzed to produce this variant call result. Enables traceability from genomic result back to the physical sample in the LIMS.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS; ISO 15189; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493

attributes.name: sequencing_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sequencing.sequencing_run. Business justification: Variant calls require provenance to sequencing run for clinical validation, regulatory submissions, and quality assessment. CAP/CLIA labs must demonstrate traceability from variant calls back to raw s

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.submission. Business justification: Variant call results are core analytical performance data (sensitivity, specificity, PPV) submitted in IVD regulatory dossiers (510(k), PMA, CE-IVD). Direct FK enables automated dossier assembly and t

attributes.name: validation_study_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.validation_study. Business justification: Clinical variant calling pipelines must reference the validation study establishing analytical performance (LOD, sensitivity, specificity) for regulatory use. Required for CLIA/CAP compliance and clin

attributes.name: annotation_pipeline_version
attributes.description: Version of the variant annotation pipeline applied to this call set (e.g., VEP, ANNOVAR, SnpEff). Tracks which annotation databases and logic were used, critical for clinical interpretation reproducibility and regulatory audit.
attributes.references: Ensembl VEP; ANNOVAR; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 15189; GxP Software Validation

attributes.name: array_probe_identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the array probe used to genotype this locus (applicable to array-based SNP genotyping only, e.g., Illumina Infinium probe ID). Null for NGS-based variant calls. Enables probe-level QC and array manifest cross-referencing.
attributes.references: Illumina Array Manifest Specification; Illumina GenomeStudio Documentation

attributes.name: assay_type
attributes.description: Classification of the genomic assay that generated this result. Supports workflow routing for GWAS, pharmacogenomics, oncology, clinical interpretation, ancestry, and agricultural genomics use cases. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WGS|WES|targeted_panel|SNP_array|CNV_array|pharmacogenomics|oncology|ancestry|agricultural — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ACMG/AMP Guidelines; FDA IVD Guidance; CE-IVD IVDR 2017/746

attributes.name: call_method
attributes.description: Discriminator indicating the technology and analytical approach used to generate this result: NGS variant calling (WGS/WES), array-based SNP genotyping, targeted panel sequencing, or targeted genotyping. Drives downstream interpretation logic and QC thresholds.
attributes.references: ACMG/AMP Variant Interpretation Guidelines; FDA 21 CFR Part 820

attributes.name: call_rate
attributes.description: Proportion of loci or probes that received a valid genotype call (range 0.0000–1.0000). A key QC metric for array genotyping; samples below threshold (typically <0.97) are flagged for reanalysis. Also applicable to targeted panel completeness.
attributes.references: Illumina GenomeStudio QC Guidelines; GWAS QC Best Practices; ISO 15189

attributes.name: call_timestamp
attributes.description: The real-world timestamp when the variant calling or genotyping pipeline completed and this result was generated. Principal business event time for this transaction. Used for turnaround time (TAT) calculations and SLA monitoring.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CAP Checklist

attributes.name: caller_tool_name
attributes.description: Name of the variant calling or genotyping software tool used (e.g., GATK HaplotypeCaller, DeepVariant, Strelka2, GenomeStudio, Illumina DRAGEN). Essential for reproducibility, audit, and regulatory submission documentation.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; FDA Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) Guidance; ISO 15189

attributes.name: caller_tool_version
attributes.description: Software version of the variant calling or genotyping tool (e.g., 4.2.6.1 for GATK). Required for regulatory submissions, audit trails, and ensuring reproducibility of results across pipeline versions.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 15189; GxP Software Validation Guidelines

attributes.name: chromosome
attributes.description: Chromosome identifier for the primary or representative variant locus in this result record (e.g., chr1, chrX, chrMT). For multi-variant result summaries, this field captures the primary locus; individual variant details are in the VCF file.
attributes.references: NCBI RefSeq; Ensembl Genome Browser; VCF Specification v4.3

attributes.name: cnv_count
attributes.description: Number of copy number variation (CNV) events detected in this result. Applicable to WGS, WES, and array-based CNV analysis workflows. Null for targeted SNP-only panels.
attributes.references: ACMG/AMP CNV Interpretation Guidelines; ClinGen; ISO 15189

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this variant call result record was first ingested into the Databricks Silver Layer data product. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking per GxP and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 27001; GxP Data Integrity Guidelines

attributes.name: dbsnp_concordance_rate
attributes.description: Proportion of called variants that are present in the dbSNP database (range 0.0000–1.0000). A QC benchmark for variant calling accuracy; high concordance (>0.95 for WGS) indicates reliable calling performance.

attributes.name: filter_criteria_applied
attributes.description: Description or identifier of the variant filtering criteria applied to this call set (e.g., VQSR, hard-filter thresholds, panel-specific filters). Documents the post-calling filtering logic for audit, reproducibility, and regulatory submission.
attributes.references: GATK Best Practices; VCF Specification v4.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 15189

attributes.name: genomic_position
attributes.description: 1-based genomic coordinate of the primary or representative variant locus on the reference genome. Used for locus-level QC reporting, targeted panel coverage verification, and clinical variant lookup.
attributes.references: VCF Specification v4.3; NCBI RefSeq; Ensembl Genome Browser

attributes.name: genotype_quality_score
attributes.description: Phred-scaled genotype quality score (GQ) for the primary variant call, representing confidence in the assigned genotype. Follows VCF FORMAT/GQ field conventions. Used for variant-level QC filtering and clinical reporting thresholds.
attributes.references: VCF Specification v4.3; GATK Best Practices; ISO 15189; ACMG/AMP Guidelines

attributes.name: indel_count
attributes.description: Number of small insertion and deletion (INDEL) variants called in this result. INDELs are a distinct variant class from SNPs and require separate QC thresholds and clinical interpretation rules.
attributes.references: VCF Specification v4.3; ACMG/AMP Guidelines; ISO 15189

attributes.name: is_clinical_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this variant call result has passed all QC gates and regulatory checks and is eligible for inclusion in a clinical genomics report. True = reportable; False = not reportable (failed QC, RUO designation, or pending review).
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CAP Checklist; ACMG/AMP Guidelines; ISO 15189

attributes.name: maf_threshold_applied
attributes.description: The minor allele frequency (MAF) cutoff applied during variant filtering or GWAS QC for this result (e.g., 0.01 = 1%). Variants below this threshold may be excluded from population-level analyses. Null if no MAF filter was applied.
attributes.references: GWAS QC Best Practices; gnomAD; dbSNP (NCBI); NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: mean_base_quality_score
attributes.description: Mean Phred quality score across all sequenced bases for this sample run. Phred score reflects base-calling accuracy (Q30 = 99.9% accuracy). A core NGS QC metric; samples below Q30 threshold may require resequencing.
attributes.references: Phred Quality Score Standard; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; ISO 15189

attributes.name: mean_coverage_depth
attributes.description: Average sequencing coverage depth (mean number of reads aligned per base) across the target region for this sample and run. A fundamental NGS QC metric; minimum thresholds vary by assay (e.g., 30x for WGS, 100x for targeted oncology panels).
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; ACMG/AMP Guidelines; ISO 15189; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493

attributes.name: pct_bases_above_20x
attributes.description: Proportion of target bases achieving at least 20x sequencing coverage depth (range 0.0000–1.0000). A standard NGS QC threshold metric used to assess adequacy of coverage for reliable variant detection.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; ACMG/AMP Guidelines; CAP Checklist; ISO 15189

attributes.name: qc_status
attributes.description: Overall QC pass/fail status for this variant call result. Drives clinical reporting eligibility, downstream analysis inclusion/exclusion, and regulatory compliance gating. A 'fail' or 'flagged' result must not be released for clinical interpretation without review.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CAP Checklist; FDA IVD Guidance

attributes.name: reanalysis_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this result was generated as a reanalysis of a previously processed sample (e.g., due to updated pipeline version, reference genome, or QC failure). True = reanalysis; False = original analysis. Supports data lineage and version tracking.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 15189; GxP Data Integrity Guidelines

attributes.name: regulatory_use_designation
attributes.description: Regulatory designation governing the intended use of this result: In Vitro Diagnostic (IVD), Research Use Only (RUO), Laboratory Developed Test (LDT), or CE-IVD (EU conformity). Determines applicable regulatory reporting obligations and data handling requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820; IVDR 2017/746; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; ISO 13485

attributes.name: result_identifier
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for this variant call result record (e.g., VCR-WGS001-20240115). Used in reports, LIMS cross-references, and regulatory submissions to uniquely identify the result output.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CAP Checklist

attributes.name: result_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this variant call result record. Controls whether the result is available for clinical reporting, downstream analytics, or has been superseded by a reanalysis. Distinct from QC status.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: rs_number
attributes.description: dbSNP reference SNP identifier (rsID) for the primary or representative variant in this result (e.g., rs334 for the sickle cell HbS variant). Enables cross-study variant lookup, pharmacogenomics mapping, and clinical database concordance checks.

attributes.name: snp_count
attributes.description: Number of single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) variants called in this result. Used for QC benchmarking, GWAS analysis, and pharmacogenomics reporting.
attributes.references: dbSNP (NCBI); VCF Specification v4.3; ACMG/AMP Guidelines

attributes.name: ti_tv_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of transition (Ti) to transversion (Tv) SNP variants in this call set. A critical QC metric for NGS variant calling: expected ~2.0–2.1 for WGS, ~3.0–3.3 for WES coding regions. Deviations indicate potential calling errors or contamination.
attributes.references: GATK Best Practices; Illumina BaseSpace QC Metrics; ISO 15189

attributes.name: total_genotypes_called
attributes.description: Total number of individual genotype calls made in this result. Primarily applicable to array-based SNP genotyping where each probe position yields a discrete genotype call. Distinct from variant count in NGS workflows.

attributes.name: total_variants_called
attributes.description: Total count of all variant sites (SNPs, INDELs, CNVs, structural variants) called in this result before any filtering. Primary quantitative output metric for NGS variant calling runs.
attributes.references: VCF Specification v4.3; ACMG/AMP Guidelines; ISO 15189

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this variant call result record (e.g., QC status update, annotation refresh, reanalysis flag). Required for change tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 27001; GxP Data Integrity Guidelines

attributes.name: use_case_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the intended use case for this variant call result. attributes.references: ISO 27001; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: accession_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sample.accession. Business justification: Clinical genomic artifacts must be traceable to the originating accession for result delivery, data access authorization, and regulatory compliance. PHI-containing artifacts (BAM, VCF) require accessi

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Genomic data files (BAMs, VCFs, analysis reports) generated for customer accounts in commercial service or collaborative research contexts. Essential for data delivery tracking, customer portal access

attributes.name: aliquot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sample.aliquot. Business justification: Genomic artifacts (FASTQ, BAM, VCF files) are generated from a specific aliquot. Data retention policies, PHI management, and GxP data integrity requirements in regulated genomics environments mandate

attributes.name: catalog_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.catalog_item. Business justification: Reference datasets, genome assemblies, annotation databases are sold as catalog items (e.g., Illumina BaseSpace datasets, GATK resource bundles). Business need: product sales tracking, licensing enfor

attributes.name: delivery_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.delivery_line. Business justification: Genomic artifacts (VCF, BAM, reports) are the digital deliverables fulfilled against delivery line items. Linking artifact to delivery_line enables proof-of-delivery tracking for digital genomics outp

attributes.name: demux_result_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sequencing.demux_result. Business justification: Artifacts originate from demultiplexing, critical for file provenance and storage management. This link enables tracking FASTQ files through processing pipelines, required for data lineage audits and

attributes.name: deviation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.deviation. Business justification: Genomic artifacts with data integrity issues (checksum mismatch, unexpected file size, QC failure) trigger formal deviations in GxP genomics operations. Linking genomic_artifact to quality.deviation e

attributes.name: extraction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sample.extraction. Business justification: Genomic artifacts are the computational representation of an extraction's nucleic acid. File provenance tracking, regulatory audit trails, and data lineage documentation require linking artifacts to t

attributes.name: flow_cell_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the sequencing flow cell on which the originating sequencing run was performed. Enables traceability to the physical consumable lot, instrument, and run conditions. Critical for QC investigations and reagent lot correlation analysis.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; LabVantage LIMS; ISO 13485

attributes.name: instrument_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to instrument.instrument_run. Business justification: Raw sequencing files (FASTQ, BCL) are generated by instrument runs. This link establishes data provenance from file creation through analysis pipeline, required for regulatory submissions (FDA/CLIA),

attributes.name: library_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sequencing.library. Business justification: Genomic artifacts (BAM/VCF files) are library-specific outputs required for data management, archival, and retrieval. This link enables library-level file organization, storage policy enforcement, and

attributes.name: parent_artifact_genomic_artifact_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the immediate upstream artifact from which this artifact was derived (e.g., a BAM artifact's parent is the FASTQ artifact; a VCF artifact's parent is the BAM artifact). Enables reconstruction of the full data lineage chain from raw to interpreted results.
attributes.references: NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; GxP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: pipeline_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the bioinformatics pipeline run that produced or last processed this artifact. Establishes provenance linkage from the artifact back to the specific pipeline execution, algorithm version, and compute parameters used. Serves as the PARTY_REFERENCE (resource reference) for this entity.
attributes.references: NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; GxP (Good Practice Regulations); ISO 27001

attributes.name: pipeline_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bioinformatics.pipeline_version. Business justification: genomic_artifact has a denormalized `pipeline_version` STRING column. Every genomic artifact (FASTQ, BAM, VCF, etc.) is produced by a specific pipeline version, and tracking which version produced whi

attributes.name: qc_result_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.qc_result. Business justification: Genomic artifacts (FASTQ, BAM, VCF) are generated from samples that underwent laboratory QC testing. Linking enables complete data lineage from sample receipt through QC to final bioinformatics output

attributes.name: run_sample_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sample.run_sample. Business justification: FASTQ artifacts are generated per run_sample after demultiplexing. The run_sample record defines the barcode/index sequence and lane that produced the artifact. This link is essential for demultiplexi

attributes.name: sample_specimen_id
attributes.description: Reference to the biological sample from which this genomic artifact was derived. Enables traceability from the final computational artifact back to the physical sample, supporting clinical reporting, QC, and regulatory audit requirements.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS; CLIA; CAP; ISO 15189; HIPAA

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.submission. Business justification: Genomic artifacts (BAM, VCF, FASTQ files) submitted as raw data packages in FDA/EMA regulatory submissions must be directly traceable to the submission record. Required for data integrity verification

attributes.name: archived_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this artifact was moved to archival storage (e.g., AWS S3 Glacier), in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Null if the artifact has not been archived. Used for storage cost tracking, retrieval SLA management, and compliance with data lifecycle policies.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; HIPAA (45 CFR §164.530); CLIA; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; AWS S3 Glacier

attributes.name: artifact_external_reference
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier for the artifact as assigned by the originating system of record (e.g., Illumina BaseSpace file ID, LabVantage LIMS artifact accession number, or cloud storage object key). Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; LabVantage LIMS

attributes.name: artifact_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label assigned to the genomic artifact, typically derived from the sample identifier, run identifier, and artifact type (e.g., 'SampleA_WGS_R1.fastq.gz'). Serves as the IDENTITY_LABEL for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — File Naming Convention; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: artifact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the genomic artifact within the bioinformatics pipeline ecosystem. 'pending' indicates awaiting generation; 'available' indicates ready for downstream consumption; 'processing' indicates actively being transformed; 'failed' indicates a pipeline error; 'archived' indicates moved to cold storage; 'deleted' indicates purged per retention policy. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; GxP (Good Practice Regulations)

attributes.name: artifact_type
attributes.description: Classification of the genomic data artifact by its file format and biological content type. Drives downstream pipeline routing, storage tier assignment, and retention policy application. Serves as the CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FASTQ|BAM|CRAM|VCF|gVCF|BED|ANNOTATION|REPORT|INDEX|QC_METRICS — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAM/BAM Format Specification (hts-specs); VCF Specification v4.3 (GA4GH); FASTQ Format (Cock et al. 2010); NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: barcode_sequence
attributes.description: Index/barcode nucleotide sequence used to identify this sample within a multiplexed sequencing pool during demultiplexing. Enables traceability of the artifact to its specific library preparation and sample assignment in a pooled run.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; LabVantage LIMS; FASTQ Format Specification

attributes.name: checksum_md5
attributes.description: MD5 hash digest of the artifact file content used for data integrity verification during transfer, storage, and retrieval. Enables detection of file corruption or unauthorized modification. Widely used in genomics data exchange protocols.
attributes.references: GA4GH Data Object Service (DOS); NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; ISO 27001

attributes.name: checksum_sha256
attributes.description: SHA-256 cryptographic hash of the artifact file content providing stronger integrity assurance than MD5. Required for regulatory-grade data integrity verification under GxP and HIPAA security rule compliance. Preferred checksum for clinical and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule (45 CFR Part 164); GxP (Good Practice Regulations); ISO 27001; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: compression_format
attributes.description: Compression algorithm applied to the artifact file. BGZF (Blocked GNU Zip Format) is standard for BAM/CRAM/VCF files enabling random access; GZIP is standard for FASTQ files. Determines decompression requirements for downstream pipeline steps and storage cost calculations.
attributes.references: SAM/BAM Format Specification (hts-specs); FASTQ Format Specification; AWS S3

attributes.name: contains_phi
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this artifact contains Protected Health Information (PHI) as defined under HIPAA. Drives access control enforcement, audit logging requirements, and data handling procedures. Must be set to True for any artifact linked to an identified clinical sample.
attributes.references: HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act) 45 CFR §164.501; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this genomic artifact record was first created in the registry, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and retention policy calculation.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; GxP; HIPAA Security Rule

attributes.name: data_classification
attributes.description: Privacy and regulatory classification of the genomic data contained in this artifact. 'PHI' (Protected Health Information) indicates data subject to HIPAA; 'de_identified' indicates PHI has been removed per HIPAA Safe Harbor or Expert Determination; 'research' indicates IRB-governed research data; 'restricted' indicates controlled-access data (e.g., dbGaP); 'public' indicates open-access data.
attributes.references: HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act) 45 CFR §164.514; GDPR Article 9; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; IRB (Institutional Review Board)

attributes.name: file_generation_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the physical artifact file was generated by the pipeline or instrument, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Distinct from the registry record creation timestamp — represents the actual file creation time as reported by the pipeline or storage system. Used for data freshness assessment and TAT (Turnaround Time) calculations.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; GxP; CLIA

attributes.name: file_size_bytes
attributes.description: Physical size of the genomic artifact file in bytes at the time of creation or last verification. Used for storage capacity planning, cost allocation, and data transfer monitoring. Serves as the principal MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: AWS S3 Object Metadata; ISO 27001 — Asset Management

attributes.name: genome_build
attributes.description: Specific reference genome assembly build used during alignment or variant calling (e.g., GRCh38, GRCh37/hg19). Stored directly on the artifact for rapid querying without joining to the reference genome table. Critical for variant interpretation and cross-cohort comparability.
attributes.references: Genome Reference Consortium (GRC); NCBI RefSeq; GA4GH Variant Representation Specification

attributes.name: index_storage_uri
attributes.description: Full URI path to the index file associated with this artifact (e.g., '.bai' for BAM, '.tbi' for VCF). Stored alongside the artifact URI to enable direct access by pipeline tools without requiring a separate lookup.
attributes.references: SAM/BAM Format Specification (hts-specs); AWS S3; ISO 27001

attributes.name: is_indexed
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a corresponding index file exists for this artifact (e.g., BAI index for BAM, TBI/CSI index for VCF). Indexed artifacts support random-access queries by genomic coordinate, which is required for most downstream analysis tools.
attributes.references: SAM/BAM Format Specification (hts-specs); Tabix (hts-specs); NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: is_paired_end
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the sequencing reads in this artifact were generated using paired-end sequencing chemistry (True) or single-end (False). Paired-end reads improve alignment accuracy and structural variant detection. Determines applicable alignment and QC parameters.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; SAM/BAM Format Specification (hts-specs)

attributes.name: lane_number
attributes.description: Lane number on the sequencing flow cell from which the reads in this artifact were generated. Used for per-lane QC analysis, demultiplexing traceability, and identification of lane-specific sequencing artifacts or failures.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; SAM/BAM Format Specification (hts-specs)

attributes.name: mean_coverage_depth
attributes.description: Mean sequencing coverage depth (average number of reads covering each base) for alignment artifacts (BAM/CRAM). A key QC metric indicating whether sufficient data was generated for reliable variant calling. Expressed as fold-coverage (e.g., 30.0x for 30-fold coverage).
attributes.references: CLIA; CAP; ISO 15189; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: mean_phred_quality_score
attributes.description: Mean Phred base quality score across all reads in the artifact. Phred score (Q) represents the probability of an incorrect base call (Q30 = 99.9% accuracy). A primary QC metric for sequencing run quality assessment per CLIA and CAP standards.
attributes.references: Phred Quality Score (Ewing & Green 1998); CLIA; CAP; ISO 15189; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: percent_q30
attributes.business_glossary_term: Percentage of Bases at Q30 or Above (%Q30)
attributes.description: Percentage of bases in the artifact with a Phred quality score of 30 or higher (≥Q30), indicating ≥99.9% base call accuracy. Industry-standard QC threshold metric for NGS data quality acceptance. Typically required to be ≥80% for clinical-grade sequencing.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; CLIA; CAP; ISO 15189

attributes.name: pipeline_stage
attributes.description: Stage in the bioinformatics processing pipeline at which this artifact was produced. Defines the artifact's position in the data lineage chain from raw sequencing output to interpreted genomic results: 'raw' (FASTQ from demux), 'aligned' (BAM/CRAM), 'variant_called' (VCF/gVCF), 'annotated' (annotated VCF), 'filtered' (filtered VCF), 'reported' (final clinical/research report input).
attributes.references: NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; GxP; CLIA; CAP

attributes.name: qc_failure_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded description of the reason(s) for a QC failure or warning on this artifact (e.g., 'low_coverage', 'high_duplication_rate', 'adapter_contamination', 'low_q30'). Populated only when qc_status is 'fail' or 'warning'. Supports root cause analysis and corrective action tracking.

attributes.name: qc_status
attributes.description: Quality control assessment outcome for this artifact based on applicable QC metrics (coverage depth, %Q30, alignment rate, etc.). 'pass' indicates all QC thresholds met; 'fail' indicates one or more critical thresholds not met; 'warning' indicates borderline metrics requiring review; 'pending_review' indicates QC evaluation not yet completed.
attributes.references: CLIA (42 CFR §493); CAP; ISO 15189; LabVantage LIMS

attributes.name: read_length_bp
attributes.description: Length of sequencing reads in base pairs for FASTQ and BAM artifacts (e.g., 150 for 2x150bp paired-end). Determines applicable alignment parameters, variant calling sensitivity, and QC thresholds. Stored in base pairs (bp).
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; SAM/BAM Format Specification (hts-specs)

attributes.name: retention_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this artifact becomes eligible for archival or deletion per the assigned retention policy. Calculated from the artifact creation date and the applicable retention period. Used by automated data lifecycle management processes.
attributes.references: HIPAA (45 CFR §164.530); CLIA (42 CFR §493.1105); FDA 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5(1)(e)

attributes.name: retention_policy
attributes.description: Retention policy classification governing how long this artifact must be retained before it is eligible for archival or deletion. 'short_term' (e.g., 90 days for intermediate files); 'standard' (e.g., 2 years); 'long_term' (e.g., 7 years for clinical); 'permanent' (e.g., reference datasets); 'regulatory_hold' (litigation or regulatory investigation hold).
attributes.references: HIPAA (45 CFR §164.530); CLIA (42 CFR §493.1105); FDA 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5(1)(e); GxP

attributes.name: sequencing_assay_type
attributes.description: Type of genomic sequencing or array assay that generated the raw data underlying this artifact. Determines applicable QC thresholds, coverage expectations, and downstream analysis pipelines. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WGS|WES|RNA_SEQ|AMPLICON|TARGETED_PANEL|ARRAY|CHIP_SEQ|METHYL_SEQ|ATAC_SEQ|SINGLE_CELL — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; LabVantage LIMS; CLIA; CAP; ISO 15189

attributes.name: storage_platform
attributes.description: Cloud or on-premises storage platform where the artifact is physically stored. Drives data access patterns, cost allocation, and egress fee tracking. Supports multi-cloud and hybrid storage architecture management.
attributes.references: AWS (Amazon Web Services); ISO 27001 — Asset Management

attributes.name: storage_uri
attributes.description: Full URI path to the artifact file in the storage backend (e.g., S3 bucket path 's3://genomics-biotech-prod/artifacts/sample123/output.bam', HDFS path, or NFS mount path). Used by pipeline orchestration and data access layers to locate and retrieve the file.
attributes.references: AWS S3; ISO 27001 — Asset Management; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: total_read_count
attributes.description: Total number of sequencing reads contained in this artifact. For FASTQ files, represents raw read count; for BAM/CRAM files, represents total aligned and unaligned reads. Used for QC assessment, yield reporting, and billing calculations.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; LabVantage LIMS; CLIA

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this genomic artifact record in the registry, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Tracks record modifications for audit trail compliance and change detection in downstream pipelines.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; GxP; HIPAA Security Rule

attributes.name: use_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory use classification of the artifact indicating its intended application context. 'RUO' (Research Use Only) — not for diagnostic use; 'IVD' (In Vitro Diagnostic) — cleared/approved for clinical diagnostics; 'LDT' (Laboratory Developed Test) — validated in-house clinical test; 'clinical' — used in clinical reporting; 'research' — used in research studies; 'internal_qc' — internal quality control purposes.
attributes.references: FDA (U.S. Food and Drug Administration) IVD Regulations; IVDR (EU In Vitro Diagnostic Regulation 2017/746); CLIA; CAP

attributes.name: variant_count
attributes.description: Total number of genomic variants (SNPs, indels, CNVs, SVs) recorded in this artifact for VCF and gVCF file types. Provides a high-level QC indicator and enables rapid assessment of variant calling yield without parsing the full VCF file.

products.name: data_lineage_event
products.description: Transactional record capturing each data transformation event in the bioinformatics processing chain — from raw FASTQ ingestion through alignment (BAM/CRAM), variant calling (VCF/gVCF), annotation, QC filtering, and clinical report generation. Records source artifact(s), target artifact(s), transformation tool and version, pipeline run step reference, timestamp, lineage event type (ingest, transform, filter, merge, split, annotate, export, archive), operator/system identity, and error/failure context when transformations fail. Supports GxP audit trails, HIPAA data traceability, 21 CFR Part 11 compliance, reproducibility requirements, and failure root-cause analysis.

attributes.name: data_lineage_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each data lineage event record in the bioinformatics processing chain. Primary key for this table. Entity role: EVENT_LOG — captures immutable transformation events across the genomic data processing pipeline from raw FASTQ ingestion to clinical report generation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GxP Good Practice Regulations

attributes.name: aliquot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sample.aliquot. Business justification: Data lineage events must close the physical-to-digital provenance gap at the aliquot level. GxP data integrity (21 CFR Part 11) and HIPAA audit trail requirements mandate that every data transformatio

attributes.name: compute_job_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bioinformatics.compute_job. Business justification: data_lineage_event tracks transformations and has hpc_job_id as STRING. compute_job is the authoritative registry of HPC/cloud jobs with compute_job_id as PK. Normalizing hpc_job_id STRING to compute_

attributes.name: demux_result_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sequencing.demux_result. Business justification: Lineage events capture demultiplexing as a transformation step in data processing workflows. This link enables tracking FASTQ file generation and subsequent processing, required for GxP-compliant data

attributes.name: deviation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.deviation. Business justification: Data lineage events recording errors or unexpected data transformations (event_status=error, unexpected record counts) trigger formal deviations in GxP genomics operations. This link enables investiga

attributes.name: extraction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sample.extraction. Business justification: Data lineage events must trace back to the extraction step as the origin of digital genomic data. GxP data integrity requirements and regulatory submissions require a complete, unbroken chain from ext

attributes.name: library_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sequencing.library. Business justification: Lineage tracking at library level enables sample-level audit trails and consent management. This link supports clinical laboratories in demonstrating complete chain of custody from sample receipt thro

attributes.name: parent_lineage_event_data_lineage_event_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the immediately preceding lineage event in the processing chain. Enables construction of a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of transformation events for end-to-end data lineage traversal from raw FASTQ to clinical report.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GxP; HIPAA; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: pipeline_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent bioinformatics pipeline run that encompasses this lineage event. Enables grouping of all lineage events within a single pipeline execution for end-to-end traceability.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GxP; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: pipeline_run_step_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific pipeline run step that produced or triggered this lineage event. Links the lineage record to the bioinformatics pipeline execution context for reproducibility and audit traceability.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GxP Good Practice Regulations; HIPAA

attributes.name: primary_data_genomic_artifact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the genomic data artifact (e.g., FASTQ, BAM, VCF, gVCF, annotation file) that served as the input to this transformation event. Supports forward and backward data lineage tracing.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; GxP

attributes.name: sample_specimen_id
attributes.description: Reference to the biological sample associated with this lineage event, as tracked in the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS). Provides traceability from raw genomic data back to the originating sample.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CLIA; CAP; HIPAA; LabVantage LIMS

attributes.name: sequencing_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sequencing.sequencing_run. Business justification: Lineage events track transformations from sequencing runs through pipeline stages, required for GxP compliance and FDA 21 CFR Part 11 audit trails. This link enables complete data provenance from raw

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.submission. Business justification: Data lineage events in GxP bioinformatics environments must be traceable to the regulatory submission they support, satisfying 21 CFR Part 11 and Annex 11 audit trail requirements. Regulators inspecti

attributes.name: target_artifact_genomic_artifact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the genomic data artifact produced as the output of this transformation event (e.g., aligned BAM, called VCF, annotated VCF, clinical report). Enables downstream lineage traversal.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; GxP

attributes.name: algorithm_parameters
attributes.description: Serialized string (JSON or key=value pairs) of the runtime parameters passed to the bioinformatics tool for this transformation event (e.g., minimum base quality score, minimum mapping quality, ploidy setting). Critical for reproducibility and regulatory audit trails.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GxP; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; ISO 13485

attributes.name: assay_type
attributes.description: Type of genomic assay associated with this lineage event, indicating the sequencing or array methodology applied (e.g., Whole Genome Sequencing (WGS), Whole Exome Sequencing (WES), targeted gene panel, SNP array, Copy Number Variation (CNV) analysis, RNA-seq, amplicon sequencing). Used for assay-specific pipeline routing and regulatory classification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WGS|WES|targeted_panel|SNP_array|CNV_analysis|RNA_seq|amplicon — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA IVD Regulations; CLIA; CAP; ISO 13485; IVDR 2017/746

attributes.name: compute_platform
attributes.description: The computing infrastructure platform on which this transformation event was executed (e.g., AWS Batch, AWS EMR, HPC SLURM cluster, Databricks). Used for cost attribution, performance benchmarking, and infrastructure capacity planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: aws_batch|aws_emr|hpc_slurm|hpc_lsf|databricks|local|on_premise_hpc — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cpu_cores_used
attributes.description: Number of CPU cores allocated and consumed by the compute job executing this transformation event. Used for HPC/cloud resource consumption tracking, cost attribution, and pipeline performance optimization.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when this lineage event record was first captured in the data platform. Distinct from event_timestamp (the real-world transformation time). Required for GxP audit trails and 21 CFR Part 11 record integrity.

attributes.name: error_code
attributes.description: Structured error or exception code returned by the bioinformatics tool or pipeline orchestrator when a transformation event fails (e.g., TOOL_EXIT_NONZERO, INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE, CHECKSUM_MISMATCH, TIMEOUT). Used for failure root-cause analysis and automated alerting.

attributes.name: error_message
attributes.description: Human-readable error or exception message captured when a transformation event fails or produces a warning. Provides detailed context for failure root-cause analysis, pipeline debugging, and GxP deviation investigation.

attributes.name: event_code
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this lineage event, formatted as LIN- followed by an alphanumeric code. Used for cross-system referencing, audit log correlation, and regulatory submission traceability.

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the data transformation event. Indicates whether the transformation is pending execution, actively running, successfully completed, failed with error, skipped due to conditional logic, or retried after a prior failure. Used for pipeline monitoring and failure root-cause analysis.

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) at which the data transformation event occurred in the bioinformatics pipeline. This is the principal real-world event time, distinct from record audit timestamps. Critical for GxP audit trails and 21 CFR Part 11 compliance.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Categorical discriminator identifying the kind of data transformation that occurred in the bioinformatics pipeline. Values: ingest (raw FASTQ ingestion), transform (alignment/variant calling), filter (QC filtering), merge (combining artifacts), split (demultiplexing), annotate (variant annotation), export (clinical report generation), archive (long-term storage). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ingest|transform|filter|merge|split|annotate|export|archive — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GxP; HIPAA; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: execution_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Wall-clock elapsed time in seconds for the transformation event to complete, from job start to job end. Used for pipeline performance benchmarking, Turnaround Time (TAT) analysis, and SLA monitoring.

attributes.name: gxp_audit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transformation event is subject to GxP (Good Practice Regulations including GMP, GLP, GCP) audit trail requirements (True = GxP-regulated event, False = non-regulated event). Used to filter events for regulatory audit reporting and inspection readiness.
attributes.references: GxP Good Practice Regulations; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA; EMA; ICH

attributes.name: hipaa_phi_involved
attributes.business_glossary_term: HIPAA Protected Health Information (PHI) Involved Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transformation event processed or produced data containing Protected Health Information (PHI) as defined under HIPAA (True = PHI involved, False = no PHI). Used for HIPAA compliance reporting, data access controls, and breach risk assessment.
attributes.references: HIPAA Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act; 45 CFR Parts 160 and 164

attributes.name: input_record_count
attributes.description: Number of input records, reads, or variants consumed by this transformation event (e.g., number of FASTQ reads ingested, number of variants in input VCF). Used for data volume tracking, QC validation, and pipeline performance analysis.
attributes.references: GxP; 21 CFR Part 11; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: memory_used_gb
attributes.description: Amount of RAM in gigabytes consumed by the compute job executing this transformation event. Used for HPC/cloud resource consumption tracking, cost attribution, and pipeline performance optimization.

attributes.name: operator_identity
attributes.description: Username, service account name, or system identity (human user or automated pipeline agent) that initiated or executed this transformation event. Required for GxP audit trails, 21 CFR Part 11 electronic signature traceability, and HIPAA access accountability.

attributes.name: operator_type
attributes.description: Categorizes whether the transformation event was initiated by a human user, an automated bioinformatics pipeline, a system service account, or a scheduled job. Supports audit trail differentiation and compliance reporting under 21 CFR Part 11.

attributes.name: output_record_count
