attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493.1241, CAP Laboratory General Checklist

attributes.name: required_tat_hours
attributes.description: Required turnaround time in hours from specimen receipt to result reporting, based on test type and priority.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493.1241, CAP Laboratory General Checklist

attributes.name: specimen_collection_date
attributes.description: Date and time when the specimen was collected from the patient.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493.1241, CAP Laboratory General Checklist

attributes.name: specimen_type
attributes.description: Type of biological specimen collected for the clinical test (e.g., blood, saliva, tissue biopsy).
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493.1241, CAP Laboratory General Checklist

attributes.name: test_price_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Test Price in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: List price of the clinical test in USD. Used for billing and revenue recognition.

products.name: patient
products.description: PHI-compliant master record for patients whose specimens are submitted for clinical genomic testing. Stores de-identified and identified patient demographics (name, DOB, sex, race/ethnicity, MRN), consent records, HIPAA authorization status, GDPR data subject rights flags, guardian/proxy relationships, and patient communication preferences. Governed under HIPAA/GDPR data handling policies. SSOT for patient identity within the clinical domain.

attributes.name: patient_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the patient record within the clinical genomics system. Primary key for patient entity. Serves as the single source of truth for patient identity across all clinical workflows.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.514, GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the patient. Used for clinical report mailing, specimen collection coordination, and patient identification. Subject to HIPAA PHI geographic subdivision restrictions for de-identification.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for apartment, suite, or unit number. Optional field used for complete patient address information.

attributes.name: biological_sex
attributes.description: Biological sex of the patient as recorded for clinical genomic testing purposes. Critical for sex-chromosome analysis (X/Y), X-linked variant interpretation, and assay-specific quality control. Distinct from gender identity.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493, CAP Laboratory Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of patient residence. Used for clinical report delivery and geographic analysis of patient populations. Subject to HIPAA de-identification rules for populations under 20,000.

attributes.name: communication_preference
attributes.description: Patient's preferred method for receiving clinical reports and test result notifications. Used to respect patient communication preferences and ensure HIPAA-compliant delivery of Protected Health Information (PHI).

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: Date when patient consent was obtained for clinical genomic testing. Used for consent validity tracking, audit trails, and regulatory compliance verification. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.508, GDPR Article 7, IRB 21 CFR 50

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Current status of patient consent for clinical genomic testing and data usage. Tracks whether patient has provided informed consent, declined, or withdrawn consent. Critical for HIPAA authorization and GDPR lawful basis compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.508, GDPR Article 6 and 9, IRB 21 CFR 50

attributes.name: consent_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the consent form signed by the patient. Used to track which consent language and terms the patient agreed to, critical for regulatory audits and consent re-validation workflows.
attributes.references: IRB 21 CFR 50, HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.508

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of patient residence. Used for international clinical report delivery, regulatory compliance tracking, and cross-border genomic data sharing governance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the patient record was first created in the clinical genomics system. Used for audit trails, data lineage tracking, and regulatory compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493, CAP Laboratory Accreditation Standards, ISO 15189

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the patient. Critical for patient identification, age-based clinical interpretation of genomic variants, pediatric vs adult assay selection, and HIPAA-compliant de-identification workflows. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.514, CLIA 42 CFR 493

attributes.name: de_identification_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this patient record has been de-identified according to HIPAA Safe Harbor or Expert Determination methods. True indicates PHI has been removed for research or secondary use. Critical for genomic data sharing and research applications.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.514, NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for patient communication. Used for secure clinical report delivery, test result notifications, and consent documentation. Must comply with HIPAA-compliant secure messaging requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.514, HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR 164.312

attributes.name: ethnicity
attributes.description: Self-reported ethnicity of the patient. Used for population-specific genomic variant interpretation, ancestry-based allele frequency assessment, and precision medicine applications. Complements race data for clinical genomics analysis.
attributes.references: NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy, ACMG Variant Interpretation Guidelines

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal first name of the patient as recorded in the healthcare system. Used for patient identification, clinical report generation, and communication. Subject to HIPAA Protected Health Information (PHI) controls.

attributes.name: gdpr_data_subject_rights_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether patient has exercised GDPR data subject rights (right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, or objection). True indicates active data subject request requiring special handling.

attributes.name: gender_identity
attributes.description: Self-identified gender of the patient. Used for patient communication preferences and respectful clinical interactions. Distinct from biological sex used for genomic analysis.

attributes.name: guardian_email
attributes.description: Email address for the patient's guardian or healthcare proxy. Used for secure clinical report delivery and communication when patient cannot receive reports directly.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.502, HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR 164.312

attributes.name: guardian_name
attributes.description: Full name of legal guardian or healthcare proxy authorized to make decisions on behalf of the patient. Required for pediatric patients and patients lacking decision-making capacity. Used for consent documentation and clinical report delivery.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.502, IRB 21 CFR 50.55

attributes.name: guardian_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the patient's guardian or healthcare proxy. Used for clinical report delivery, critical result communication, and consent verification when patient cannot be reached directly.

attributes.name: guardian_relationship
attributes.description: Type of relationship between the guardian/proxy and the patient. Used to verify legal authority for consent and clinical decision-making in pediatric and incapacitated patient cases.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.502, IRB 21 CFR 50.55

attributes.name: hipaa_authorization_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether patient has provided HIPAA authorization for use and disclosure of Protected Health Information (PHI) for clinical genomic testing and research purposes. True indicates authorization granted.

attributes.name: insurance_group_number
attributes.description: Group number associated with the patient's health insurance policy. Used for insurance verification and claims processing for clinical genomic testing services.

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Patient's health insurance policy or member identification number. Used for insurance verification, prior authorization, and claims submission for clinical genomic testing. Subject to HIPAA PHI controls.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.514, HIPAA Transaction Standards 45 CFR 162

attributes.name: insurance_provider
attributes.description: Name of the patient's primary health insurance provider. Used for billing, prior authorization, and reimbursement workflows for clinical genomic testing services.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified the patient record. Used for audit trails, accountability tracking, and regulatory compliance verification. Not patient PII.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493, CAP Laboratory Accreditation Standards, ISO 15189, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the patient record was last updated or modified. Used for audit trails, change tracking, and data synchronization across clinical systems. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493, CAP Laboratory Accreditation Standards, ISO 15189

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal last name (surname/family name) of the patient. Used for patient identification, clinical report generation, and communication. Subject to HIPAA Protected Health Information (PHI) controls.

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Middle name or initial of the patient. Optional field used for complete patient identification and to reduce matching errors in clinical workflows.

attributes.name: mrn
attributes.description: Medical Record Number assigned by the healthcare institution. Unique patient identifier used across clinical systems for patient identification and record linkage. Critical for specimen tracking and clinical report delivery.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.514, CLIA 42 CFR 493

attributes.name: ordering_facility_name
attributes.description: Name of the healthcare facility or institution that ordered the clinical genomic test. Used for clinical report delivery, billing, and regulatory compliance tracking.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493, CAP Laboratory Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: patient_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the patient record. Active indicates patient is eligible for new test orders. Inactive indicates patient has not had recent activity. Deceased triggers special handling for posthumous data access. Merged indicates record consolidated with another MRN.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493, HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.502

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of patient residence. Used for clinical report delivery and geographic analysis. Subject to HIPAA de-identification rules requiring aggregation to first 3 digits for populations under 20,000.

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: Preferred language for patient communication and clinical report delivery. Used to ensure culturally competent care and compliance with language access requirements. ISO 639-1 two-letter language codes recommended.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493, CAP Laboratory Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: primary_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the patient. Used for clinical report delivery notifications, critical result communication, and patient consent verification. Subject to HIPAA PHI controls.

attributes.name: race
attributes.description: Self-reported race of the patient. Used for population-specific variant frequency analysis, ancestry-informed variant interpretation, and clinical genomics research. Critical for accurate Minor Allele Frequency (MAF) assessment and pathogenicity classification.
attributes.references: NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy, ACMG Variant Interpretation Guidelines

attributes.name: referring_physician_name
attributes.description: Name of the physician or healthcare provider who referred the patient for clinical genomic testing. Used for clinical report delivery, result interpretation consultation, and billing. Not classified as patient PII.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493, CAP Laboratory Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: referring_physician_npi
attributes.description: National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the referring physician. 10-digit unique identifier used for healthcare provider identification, clinical report routing, and billing compliance. Required for CLIA-compliant test reporting.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493, HIPAA Administrative Simplification 45 CFR 162

attributes.name: research_participation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether patient has consented to participate in genomic research studies. True indicates patient data and specimens may be used for IRB-approved research beyond clinical care. Distinct from clinical testing consent.
attributes.references: IRB 21 CFR 50, NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy, GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State or province of patient residence. Used for clinical report delivery, regulatory compliance tracking, and state-specific Laboratory Developed Test (LDT) requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.514, CLIA State Licensure Requirements

products.name: clinical_specimen
products.description: Clinical-domain representation of a patient specimen submitted for IVD/LDT testing. Captures specimen accession number, specimen type (blood, saliva, FFPE, cfDNA, buccal swab), collection date, collection site, volume/quantity, pre-analytical QC status (Phred Score thresholds, DIN, RIN), chain-of-custody events, storage conditions, and linkage to the patient and test order. Complements the sample domain SSOT with clinical-specific pre-analytical metadata.

attributes.name: clinical_specimen_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the clinical specimen record. Primary key for the clinical specimen entity.
attributes.references: ISO 15189 - Medical Laboratories Quality and Competence

attributes.name: aliquot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sample.aliquot. Business justification: A clinical specimen received for testing is physically derived from a specific LIMS aliquot. Linking clinical_specimen to aliquot enables pre-analytical QC traceability, freeze-thaw cycle tracking, an

attributes.name: authorized_orderer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.authorized_orderer. Business justification: clinical_specimen has ordering_physician_name and ordering_physician_npi as denormalized string fields. authorized_orderer is the master registry of physicians authorized to order clinical genomic tes

attributes.name: collection_kit_material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material. Business justification: Specimen collection and processing consumes collection tubes, preservatives, extraction kits tracked as materials. Enables preanalytical workflow tracking, material lot traceability for quality invest

attributes.name: collection_site_address_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.address. Business justification: Chain-of-custody and cold-chain compliance tracking require linking each specimen to the validated customer site address where it was collected. collection_site is a denormalized address field. Role-p

attributes.name: parent_specimen_clinical_specimen_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent specimen if this record represents an aliquot or derivative specimen. Null for original specimens. Enables traceability of specimen lineage.

attributes.name: patient_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the patient from whom the specimen was collected. Links specimen to patient demographics and clinical history. Protected Health Information (PHI) under HIPAA.
attributes.references: HIPAA - Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act; GDPR - General Data Protection Regulation

attributes.name: qc_result_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.qc_result. Business justification: Specimen preanalytical QC (DNA concentration, DIN, RIN, hemolysis index, clotting) generates qc_results that must be traceable to the specimen for acceptance/rejection decisions and preanalytical proc

attributes.name: reagent_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reagent.lot. Business justification: CLIA/FDA lot-level traceability requires knowing which reagent lot processed each clinical specimen. Enables reagent recall impact assessment ('which patient specimens were processed with recalled lot

attributes.name: reagent_production_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.production_batch. Business justification: Specimens are processed using reagent batches. Batch traceability required for quality investigations when QC failures occur, enabling lot-specific CAPA and customer notifications. Critical for ISO 15

attributes.name: sample_specimen_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sample.sample_specimen. Business justification: Clinical specimens derive from biobank specimens for diagnostic testing. Real business need: CAP/CLIA chain-of-custody requirements, specimen provenance tracking, and quality control traceability in c

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reagent.storage_location. Business justification: Clinical specimens are stored in the same cold-chain infrastructure as reagents. CLIA requires documented specimen storage conditions (temperature zone, humidity). The plain text 'storage_location' co

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.study. Business justification: Clinical specimens enrolled in IRB-approved research studies must be tracked for IRB compliance reporting and study enrollment dashboards. No existing column on clinical_specimen references research.s

attributes.name: test_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the clinical test order associated with this specimen. Links specimen to the ordered IVD/LDT assay and clinical indication.

attributes.name: accession_number
attributes.description: Unique laboratory-assigned identifier for specimen tracking through the clinical workflow. Externally-known business identifier used across LIMS, clinical reports, and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: CLIA - Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments; CAP - College of American Pathologists

attributes.name: aliquot_count
attributes.description: Number of aliquots created from the original specimen for testing, storage, or repeat analysis. Used for inventory management and specimen tracking.

attributes.name: chain_of_custody_events
attributes.description: Comma-separated or structured log of chain-of-custody events tracking specimen handling from collection through testing. Includes timestamps, handler identifiers, and transfer locations. Critical for forensic and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: clinical_indication
attributes.description: Clinical reason or diagnosis code for ordering the genomic test. Examples: suspected hereditary cancer syndrome, pharmacogenomic screening, prenatal diagnosis. Used for test appropriateness review and variant interpretation.

attributes.name: clotting_observed
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether clotting was observed in the specimen upon receipt. Clotted specimens may yield insufficient DNA or introduce bias in cell-free DNA assays.

attributes.name: collection_date
attributes.description: Date when the specimen was collected from the patient. Critical for calculating turnaround time (TAT) and pre-analytical stability assessment.

attributes.name: collection_site_clia_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Collection Site Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) Number
attributes.description: CLIA certification number of the collection site if applicable. Required for regulatory compliance when collection site is a certified laboratory.

attributes.name: collection_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the specimen was collected from the patient. Used for time-sensitive pre-analytical quality assessments and cfDNA stability calculations.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes regarding specimen collection, handling, quality, or special circumstances. Used for communication between laboratory staff and for audit documentation.

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: Date when patient consent was obtained for genomic testing. Used for audit trails and regulatory compliance verification.
attributes.references: IRB - Institutional Review Board; GDPR; HIPAA

attributes.name: consent_obtained
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether informed consent was obtained from the patient for genomic testing and data use. Required for compliance with IRB protocols and GDPR.
attributes.references: IRB - Institutional Review Board; GDPR; HIPAA

attributes.name: container_type
attributes.description: Type of collection container or tube used for specimen transport. Examples: EDTA tube, PAXgene tube, Streck tube, OMNIgene tube, formalin jar. Impacts pre-analytical quality and DNA/RNA stability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this specimen record was first created in the LIMS. Used for audit trails and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which the specimen is no longer suitable for testing due to degradation or stability limits. Based on specimen type, storage conditions, and assay requirements.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this specimen record was last modified in the LIMS. Used for audit trails and change tracking.

attributes.name: preanalytical_qc_status
attributes.description: Overall pre-analytical quality control assessment status. Indicates whether specimen meets quality thresholds for downstream testing (Phred Score, DIN, RIN, hemolysis, clotting).

attributes.name: quantity_received
attributes.description: Quantity of specimen received by the laboratory. May differ from collected volume due to aliquoting or partial submission. Unit depends on specimen type (ml for liquid, mg for tissue).

attributes.name: quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the specimen quantity. Varies by specimen type: ml for blood/saliva, mg for tissue, ug for extracted DNA/RNA, cells for cell suspensions, slides for FFPE.

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: Date when the specimen was received and accessioned by the clinical laboratory. Start point for laboratory TAT calculations.

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the specimen was received and logged into the LIMS. Used for chain-of-custody documentation and pre-analytical time tracking.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason for specimen rejection if QC failed or specimen was deemed unsuitable for testing. Examples: insufficient volume, hemolyzed, mislabeled, expired transport time. Null if specimen was accepted.

attributes.name: source_anatomical_site
attributes.description: Anatomical site or body location from which the specimen was collected. Examples: peripheral blood, bone marrow, lung tissue, colon biopsy. Critical for pathology correlation and variant interpretation.

attributes.name: specimen_status
attributes.description: Current state of the specimen in the clinical laboratory workflow. Tracks progression from receipt through testing to final disposition.
attributes.references: CAP - College of American Pathologists; ISO 15189

attributes.name: specimen_type
attributes.description: Type of biological specimen collected for genomic testing. Defines the material source for DNA/RNA extraction and sequencing.
attributes.references: ISO 15189 - Medical Laboratories Quality and Competence; CLIA

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Current storage temperature and condition for the specimen. Critical for maintaining specimen integrity and meeting pre-analytical quality requirements.

attributes.name: volume_collected_ml
attributes.description: Volume of specimen collected in milliliters. Critical for determining sufficiency for testing and for calculating input quantities for library preparation.

products.name: analytical_validation
products.description: Records the analytical performance validation data for each clinical assay version — including LOD (Limit of Detection), analytical sensitivity, analytical specificity, precision (repeatability/reproducibility), accuracy, linearity, interference studies, and reference range establishment. Captures validation study design, number of replicates, acceptance criteria, pass/fail determination, validation date, and approving scientist. Required for CLIA/CAP accreditation and FDA/EMA regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: analytical_validation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the analytical validation record. Primary key for the analytical validation entity.

attributes.name: approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.approval. Business justification: Analytical validations are cited as supporting evidence in regulatory approvals (FDA 510(k)/PMA, CE-IVD technical file). Post-market surveillance and approval renewal require tracing which validations

attributes.name: assay_development_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.assay_development. Business justification: Analytical validation studies validate specific assay development efforts. Required for regulatory submissions (510(k), PMA, LDT notifications), CLIA complexity determination, and CAP accreditation. L

attributes.name: assay_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.assay_version. Business justification: analytical_validation records LOD, sensitivity, specificity, and other performance metrics for a specific clinical assay version. The existing ivd_test_catalog_id links to the catalog entry, but valid

attributes.name: catalog_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.catalog_item. Business justification: Validation studies are product-specific; catalog linkage essential for regulatory submissions (FDA 510k, IVDR technical files), product specification documentation, and lifecycle management. Critical

attributes.name: deviation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.deviation. Business justification: Deviations during analytical validation studies (reagent lot failures, instrument malfunctions, protocol departures) must be formally documented per CLIA/CAP and ISO 13485. analytical_validation has n

attributes.name: equipment_qualification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.equipment_qualification. Business justification: CLIA/CAP and FDA IVD regulations require that equipment used during analytical validation studies is formally qualified. Analytical validation reports must reference equipment qualification status; th

attributes.name: ivd_test_catalog_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical assay being validated. Links this validation study to the specific assay version under evaluation.

attributes.name: model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to instrument.model. Business justification: FDA/CLIA mandate that analytical validation studies document the specific instrument model used. Validation is platform-specific; a model change requires revalidation. This FK enables regulatory trace

attributes.name: performing_laboratory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.performing_laboratory. Business justification: analytical_validation records the analytical performance validation data for each clinical assay version. Validation studies are conducted at specific CLIA/CAP-accredited performing laboratories. This

attributes.name: pipeline_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bioinformatics.pipeline_version. Business justification: Analytical validations are performed against a specific pipeline version — directly required for FDA IVD submissions and CAP inspection documentation. No current FK exists; the assay_version path is i

attributes.name: primary_analytical_controlled_document_id
attributes.description: Reference to the controlled document containing the detailed validation study protocol. Links to document management system for version control and audit trail.

attributes.name: production_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.production_batch. Business justification: CLIA/FDA regulatory submissions require traceability from analytical validation results to the exact production batch of reagents/kits used. Genomics diagnostics QA teams routinely need this link to i

attributes.name: reagent_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reagent.lot. Business justification: FDA/CLIA analytical validation studies must document the exact reagent lots used during validation. This is a named regulatory requirement for LDT and IVD submissions — the validation report must cite

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the FDA 510(k), PMA, or EMA submission that includes this validation data. Links validation records to regulatory approval documentation.
attributes.references: FDA In Vitro Diagnostic Device Guidance

attributes.name: research_protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.research_protocol. Business justification: FDA and CAP regulatory submissions require traceability from analytical validation results to the governing research protocol defining methodology and acceptance criteria. No existing column on analyt

attributes.name: risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.risk_assessment. Business justification: Analytical validation protocols require a risk assessment (FMEA per CLSI EP23) to define acceptance criteria and identify failure modes before study execution. This FK links the validation study to it

attributes.name: specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.specification. Business justification: Analytical validation studies are performed against defined product specifications (LOD, sensitivity, specificity thresholds). CLIA/CAP and FDA IVD regulations require traceability from validation res

attributes.name: validated_reagent_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.batch. Business justification: Analytical validation studies must document the exact reagent batch used; batch-to-batch variability is a key validation parameter per CLIA/CAP/FDA guidance. This FK enables regulatory audit traceabil

attributes.name: validation_reagent_material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material. Business justification: CLIA/CAP/FDA analytical validation reports must document the specific reagent materials used during validation studies. Reagent identity is a required element of validation documentation; supplier or

attributes.name: validation_reagent_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supplier. Business justification: Analytical validation studies must document the reagent supplier; a supplier change post-validation requires comparability testing per CLIA/CAP requirements. Supplier qualification status directly aff

attributes.name: validation_study_id
attributes.description: Business identifier for the validation study protocol. Used for cross-referencing with study design documents and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: CAP College of American Pathologists Laboratory Accreditation

attributes.name: acceptance_criteria
attributes.description: Pre-defined performance thresholds that the assay must meet to pass validation. Includes specific numeric criteria for sensitivity, specificity, precision, accuracy, and other performance metrics.
attributes.references: ISO 15189 Medical Laboratories Quality and Competence

attributes.name: accuracy_bias
attributes.description: Systematic deviation of assay results from the true or reference value, expressed as a percentage. Positive bias indicates overestimation; negative bias indicates underestimation.
attributes.references: CLSI Clinical and Laboratory Standards Institute EP09 Guidelines

attributes.name: analytical_sensitivity
attributes.description: Proportion of true positive results correctly identified by the assay, expressed as a percentage. Measures the assay's ability to detect the target analyte when present.
attributes.references: FDA In Vitro Diagnostic Device Guidance

attributes.name: analytical_specificity
attributes.description: Proportion of true negative results correctly identified by the assay, expressed as a percentage. Measures the assay's ability to correctly identify samples without the target analyte.
attributes.references: FDA In Vitro Diagnostic Device Guidance

attributes.name: approving_scientist_name
attributes.description: Full name of the qualified scientist or laboratory director who approved the validation study. Required for regulatory documentation and audit trails.
attributes.references: CAP College of American Pathologists Laboratory Accreditation

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, deviations from protocol, or special considerations identified during the validation study. Used for capturing context not covered by structured fields.
attributes.references: ISO 15189 Medical Laboratories Quality and Competence

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this validation record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for data governance and compliance.

attributes.name: intended_use
attributes.description: Regulatory classification of the assay. IVD (In Vitro Diagnostic) for FDA-cleared tests; RUO (Research Use Only) for non-clinical applications; LDT (Laboratory Developed Test) for CLIA-validated in-house assays.
attributes.references: FDA In Vitro Diagnostic Device Guidance

attributes.name: interference_result
attributes.description: Overall determination of whether tested substances interfere with assay performance. No interference indicates acceptable performance; interference detected requires mitigation or sample rejection criteria; conditionally acceptable indicates interference only at extreme concentrations.
attributes.references: CLSI Clinical and Laboratory Standards Institute EP07 Guidelines

attributes.name: interference_substances_tested
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of endogenous and exogenous substances evaluated for potential interference with assay performance. Common interferents include hemoglobin, lipids, bilirubin, and common medications.
attributes.references: CLSI Clinical and Laboratory Standards Institute EP07 Guidelines

attributes.name: linearity_r_squared
attributes.description: Coefficient of determination for the linearity study regression analysis. Values closer to 1.0 indicate stronger linear relationship. Typical acceptance criterion is R² ≥ 0.95.
attributes.references: CLSI Clinical and Laboratory Standards Institute EP06 Guidelines

attributes.name: linearity_range_lower
attributes.description: Lower boundary of the concentration range over which the assay demonstrates a linear relationship between input and output. Defines the minimum reportable value.
attributes.references: CLSI Clinical and Laboratory Standards Institute EP06 Guidelines

attributes.name: linearity_range_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for the linearity range boundaries. Must be consistent with LOD unit and assay measurement unit.
attributes.references: CLSI Clinical and Laboratory Standards Institute EP06 Guidelines

attributes.name: linearity_range_upper
attributes.description: Upper boundary of the concentration range over which the assay demonstrates a linear relationship between input and output. Defines the maximum reportable value before dilution is required.
attributes.references: CLSI Clinical and Laboratory Standards Institute EP06 Guidelines

attributes.name: lod_unit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Limit of Detection (LOD) Unit of Measure
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for the LOD value. Common units include ng/mL, copies/mL, percentage, or variant allele frequency depending on assay type.
attributes.references: CLSI Clinical and Laboratory Standards Institute EP17 Guidelines

attributes.name: lod_value
attributes.description: Lowest concentration or quantity of analyte that can be reliably detected by the assay. Critical performance metric for regulatory approval and clinical interpretation.
attributes.references: CLSI Clinical and Laboratory Standards Institute EP17 Guidelines

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this validation record was last modified. Tracks changes for audit trail and data lineage purposes.

attributes.name: pass_fail_determination
attributes.description: Final determination of whether the assay met all acceptance criteria. Pass indicates full approval for clinical use; fail requires remediation; conditional pass indicates approval with specific limitations or monitoring requirements.
attributes.references: CAP College of American Pathologists Laboratory Accreditation

attributes.name: precision_repeatability

Distinct from the reference domain's public variant databases — this is the proprietary clinical interpretation repository.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.controlled_document. attributes.name: study_id

attributes.name: submission_id

attributes.name: acmg_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG) Classification
attributes.description: Current ACMG/AMP clinical significance classification of the variant. Represents the most recent expert interpretation of the variant's pathogenicity.

attributes.name: acmg_classification_date
attributes.description: Date when the current ACMG classification was assigned. Critical for tracking classification currency and reanalysis requirements.

attributes.name: acmg_criteria_applied
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ACMG/AMP evidence codes applied in the classification (e.g., PVS1, PS3, PM2, PP3). Documents the evidence basis for the classification.

attributes.name: alternate_allele
attributes.description: Alternate nucleotide sequence observed at the variant position. Represents the variant allele.

attributes.name: chromosome
attributes.description: Chromosome on which the variant is located (e.g., chr17, chrX, chrMT). Follows standard chromosome nomenclature.

attributes.name: clingen_expert_panel_name
attributes.description: Name of the ClinGen expert panel that reviewed this variant (e.g., Hereditary Cancer Clinical Domain Working Group). Null if not reviewed by ClinGen.

attributes.name: clingen_expert_panel_review_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Genome Resource (ClinGen) Expert Panel Review Status
attributes.description: Status of ClinGen expert panel review for this variant. Indicates whether the variant has been evaluated by a disease-specific expert panel.

attributes.name: clinical_actionability
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the variant has clinical management implications (e.g., surveillance, prophylactic surgery, targeted therapy). Guides clinical decision-making.

attributes.name: clinvar_submission_date
attributes.description: Date when the variant interpretation was submitted to ClinVar. Null if not yet submitted.

attributes.name: clinvar_submission_status
attributes.description: Status of Genomics Biotech's submission of this variant interpretation to ClinVar. Tracks regulatory and data-sharing compliance.

attributes.name: clinvar_variation_accession
attributes.description: ClinVar accession number for this variant (e.g., VCV000012345). Links to the public ClinVar database entry.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the individual who created this variant entry. Audit trail for accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this variant knowledge base entry was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: disease_association
attributes.description: Primary disease or clinical condition associated with this variant (e.g., Hereditary Breast and Ovarian Cancer Syndrome, Lynch Syndrome). Represents the clinical phenotype linked to the variant.

attributes.name: evidence_level
attributes.description: Overall strength of evidence supporting the variant-disease association. Aggregates multiple evidence types per ACMG framework.

attributes.name: functional_impact_prediction
attributes.description: Computational prediction of the variant's functional impact on protein function. Aggregated from tools such as SIFT, PolyPhen-2, and CADD.

attributes.name: genomic_position
attributes.description: Genomic coordinate position of the variant on the reference genome. Represents the start position of the variant in base pairs.

attributes.name: inheritance_pattern
attributes.description: Mode of inheritance for the disease associated with this variant. Critical for family risk assessment and genetic counseling.

attributes.name: internal_allele_frequency
attributes.description: Allele frequency of this variant within Genomics Biotech's tested population. Calculated as observation count divided by total alleles tested. Proprietary metric for internal variant prioritization.

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for curator notes, interpretation rationale, or internal discussion points. Not included in external submissions or patient reports.

attributes.name: internal_observation_count
attributes.description: Number of times this variant has been observed in Genomics Biotech's patient population. Proprietary frequency data distinct from public databases.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the individual who last modified this variant entry. Audit trail for change tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this variant knowledge base entry was last updated. Tracks the currency of the interpretation.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this variant interpretation was last reviewed by a curator. Used to trigger periodic reanalysis per ACMG guidelines (recommended every 2 years).

attributes.name: next_review_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this variant interpretation. Supports compliance with reanalysis requirements.

attributes.name: penetrance
attributes.description: Likelihood that individuals carrying this variant will develop the associated disease. Important for risk counseling.

attributes.name: phi_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this variant entry has been de-identified and is compliant with HIPAA PHI requirements for data sharing. True if PHI-compliant.

attributes.name: population_allele_frequency
attributes.description: Allele frequency in the general population as reported by gnomAD or other population databases. Used for variant filtering and classification.

attributes.name: protein_change
attributes.description: HGVS protein-level notation for the amino acid change caused by the variant (e.g., p.Arg273His). Null for non-coding variants.

attributes.name: reference_allele
attributes.description: Reference nucleotide sequence at the variant position as defined by the reference genome build.

attributes.name: reference_genome_build
attributes.description: Reference genome assembly version used for variant coordinates (e.g., GRCh37, GRCh38). Critical for coordinate liftover and data integration.

attributes.name: supporting_literature_pubmed_ids
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of PubMed identifiers (PMIDs) for publications supporting the variant interpretation. Provides evidence traceability.

attributes.name: transcript_consequence
attributes.description: Predicted effect of the variant on the transcript (e.g., missense_variant, frameshift_variant, splice_donor_variant). Uses Sequence Ontology terms.

attributes.name: variant_identifier_hgvs
attributes.business_glossary_term: Human Genome Variation Society (HGVS) Variant Identifier
attributes.description: Standardized HGVS nomenclature for the genomic variant (e.g., NM_000059.3:c.274G>T). This is the canonical identifier used for variant representation across clinical genomics systems.

attributes.name: variant_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this variant knowledge base entry. Active entries are used in clinical reporting; archived entries are retained for historical reference.

attributes.name: variant_type
attributes.description: Classification of the variant by structural type: single nucleotide variant (SNV), insertion, deletion, indel, duplication, or inversion.

SSOT for laboratory accreditation standing and PT compliance tracking.

attributes.name: accreditation_fee_amount_usd
attributes.description: The total fee amount paid or due for the accreditation or certificate, expressed in US dollars. Includes application fees, inspection fees, and annual maintenance fees.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493.638 Fee for Determination of Program Compliance, CAP Laboratory Accreditation Program Fee Schedule

attributes.name: accreditation_fee_payment_status
attributes.description: Current status of payment for accreditation fees. Tracks whether fees have been paid, are pending, or are overdue, which may impact accreditation standing.

attributes.name: accreditation_scope
attributes.description: Detailed description of the scope of testing authorized under this accreditation. Includes test categories, specialty areas, complexity levels (waived, moderate, high), and specific analytes or methodologies covered.

attributes.name: accreditation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the accreditation. Indicates whether the laboratory is currently authorized to perform clinical testing under this accreditation.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493.1806 Suspension, Limitation, or Revocation of Certificate, CAP Laboratory Accreditation Program

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: The externally-issued unique certificate or accreditation number assigned by CLIA or CAP. Business identifier for the accreditation agreement.

attributes.name: certificate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the accreditation or certificate type. Indicates the regulatory framework and scope of laboratory operations permitted.

attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493.1 Certificate Types, CAP Laboratory Accreditation Program

attributes.name: complexity_level

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the user who created this accreditation record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this accreditation record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: deficiencies_cited_count

attributes.name: deficiency_summary
attributes.description: Narrative summary of the deficiencies or non-conformances cited during the most recent inspection. Includes checklist item references, severity classification, and areas requiring corrective action.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the accreditation or certificate became valid and the laboratory was authorized to begin or continue clinical testing operations under this credential.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the accreditation or certificate expires and must be renewed. Nullable for indefinite or rolling accreditations pending inspection cycles.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493.1 Certificate Requirements, CAP Laboratory Accreditation Program

attributes.name: inspection_outcome
attributes.description: The overall result or finding from the most recent inspection. Indicates whether the laboratory met all requirements, had minor recommendations, or had deficiencies requiring corrective action.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493.1806 Enforcement Actions, CAP Laboratory Accreditation Program Inspection Report

attributes.name: issuing_body
attributes.description: The regulatory or accrediting organization that issued the certificate. Examples include CMS (Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services), CAP (College of American Pathologists), state health departments, or other approved accrediting organizations.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493.551 Approved Accreditation Organizations, CAP Laboratory Accreditation Program

attributes.name: laboratory_address
attributes.description: The physical address of the clinical laboratory facility. Required for regulatory reporting, inspection scheduling, and certificate issuance. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493.1 Certificate Requirements, CAP Laboratory Accreditation Program

attributes.name: laboratory_clia_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) Number
attributes.description: The unique 10-digit CLIA identification number assigned to the laboratory by CMS. This is the primary regulatory identifier for the laboratory and is distinct from the certificate number.

attributes.name: laboratory_name
attributes.description: The official name of the clinical laboratory holding this accreditation. Used for regulatory reporting, certificate display, and external communications.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493.1 Certificate Requirements, CAP Laboratory Accreditation Program

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent on-site inspection or survey conducted by the accrediting body or regulatory agency. Critical for tracking compliance cycles and renewal timelines.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493.1773 Inspection Frequency, CAP Laboratory Accreditation Program Inspection Schedule

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the user who last modified this accreditation record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this accreditation record was last updated or modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: The scheduled or anticipated date for the next on-site inspection or survey. Used for proactive compliance planning and resource allocation.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493.1773 Inspection Frequency, CAP Laboratory Accreditation Program Inspection Schedule

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or context related to the accreditation record. May include special conditions, historical context, or internal tracking information.

attributes.name: pt_analyte_test_system
attributes.business_glossary_term: Proficiency Testing (PT) Analyte or Test System
attributes.description: The specific analyte, test system, or specialty area evaluated through proficiency testing. Examples include Glucose, HbA1c, Molecular Oncology, Cytogenetics, or specific gene panels.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493.801 Proficiency Testing Requirements, CAP Laboratory Accreditation Program PT Requirements

attributes.name: pt_corrective_action_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Proficiency Testing (PT) Corrective Action Required Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether corrective action is required in response to unsuccessful proficiency testing performance. True indicates corrective action is required; False indicates acceptable performance.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493.855 Unsuccessful Proficiency Testing Performance, CAP Laboratory Accreditation Program PT Corrective Action

attributes.name: pt_enrollment_period
attributes.description: The time period or cycle for which the laboratory is enrolled in the proficiency testing program. Typically expressed as a year or year-quarter (e.g., 2024-Q1, 2024 Annual).
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493.801 Proficiency Testing Requirements, CAP Laboratory Accreditation Program PT Requirements

attributes.name: pt_graded_outcome
attributes.description: The overall graded outcome or performance result for the proficiency testing cycle. Indicates whether the laboratory met acceptable performance criteria for the analyte or test system.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493.823 Proficiency Testing Performance Standards, CAP Laboratory Accreditation Program PT Grading

attributes.name: pt_program_name
attributes.description: The name of the proficiency testing program in which the laboratory is enrolled. Examples include CAP Surveys, ARUP Proficiency Testing, or other CMS-approved PT providers.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493.801 Proficiency Testing Requirements, CAP Laboratory Accreditation Program PT Requirements

attributes.name: pt_results_submitted_count
attributes.description: The number of proficiency testing results or reports submitted by the laboratory during the enrollment period. Used to verify compliance with PT submission requirements.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493.801 Proficiency Testing Requirements, CAP Laboratory Accreditation Program PT Requirements

attributes.name: pt_sample_sets_received
attributes.description: The number of proficiency testing sample sets or challenges received by the laboratory during the enrollment period. Used to track PT participation completeness.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493.801 Proficiency Testing Requirements, CAP Laboratory Accreditation Program PT Requirements

attributes.name: pt_score_percent
attributes.description: The percentage score achieved by the laboratory on the proficiency testing challenge. Calculated as the number of acceptable results divided by the total number of challenges, expressed as a percentage.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493.823 Proficiency Testing Performance Standards, CAP Laboratory Accreditation Program PT Grading

attributes.name: pt_submission_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the laboratory submitted proficiency testing results by the required deadline. True indicates on-time submission; False indicates late or missing submission.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493.801 Proficiency Testing Requirements, CAP Laboratory Accreditation Program PT Requirements

attributes.name: pt_submission_deadline
attributes.description: The deadline by which proficiency testing results must be submitted to the PT provider. Used to track compliance with PT submission timelines and avoid late submission penalties.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493.801 Proficiency Testing Requirements, CAP Laboratory Accreditation Program PT Requirements

attributes.name: renewal_application_date
attributes.description: The date on which the laboratory submitted the renewal application for the accreditation or certificate. Used to track renewal cycle timelines and compliance with submission deadlines.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493.1 Certificate Requirements, CAP Laboratory Accreditation Program Renewal Process

attributes.name: renewal_workflow_status
attributes.description: Current status of the accreditation renewal process. Tracks the laboratory's progress through the renewal application, review, and approval workflow.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493.1 Certificate Requirements, CAP Laboratory Accreditation Program Renewal Process

attributes.name: test_specialty_areas
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of specialty areas or disciplines covered by the accreditation (e.g., Molecular Pathology, Cytogenetics, Clinical Chemistry, Hematology, Microbiology). Defines the breadth of clinical testing capabilities.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR 493.1441 Specialty and Subspecialty Requirements, CAP Laboratory Accreditation Program

attributes.name: irb_protocol_number

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: phi_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent record meets all HIPAA PHI protection requirements. Used for compliance audits and data governance.

attributes.name: recontact_permitted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether patient consented to be recontacted for future research opportunities or updated findings. Required for longitudinal genomic studies.

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the regulatory jurisdiction governing this consent. Required for multi-country genomic testing operations.

attributes.name: research_use_permitted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether patient consented to use of genomic data for research purposes beyond clinical care. Required for NIH data sharing compliance.

attributes.name: signature_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the stored signature artifact (electronic or scanned paper). Used for audit and legal verification purposes.

attributes.name: somatic_testing_permitted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether patient consented to somatic genomic testing (tumor/acquired variants). Required for oncology genomic testing workflows.

products.name: test_site_authorization
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between test_catalog and performing_laboratory. It captures the governed authorization of a specific clinical assay version at a specific CLIA/CAP-certified laboratory site. Each record defines one test-lab authorization with its own lifecycle, accreditation scope, turnaround time commitment, and menu access level — attributes that exist only in the context of this specific test-site pairing and cannot reside on either the test catalog or the laboratory master alone.. Existence Justification: In clinical genomics operations, a single test (e.g., WGS, targeted panel) can be authorized and performed at multiple CLIA-certified laboratory sites, and each laboratory site is authorized to perform multiple tests. This is not a derived analytical correlation — genomics companies with multi-site operations actively govern which tests are authorized at which sites, with distinct effective dates, turnaround time commitments, and accreditation scope per site-test combination. The business explicitly manages this as a 'laboratory test offering' or 'test site authorization' — a recognized operational concept with its own lifecycle.

Stores legal entity name, account type (RUO, IVD/clinical, OEM, agricultural, biopharma), industry vertical, tier classification, account status, primary address, tax/VAT identifiers, DUNS number, parent account reference for hierarchy, assigned territory, CRM account ID, ERP customer number (SAP SD), credit limit, currency, preferred language, data privacy consent flags (GDPR, HIPAA), market segment classification (RUO, IVD/clinical, biopharma, agricultural, OEM, academic/government), strategic tier (key account, growth, standard), pricing tier, SLA tier, segment effective date, and segment change reason. Segment classification is the authoritative source — no separate segment entity exists.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the customer account. Primary key for the account entity.

attributes.name: parent_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent account in a corporate hierarchy. Used for multi-site organizations, hospital systems, university networks, and corporate subsidiaries. Enables roll-up reporting and consolidated billing.

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_segment. Business justification: Account has market_segment (STRING) which should be normalized to customer_segment_id FK. The customer_segment table exists as a reference table with segment_code, segment_name, regulatory_use_classif

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the customer account. Active (operational), Inactive (dormant but not closed), Suspended (temporarily blocked), Pending Approval (new account under review), Closed (permanently terminated).

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Primary classification of the customer account based on business relationship and product usage. RUO (Research Use Only), IVD/Clinical (In Vitro Diagnostic), OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer), Agricultural Genomics, Biopharma Partner, or Academic/Government Institution.
attributes.references: FDA IVD Regulatory Framework, Internal Business Taxonomy

attributes.name: assigned_territory
attributes.description: Sales territory or region to which this account is assigned. Used for sales quota allocation, territory management, and field application scientist assignment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this account record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage.

attributes.name: credit_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum credit limit approved for the account in the account currency. Used for order approval workflows and credit risk management.

attributes.name: crm_account_code
attributes.description: External identifier from Salesforce CRM Account object. Used for cross-system reconciliation and integration.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the accounts default transaction currency. Used for pricing, invoicing, and financial reporting.

attributes.name: dba_name
attributes.description: Trade name or operating name used by the customer if different from legal entity name. Common for research institutions and clinical laboratories.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit Dun & Bradstreet identifier for the business entity. Used for credit assessment, supplier verification, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: erp_customer_number
attributes.description: Customer master number from SAP S/4HANA SD (Sales and Distribution) module. Used for order processing, billing, and financial transactions.

attributes.name: established_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer account was first established in the system. Represents the start of the business relationship.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Consent Date
attributes.description: Date when GDPR consent was obtained from the account. Used for consent lifecycle management and audit trails.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Consent Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account has provided consent for data processing under GDPR requirements. True if consent obtained, False otherwise. Required for EU-based accounts.

attributes.name: hipaa_baa_effective_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Business Associate Agreement (BAA) Effective Date
attributes.description: Effective date of the executed HIPAA Business Associate Agreement. Used for compliance tracking and audit readiness.

attributes.name: hipaa_baa_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Business Associate Agreement (BAA) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement is in place for this account. True if BAA executed, False otherwise. Required for clinical and IVD accounts handling Protected Health Information (PHI).

attributes.name: industry_vertical
attributes.description: Industry sector or vertical market segment of the customer. Examples: clinical diagnostics, pharmaceutical research, agricultural biotechnology, academic research, contract research organization.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this account record was last updated. Used for change tracking, synchronization, and audit trails.

attributes.name: last_order_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent order placed by this account. Used for customer activity tracking, churn risk analysis, and reactivation campaigns.

attributes.name: legal_entity_name
attributes.description: Official registered legal name of the customer organization or individual. Used for contracts, invoicing, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: owner_name
attributes.description: Name of the sales representative or account manager assigned as the primary owner of this account. Used for relationship management and accountability.

attributes.name: preferred_language_code
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO language code for the accounts preferred communication language. Used for documentation, support, and correspondence.

attributes.name: pricing_tier
attributes.description: Pricing tier assigned to the account based on volume commitments, strategic relationship, and negotiated terms. Determines discount levels and special pricing agreements.

attributes.name: primary_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the primary business address for the account. Typically contains street number and street name.

attributes.name: primary_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the primary business address. Used for suite numbers, building names, department identifiers, or additional location details.

attributes.name: primary_city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the primary business address.

attributes.name: primary_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the primary business address. Used for regulatory compliance, export controls, and regional reporting.

attributes.name: primary_email
attributes.description: Primary business email address for account-level communication, notifications, and correspondence.

attributes.name: primary_phone
attributes.description: Main business telephone number for the account. Used for customer service, technical support, and business communication.

attributes.name: primary_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal code or ZIP code of the primary business address. Format varies by country.

attributes.name: primary_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region of the primary business address. Format varies by country (two-letter state code in USA, province name in other jurisdictions).

attributes.name: segment_change_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for the most recent market segment classification change. Examples: product portfolio shift, regulatory status change, acquisition, business model pivot.

attributes.name: segment_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the current market segment classification became effective. Used for tracking segment transitions and historical analysis.

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: Service level tier defining response times, technical support priority, and service commitments. Platinum (24/7 premium support), Gold (priority business hours), Silver (enhanced standard), Standard (basic support).

attributes.name: strategic_tier
attributes.description: Strategic importance tier assigned to the account. Key Account (top-tier strategic partners), Growth (high-potential emerging accounts), or Standard (regular commercial accounts). Drives resource allocation and service levels.

attributes.name: tax_identifier
attributes.description: Tax identification number for the customer entity. Format varies by jurisdiction (EIN in USA, VAT number in EU, GST number in other regions). Used for tax reporting and invoice compliance.
attributes.references: IRS EIN Standard, EU VAT Directive

attributes.name: vat_registration_number
attributes.description: VAT registration number for customers in VAT jurisdictions. Required for cross-border EU transactions and tax compliance.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Official website URL of the customer organization. Used for research, validation, and business intelligence.

products.name: contact

Captures full name, job title, department, email, phone, preferred communication channel, contact role (technical, commercial, billing, regulatory), opt-in/opt-out marketing flags, GDPR consent status, PHI handling authorization, and active/inactive status.

attributes.name: contact_id

attributes.name: account_id

attributes.name: catalog_item_id

attributes.name: mailing_address_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.address. Business justification: Contact has embedded mailing address fields (mailing_street, mailing_city, mailing_state_province, mailing_postal_code, mailing_country_code) which should be normalized to mailing_address_id FK to the

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.segment. Business justification: contact currently has a customer_segment STRING field which is a denormalized copy of segment classification data. The segment table is the authoritative source for market segmentation (RUO vs. IVD/cl

attributes.name: contact_type

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: department

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_status

attributes.name: last_name
