products.name: segment
products.description: Market segmentation classification applied to customer accounts for commercial targeting, pricing strategy, and service tiering. Segments include RUO (Research Use Only), IVD/clinical, biopharma drug development, agricultural genomics, OEM/reseller, and academic/government. Stores segment code, segment name, regulatory use classification (RUO vs. IVD), market vertical, sub-vertical, strategic tier (key account, growth, standard), assigned pricing tier, SLA tier, and segment owner. Drives downstream product eligibility, promotional eligibility, and support prioritization.

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the customer segment classification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment is currently active and in use for customer classification (True) or has been retired/deprecated (False).

attributes.name: consent_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether accounts in this segment require explicit consent management for data processing and marketing communications (True) or operate under standard terms (False). Relevant for GDPR and HIPAA compliance.

attributes.name: contract_term_months
attributes.description: Standard contract duration in months for accounts in this segment (e.g., 12 for annual contracts, 36 for multi-year agreements). Null if no standard term applies.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this segment record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: credit_limit_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Standard Credit Limit in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Standard credit limit assigned to accounts in this segment for credit risk management. Expressed in USD. Null if no standard limit applies.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this segment classification was retired or superseded. Null if currently active. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this segment classification became effective and available for customer assignment. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Primary geographic scope or region where this segment operates (e.g., GLOBAL for worldwide segments, USA for US-only, EMEA for Europe/Middle East/Africa). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: GLOBAL|NORTH_AMERICA|EMEA|APAC|LATAM|USA|MULTI_REGION — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: gxp_compliance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether accounts in this segment operate under GxP regulations (GMP, GLP, GCP) and require validated systems, audit trails, and regulatory documentation (True) or not (False).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11, ICH Q7, ISO 13485

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this segment record was last updated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: market_sub_vertical
attributes.description: More granular sub-classification within the market vertical (e.g., Oncology Research, Rare Disease Diagnostics, Crop Genomics, Companion Diagnostics).

attributes.name: market_vertical
attributes.description: Primary market vertical or industry sector this segment serves (e.g., ACADEMIC for research institutions, CLINICAL_LAB for diagnostic laboratories, BIOPHARMA for pharmaceutical companies, AGRICULTURAL for agri-genomics clients). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ACADEMIC|CLINICAL_LAB|BIOPHARMA|AGRICULTURAL|OEM|GOVERNMENT|HOSPITAL|DIAGNOSTIC_CENTER — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: owner_email
attributes.description: Email address of the segment owner for business inquiries and segment strategy coordination.

attributes.name: owner_name
attributes.description: Name of the business leader or product manager responsible for this segment strategy and performance (e.g., VP of Clinical Markets, Director of Academic Sales).

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Standard payment terms in days for accounts in this segment (e.g., 30 for Net 30, 60 for Net 60). Drives accounts receivable and credit management.

attributes.name: phi_handling_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Protected Health Information (PHI) Handling Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether accounts in this segment handle Protected Health Information (PHI) and require HIPAA-compliant data handling, Business Associate Agreements (BAA), and enhanced security controls (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: preferred_sales_channel
attributes.description: Primary sales channel used to serve accounts in this segment (e.g., DIRECT for direct sales force, DISTRIBUTOR for channel partners, ONLINE for e-commerce).

attributes.name: pricing_tier
attributes.description: Pricing tier assigned to this segment, determining discount levels, volume pricing eligibility, and contract terms. Drives product pricing and promotional eligibility.

attributes.name: product_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment has access to the full product catalog (True) or restricted product eligibility based on regulatory or commercial constraints (False).

attributes.name: promotional_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether accounts in this segment are eligible for promotional campaigns, special offers, and marketing programs (True) or excluded from promotions (False).

attributes.name: regulatory_use_classification
attributes.description: Primary regulatory classification of the segment: RUO (Research Use Only), IVD (In Vitro Diagnostic), LDT (Laboratory Developed Test), CLINICAL (clinical use), RESEARCH (research only), or MIXED (multiple use cases).

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the segment (e.g., RUO_ACADEMIC, IVD_CLINICAL, BIOPHARMA_DRUG_DEV). Used as business key for segment classification.

attributes.name: segment_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the segment characteristics, target customer profile, and business rationale for this segmentation.

attributes.name: segment_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the customer segment (e.g., Research Use Only - Academic Institutions, In Vitro Diagnostic - Clinical Laboratories).

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: Service level agreement tier defining support response times, technical assistance levels, and service prioritization (e.g., PREMIUM for 24/7 support, STANDARD for business hours).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: System of record where this segment definition originated (e.g., SALESFORCE_CRM for CRM-managed segments, SAP_SD for ERP-managed segments, MANUAL for manually defined segments).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this segment record in the source system (e.g., Salesforce Record ID, SAP segment code). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: strategic_tier
attributes.description: Strategic importance classification of accounts in this segment: KEY_ACCOUNT (top-tier strategic partners), STRATEGIC (high-value established), GROWTH (high-potential expansion), STANDARD (regular commercial), EMERGING (new/developing).

attributes.name: support_priority_level
attributes.description: Numeric priority level for technical support and field application scientist assistance (1=highest priority, 5=standard priority). Drives support queue prioritization.

attributes.name: target_annual_revenue_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Annual Revenue in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Target annual revenue contribution from all accounts in this segment. Used for segment performance tracking and strategic planning. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: target_asp_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Average Selling Price (ASP) in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Target average selling price per transaction for accounts in this segment, used for pricing strategy and revenue forecasting. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: technical_support_model
attributes.description: Technical support delivery model for this segment: DEDICATED_FAE (dedicated Field Application Engineer), SHARED_FAE (shared FAE resources), SELF_SERVICE (online resources only), PARTNER_SUPPORT (through distributors), PREMIUM_SUPPORT (24/7 premium service).

attributes.name: typical_order_size_category
attributes.description: Typical order size category for accounts in this segment (e.g., SMALL for individual reagent orders, LARGE for instrument purchases, ENTERPRISE for multi-year contracts).

products.name: address
products.description: Physical and mailing addresses associated with customer accounts and contacts — shipping destinations for instruments and reagent kits, billing addresses, laboratory site addresses, and registered legal addresses. Captures address type (shipping, billing, legal, lab site), street lines, city, state/province, postal code, country (ISO 3166), geocoordinates, validated flag, validation source, biosafety level of the receiving lab (BSL-1 through BSL-4), cold-chain eligibility flag, and hazmat receiving authorization.
products.reference: Salesforce CRM Address / SAP SD Ship-To

attributes.name: address_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the address record. Primary key.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account or contact associated with this address.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address is currently active and available for use in transactions. True if active, False if inactive or deprecated.

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Classification of the address purpose: shipping destination for instruments and reagent kits, billing address for invoicing, legal registered address, laboratory site address, general mailing address, or headquarters location.

attributes.name: biosafety_level
attributes.description: Biosafety containment level of the receiving laboratory site (BSL-1 through BSL-4) as defined by CDC/NIH guidelines. Determines permissible shipment of biological materials, reagents, and samples. BSL-1: minimal hazard; BSL-2: moderate hazard; BSL-3: serious/potentially lethal; BSL-4: dangerous/exotic. Not applicable for non-laboratory addresses.
attributes.references: CDC/NIH Biosafety in Microbiological and Biomedical Laboratories (BMBL)

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality name where the address is located.

attributes.name: cold_chain_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address is equipped and authorized to receive temperature-sensitive shipments requiring cold-chain logistics (e.g., reagents, enzymes, library prep kits stored at -20°C or -80°C). True if eligible, False if not.
attributes.references: Good Distribution Practice (GDP) for Temperature-Controlled Products

attributes.name: cold_chain_temperature_range
attributes.description: Acceptable temperature range for cold-chain shipments to this address (e.g., 2-8°C, -20°C, -80°C, ambient). Null if cold_chain_eligible_flag is False.
attributes.references: Good Distribution Practice (GDP) for Temperature-Controlled Products

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the country of the address (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR, DEU, CHN, JPN).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the address record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: delivery_instructions
attributes.description: Special instructions for delivery to this address, including access codes, gate instructions, receiving hours, contact person for delivery, loading dock location, or other site-specific logistics guidance.
attributes.references: Logistics and Supply Chain Management Standards

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the address ceased to be valid or was deprecated. Null if the address is still active. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the address became valid and available for use. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: hazmat_receiving_authorized_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address is authorized and equipped to receive hazardous materials shipments (e.g., flammable reagents, corrosive chemicals, biological agents) in compliance with DOT, IATA, and IMDG regulations. True if authorized, False if not.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR, IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations, IMDG Code

attributes.name: hazmat_un_classes_accepted
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazardous Materials United Nations (UN) Classes Accepted
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of UN hazard classes that the receiving site is authorized to accept (e.g., Class 3: Flammable Liquids, Class 6.2: Infectious Substances, Class 8: Corrosives, Class 9: Miscellaneous). Null if hazmat_receiving_authorized_flag is False.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the address record was last updated or modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate in decimal degrees for precise geolocation of the address. Range: -90.0000000 to +90.0000000. Used for logistics routing and cold-chain planning.

attributes.name: line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line including street number, street name, and building identifier. First line of the physical or mailing address.

attributes.name: line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, floor, apartment, unit, building name, or other location details within the primary address.

attributes.name: line_3
attributes.description: Tertiary address line for additional location details, department name, or care-of information.

attributes.name: loading_dock_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address has a loading dock or freight receiving area for large shipments (e.g., sequencing instruments, bulk reagent orders). True if available, False if not.
attributes.references: Logistics and Supply Chain Management Standards

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate in decimal degrees for precise geolocation of the address. Range: -180.0000000 to +180.0000000. Used for logistics routing and cold-chain planning.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the address, including historical context, special handling requirements, known delivery issues, or other relevant information for operations and customer service teams.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal code, ZIP code, or postcode for mail delivery routing. Format varies by country (e.g., 12345, 12345-6789, A1A 1A1, SW1A 1AA).

attributes.name: primary_address_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the primary or default address for the associated customer account. True if primary, False if secondary or alternate address.

attributes.name: receiving_hours
attributes.description: Standard receiving hours for deliveries at this address (e.g., Monday-Friday 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM, 24/7, By Appointment Only). Used for logistics planning and carrier scheduling.
attributes.references: Logistics and Supply Chain Management Standards

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, region, or administrative division within the country. Uses standard postal abbreviations where applicable (e.g., CA for California, ON for Ontario).

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the address location (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London, Asia/Tokyo). Used for scheduling deliveries, service appointments, and coordinating with customer sites.

attributes.name: validated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address has been validated against an authoritative postal or geocoding service. True if validated, False if not validated or validation failed.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Certification, Canada Post SERP

attributes.name: validation_source
attributes.description: Name of the address validation service or system used to verify the address (e.g., USPS CASS, Google Maps Geocoding API, Loqate, Melissa Data, Canada Post SERP). Null if address has not been validated.

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the address was last validated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Null if address has never been validated.

products.name: technical_requirement
products.description: Documents customer-specific technical and application requirements captured during pre-sales, onboarding, or support engagements. Covers sequencing application type (WGS, WES, targeted panel, single-cell), required read length, coverage depth targets, preferred library preparation method, multiplexing requirements, bioinformatics pipeline preferences (FASTQ delivery, BAM/VCF output), instrument platform preference, throughput requirements, turnaround time (TAT) expectations, and regulatory use classification (RUO vs. IVD/LDT). Enables field application scientists and commercial teams to configure appropriate product and service offerings.

products.name: service_agreement
products.description: Records service-level agreements, support contracts, and product evaluation/beta-testing engagements established with customer accounts — instrument service contracts, reagent supply agreements, bioinformatics support SLAs, field application scientist engagement terms, instrument beta placements, early-access reagent kit evaluations, clinical assay validation pilots, CRISPR tool assessments, and demo placements. Captures agreement type (instrument warranty, preventive maintenance, reagent supply SLA, FAS support, beta evaluation, early access, clinical evaluation, demo placement), program name, start date, end date, SLA tier (standard, premium, enterprise), response time commitments, uptime guarantees, covered instruments/products, annual contract value (ACV), renewal terms, agreement status, evaluation status, products under evaluation, success criteria, customer feedback summary, commercial conversion outcome, and internal scientific lead. Serves as the unified contractual and evaluation engagement record — no separate evaluation program entity exists.

attributes.description: Description of the scope of testing, procedures, or activities covered by the accreditation. May include specific test categories, methodologies (NGS, qPCR, array-based), or clinical specialties (oncology, reproductive health, infectious disease).

attributes.name: accreditation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the accreditation. Active = currently valid and in good standing, Expired = past expiry date and not renewed, Suspended = temporarily inactive due to compliance issue, Pending_Renewal = renewal application submitted awaiting approval, Revoked = permanently withdrawn by issuing body, Under_Review = subject to audit or investigation.

attributes.name: accreditation_type
attributes.description: Type of laboratory accreditation or certification held by the customer. CLIA = Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments certification, CAP = College of American Pathologists accreditation, ISO_15189 = Medical Laboratories Quality and Competence certification, CE_IVD = Conformité Européenne In Vitro Diagnostic authorization, GxP = Good Practice Regulations compliance status, IRB = Institutional Review Board registration.
attributes.references: CLIA, CAP, ISO 15189, IVDR 2017/746, ICH, FDA

attributes.name: audit_frequency_months

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate or registration number assigned by the issuing body. Business-confidential identifier used for verification and regulatory compliance tracking.

attributes.name: complexity_level
attributes.description: CLIA complexity level of testing authorized under this accreditation. Waived = simple tests with low error risk, Moderate = moderately complex tests, High = highly complex tests requiring specialized expertise.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this accreditation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the stored accreditation certificate or official documentation in the document management system (e.g., Veeva Vault).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the accreditation becomes valid and the laboratory is authorized to operate under the certification.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the accreditation expires and must be renewed. Nullable for indefinite or rolling certifications.

attributes.name: gdpr_compliant_flag

attributes.name: gxp_compliance_status

Compliant = meets all GxP requirements, Non_Compliant = deficiencies identified, Not_Applicable = GxP not required for this lab type, Under_Review = compliance assessment in progress.

attributes.name: issue_date

attributes.name: issuing_body

attributes.name: ivd_authorized_flag

attributes.name: laboratory_site_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific laboratory facility or site covered by this accreditation. A customer may have multiple sites with separate accreditations.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent on-site or remote audit conducted by the accreditation body to verify compliance with standards.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this accreditation record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next routine or surveillance audit by the accreditation body.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context, special conditions, audit findings, or compliance observations related to the accreditation.

attributes.name: phi_handling_authorized_flag

attributes.name: product_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this accreditation qualifies the customer to purchase and use In Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) products. True = eligible for IVD products, False = restricted to Research Use Only (RUO) products.

attributes.name: renewal_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the renewal application or re-certification process must be completed to avoid lapse in accreditation status.

attributes.name: salesforce_accreditation_code
attributes.description: External identifier from the source Salesforce CRM system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation with the operational system of record.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the accreditation status was last verified by internal compliance or sales operations team against the issuing body's registry.

attributes.name: warranty_status

attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA SD module sales document number. System-of-record identifier linking this order to the ERP order-to-cash process.

attributes.name: export_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order contains items subject to export control regulations (ITAR, EAR, dual-use technology). True requires additional compliance review and documentation.

attributes.name: gxp_relevant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order is for a customer operating under GxP regulations (GMP, GLP, GCP). True triggers additional quality documentation, certificates of analysis, and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: Standard trade terms defining the responsibilities of buyers and sellers for delivery, insurance, and risk transfer. Based on ICC Incoterms 2020. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: incoterms_location
attributes.description: Named place or port specified in the Incoterms clause where risk and cost transfer occurs (e.g., San Diego Port, customer facility address).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this order record was last updated. Audit trail for record changes.

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer order was officially placed and accepted into the system. Represents the business event timestamp for order creation.

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique business identifier for the sales order. Used in customer communications, invoices, and shipment tracking.

attributes.name: order_source_channel
attributes.description: Sales channel through which the order was received. Direct sales for company sales team, distributor for channel partners, OEM for original equipment manufacturer partnerships, e-commerce for online store, field application for scientific support-driven sales.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the sales order. Tracks progression from initial creation through fulfillment and delivery. On-hold indicates temporary suspension due to credit check, regulatory review, or customer request. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|open|in_fulfillment|shipped|delivered|cancelled|on_hold — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the order based on the primary product category being purchased: instrument (sequencing systems, arrays), reagent (library prep kits, flow cells), consumable (tips, plates), sequencing service (WGS, WES, targeted panels), software license (bioinformatics tools), or support contract (maintenance, training).

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Agreed payment conditions specifying when payment is due. Net terms indicate days from invoice date. Prepaid requires payment before shipment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: net_30|net_60|net_90|due_on_receipt|prepaid|credit_card|letter_of_credit — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: product_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory classification of the ordered products. RUO (Research Use Only) for non-clinical research, IVD (In Vitro Diagnostic) for FDA-cleared clinical use, LDT (Laboratory Developed Test) for CLIA-certified lab use, CE-IVD for European clinical diagnostic use.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Customer-provided purchase order number. Required for many institutional and government customers for invoice matching and payment processing.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: Customer-requested date for order delivery. Used for logistics planning and SLA commitment calculation.

attributes.name: sales_office
attributes.description: Geographic sales office or region responsible for this order. Used for territory management and sales performance tracking.

attributes.name: sales_organization
attributes.description: SAP sales organization code representing the legal entity or business unit responsible for this sale. Used for revenue recognition and reporting segmentation.

attributes.name: shipping_carrier
attributes.description: Name of the logistics carrier or freight forwarder handling shipment (e.g., FedEx, UPS, DHL, specialized biotech logistics provider).

attributes.name: shipping_method
attributes.description: Logistics method for order delivery. Specialized cold chain required for temperature-sensitive reagents and biological materials. Customer pickup for local instrument installations.

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: Service level tier determining turnaround time commitments and fulfillment priority. Critical tier for time-sensitive clinical or research projects.

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for special delivery, packaging, or handling requirements (e.g., temperature control, hazmat labeling, installation coordination, security clearance requirements).

attributes.name: tat_commitment_date
attributes.description: Date by which the order must be delivered to meet the SLA commitment. Calculated from order date plus SLA tier turnaround time. Used for performance tracking.

attributes.name: total_net_value
attributes.description: Total order value before taxes, fees, and adjustments. Sum of all line item net values in the order currency.

attributes.name: total_order_value
attributes.description: Total order value including all taxes, fees, shipping charges, and adjustments. Final amount to be invoiced to the customer.

attributes.name: total_tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applied to the order, including sales tax, VAT, GST, or other applicable taxes based on ship-to jurisdiction.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier-provided tracking number for shipment monitoring. Null until order ships. Used for customer self-service tracking and delivery confirmation.

products.name: line

attributes.name: actual_ship_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the line item was shipped from the warehouse or manufacturing facility. Null if not yet shipped.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description if the line item was cancelled. Null for non-cancelled lines.

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date
attributes.description: Delivery date confirmed by Available-to-Promise (ATP) check and production planning. Represents the committed delivery date to the customer.

attributes.name: confirmed_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity confirmed for delivery based on Available-to-Promise (ATP) check and inventory availability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this order line record was first created in the system. Audit trail for order entry.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this line item. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USD|EUR|GBP|JPY|CNY|AUD|CAD|CHF| — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: delivered_quantity
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity that has been shipped and delivered to the customer across all shipments for this line.

attributes.name: delivery_priority
attributes.description: Priority level for fulfillment and shipping of this line item. Influences warehouse picking sequence and carrier service selection.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount amount applied to this line item including volume discounts, promotional discounts, and customer-specific pricing agreements.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Discount percentage applied to the list price for this line item. Calculated as (line_discount_amount / (list_unit_price * ordered_quantity)) * 100.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration or shelf-life end date for time-sensitive products such as reagents and consumables. Critical for quality and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: hazmat_classification
attributes.description: Hazardous material classification code if the product contains dangerous goods requiring special shipping compliance. References UN number and shipping class.
attributes.references: IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations, DOT Hazmat

attributes.name: item_category
attributes.description: SAP SD item category code that controls line item processing behavior. TAN=Standard Item, ZSEQ=Sequencing Service, ZKIT=Reagent Kit, ZINS=Instrument, ZSVC=Service, ZCON=Consumable.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this order line record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field on the line.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the sales order. Determines the ordering and display sequence of line items.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current fulfillment status of the order line item. Tracks the line through its lifecycle from order entry to delivery completion. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|confirmed|in_production|ready_to_ship|partially_shipped|fully_shipped|delivered|cancelled|on_hold — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: list_unit_price
attributes.description: Standard catalog list price per unit before any discounts or adjustments. Expressed in order currency.

attributes.name: net_unit_price
attributes.description: Net price per unit after applying all applicable discounts and before taxes. Expressed in order currency.

attributes.name: net_value
attributes.description: Total net value for this line item calculated as net_unit_price * ordered_quantity, before taxes. Expressed in order currency.

attributes.name: open_quantity
attributes.description: Remaining quantity not yet shipped or fulfilled. Calculated as ordered_quantity minus delivered_quantity.

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the product ordered by the customer as specified in the original sales order.

attributes.name: regulatory_designation
attributes.description: Regulatory classification of the product. RUO=Research Use Only, IVD=In Vitro Diagnostic, CE-IVD=European Conformité Européenne IVD, LDT=Laboratory Developed Test.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: Customer-requested delivery date for this specific line item. May differ from the order header requested date.

attributes.name: sequencing_service_type
attributes.description: Type of Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) service when product_type is sequencing_service. WGS=Whole Genome Sequencing, WES=Whole Exome Sequencing. Empty for non-sequencing products.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number for serialized products such as instruments and equipment. Enables individual unit tracking and warranty management.

attributes.name: shipping_point
attributes.description: Organizational unit responsible for shipping activities for this line item. Determines shipping logistics and carrier selection.

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text instructions for special handling requirements such as temperature control, hazardous materials, or custom packaging.

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Storage location within the plant where the product inventory is allocated for this line item.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount calculated for this line item based on the tax code and line net value. Expressed in order currency.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction and rate code applied to this line item. Determines applicable sales tax, VAT, or GST calculation.

attributes.name: temperature_requirement
attributes.description: Required storage and shipping temperature condition for the product. Critical for reagent and biological sample integrity.

attributes.name: total_value
attributes.description: Total value for this line item including taxes. Calculated as line_net_value + tax_amount. Expressed in order currency.

attributes.name: turnaround_time_days
attributes.description: Committed Turnaround Time (TAT) in days from order confirmation to delivery for this line item. Critical SLA metric for sequencing services.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for quantities. EA=Each, KIT=Kit, RXN=Reaction, GB=Gigabase, LANE=Flow Cell Lane, RUN=Sequencing Run, HR=Hour. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|KIT|RXN|GB|LANE|RUN|HR| — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: bundle_component
products.description: This association product represents the Component role between bundle and sku. It captures the explicit composition of a product bundle — which SKUs are included, in what quantities, in what sequence, whether each is mandatory, and at what component-level discount. Each record links one bundle to one SKU and carries attributes that exist only in the context of that specific bundle-SKU pairing. Product and commercial teams actively create, update, and retire these records as bundle definitions evolve.. Existence Justification: In genomics biotech commercial operations, bundles are explicitly composed of multiple SKUs (e.g., a sequencing bundle may include a flow cell SKU, a reagent kit SKU, and a software license SKU), and a single SKU can participate in multiple bundles simultaneously (e.g., a 96-sample prep kit SKU may appear in both a research bundle and a clinical bundle). Product managers actively define, update, and retire these bundle-SKU compositions as a named business process called bundle component management. The `is_bundle_component` flag on the SKU table and the detection-phase relationship data (quantity_per_bundle, component_sequence, is_mandatory_component, bundle_component_discount_percent) confirm this is an operationally managed relationship with its own attributes.

attributes.name: bundle_component_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the bundle_component association

attributes.name: bundle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the parent bundle that contains this component SKU

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the SKU that is a component of the bundle

attributes.name: component_sequence
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this SKU within the bundle's component list, used for display ordering, pick-list sequencing, and bill-of-materials presentation.

attributes.name: discount_percent
attributes.description: Discount percentage applied to this specific SKU when sold as part of this bundle. Belongs to the bundle-SKU pairing because the same SKU may carry different component discounts across different bundles.

attributes.name: is_bundle_component
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is sold as part of a bundle or kit (true) or as a standalone item (false). Used to manage Bill of Materials (BOM) relationships. [Moved from sku: This BOOLEAN flag on the SKU table indicates whether the SKU participates in any bundle, but it cannot capture which bundles or the terms of participation. With the bundle_component association table in place, this information is derivable (a SKU is a bundle component if any bundle_component record references its sku_id). The flag becomes redundant and should be removed from sku to avoid denormalization and potential inconsistency.]

attributes.name: is_mandatory_component
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is a required component of the bundle (true) or an optional/substitutable component (false). Belongs to the pairing because the same SKU may be mandatory in one bundle and optional in another.

attributes.name: quantity_per_bundle
attributes.description: Number of units of this SKU included in one bundle. Belongs to the bundle-SKU pairing because the same SKU may be included at different quantities in different bundles.

attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; GDPR Article 5; SOX

attributes.name: decision_rationale
attributes.description: Narrative justification for the go/no-go decision recorded at a decision_gate milestone. Documents the scientific, commercial, and regulatory factors considered by the review board. Required for GxP-compliant stage-gate documentation.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; ISO 13485 Section 7.3; GxP Documentation Requirements

attributes.name: evidence_artifact_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL pointing to the supporting evidence artifacts stored in Benchling ELN, Veeva Vault, or MasterControl (e.g., experiment IDs, document control numbers, study report references). Enables traceability from milestone outcome to underlying scientific data.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records); ISO 13485 Section 4.2; GxP Documentation

attributes.name: go_no_go_decision
attributes.description: Formal decision recorded at a decision_gate milestone: go (proceed to next phase), no_go (terminate or pivot program), conditional_go (proceed with defined conditions), or hold (decision deferred pending additional data). Null for non-decision-gate milestone types.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 7.3; ICH Q10 Stage-Gate Framework

attributes.name: irb_approval_number
attributes.description: IRB protocol approval number associated with this milestone when the underlying research involves human subjects or clinical samples. Required for CLIA/CAP-compliant clinical genomics milestones and NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 56 (IRB); NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164

attributes.name: is_gxp_relevant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Practice Regulations (GxP) Relevant Milestone Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this milestone involves GxP-regulated activities (True) — including GMP, GLP, or GCP — requiring formal documentation, audit trails, and quality system controls per applicable regulations. Drives quality oversight and Veeva Vault document control requirements.
attributes.references: GxP (GMP 21 CFR 211; GLP 21 CFR 58; GCP ICH E6(R2)); ISO 13485; EMA GxP Guidelines

attributes.name: is_ip_generating
attributes.description: Indicates whether achievement of this milestone is expected to generate patentable intellectual property or trade secrets (True) or not (False). Triggers IP disclosure workflows and patent filing timelines in the R&D IP management process.
attributes.references: Bayh-Dole Act (35 U.S.C. § 200); NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; ISO 13485

attributes.name: is_regulatory_critical
attributes.description: Indicates whether this milestone lies on the critical regulatory submission path (True), meaning its delay would directly impact an FDA, EMA, or IVDR submission timeline. Used for regulatory affairs prioritization and risk management.
attributes.references: FDA Critical Path Initiative; IVDR 2017/746; ISO 13485 Section 7.3

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the milestone record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Required for GxP audit trail compliance and change tracking under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records); ISO 13485 Section 4.2; GxP Audit Trail

attributes.name: milestone_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the milestone within the R&D portfolio management system (e.g., Benchling or SAP PS). Used in project plans, stage-gate reports, and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice; ISO 13485 Section 7.3

attributes.name: milestone_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the milestone (e.g., 'IND-Enabling Toxicology Study Completion', 'Proof-of-Concept CRISPR Readout', 'TRL-4 Assessment'). Used in portfolio dashboards and stage-gate presentations.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 7.3; ICH Q8 Pharmaceutical Development

attributes.name: milestone_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the milestone: planned (scheduled but not started), in_progress (active work underway), met (successfully completed against success criteria), missed (not completed by planned date), deferred (rescheduled to a future date), or cancelled (removed from scope).
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 7.3; ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System

attributes.name: milestone_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the milestone: decision_gate (go/no-go stage gate), deliverable (tangible output such as a report or prototype), trl_assessment (Technology Readiness Level evaluation), or regulatory_checkpoint (pre-submission meeting, IND filing, FDA/EMA interaction).
attributes.references: NASA TRL Scale; FDA IND Guidance; ISO 13485 Section 7.3

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the next scheduled review or reassessment for milestones with status of in_progress, deferred, or conditional_go. Supports proactive portfolio monitoring and escalation scheduling.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Formal recorded outcome of the milestone at its evaluation point: met (all success criteria satisfied), missed (criteria not met by deadline), deferred (evaluation postponed), partial (criteria partially met with documented exceptions), or cancelled (milestone removed from plan).
attributes.references: ICH Q10; ISO 13485 Section 7.3; FDA Stage-Gate Guidance

attributes.name: phase
attributes.description: R&D program phase during which this milestone occurs: discovery (basic research), lead_optimization (candidate refinement), preclinical (IND-enabling studies), clinical (clinical trial phases), regulatory (submission and approval), or commercialization (product launch readiness). Supports portfolio stage-gating analytics.
attributes.references: ICH Q8/Q9/Q10; FDA IND/NDA/PMA Guidance; ISO 13485 Section 7.3

attributes.name: planned_date
attributes.description: Originally scheduled date by which the milestone was expected to be achieved, as defined in the R&D project plan. Used for schedule variance analysis and portfolio stage-gate tracking.

attributes.name: prior_trl_score
attributes.description: TRL score recorded at the immediately preceding TRL assessment milestone for the same project. Enables calculation of TRL advancement delta and tracking of technology maturation velocity across the R&D portfolio.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority classification of the milestone within the R&D portfolio: critical (program-blocking, must not slip), high (significant impact if delayed), medium (important but manageable), low (nice-to-have or supporting). Used for resource allocation and escalation decisions.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 7.3; ICH Q10 Portfolio Management

attributes.name: rd_spend_recognized
attributes.description: Cumulative R&D expenditure (in USD) formally recognized upon achievement of this milestone for financial reporting purposes. Supports milestone-based R&D spend recognition per ASC 730 (R&D accounting) and SOX-compliant financial controls. Null if milestone has not been met.
attributes.references: ASC 730 (R&D Costs); SOX Section 302/404; GAAP R&D Expense Recognition

attributes.name: regulatory_agency
attributes.description: Regulatory authority associated with a regulatory_checkpoint milestone (e.g., FDA = U.S. Food and Drug Administration, EMA = European Medicines Agency, PMDA = Japan Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency). Null for non-regulatory milestone types. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|EMA|PMDA|Health_Canada|TGA|ANVISA|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_type
attributes.description: Type of regulatory submission or interaction associated with a regulatory_checkpoint milestone (e.g., IND = Investigational New Drug application, PMA = Premarket Approval, 510k = 510(k) clearance, CE_IVD = CE-IVD marking, IVDR = EU IVDR submission, pre_sub = FDA Pre-Submission meeting). Null for non-regulatory milestone types. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: IND|PMA|510k|De_Novo|EUA|CE_IVD|IVDR|pre_sub|none — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR 312 (IND); FDA 21 CFR 814 (PMA); IVDR 2017/746; ISO 13485

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal milestone review meeting or assessment was conducted by the review board or stage-gate committee. Distinct from actual_completion_date, which records when the work was completed. Used for governance audit trails.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 7.3; ICH Q10; GxP Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: revised_target_date
attributes.description: Updated target completion date when the original planned date has been formally revised due to scope changes, resource constraints, or scientific findings. Null if no revision has occurred. Supports deferred milestone tracking.

attributes.name: sap_wbs_element
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA Work Breakdown Structure element code associated with this milestone for R&D cost tracking and financial recognition. Enables integration between the milestone record and SAP CO/PS project accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS (Project System); ASC 730; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: schedule_variance_days
attributes.description: Calculated difference in calendar days between actual_completion_date and planned_date (positive = late, negative = early). Populated upon milestone completion. Used for R&D portfolio schedule performance reporting and KPI dashboards. Note: derived field retained as a persisted business metric for reporting efficiency.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 7.3; ICH Q10 Performance Metrics

attributes.name: spend_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the rd_spend_recognized amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency R&D portfolio financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: success_criteria
attributes.description: Predefined, measurable criteria that must be satisfied for the milestone to be declared 'met'. Examples: 'LOD ≤ 0.1% VAF confirmed in triplicate', 'TRL score ≥ 4 validated by independent review board', 'IND submission package approved by regulatory affairs'. Captured from Benchling ELN or project charter.
attributes.references: ICH Q8; ISO 13485 Section 7.3; FDA IND Guidance 21 CFR 312

attributes.name: trl_score
attributes.description: Numeric Technology Readiness Level score on the 1–9 scale assigned at the time of a trl_assessment milestone. TRL 1 = basic principles observed; TRL 9 = system proven in operational environment. Null for non-TRL milestone types. Enables portfolio stage-gating from basic research through product development readiness.
attributes.references: NASA TRL Scale; EU Horizon 2020 TRL Definitions; ISO 16290:2013

products.name: experiment
products.description: Core entity representing individual scientific experiments and their associated electronic lab notebook (ELN) records — including CRISPR editing efficiency assays, library preparation optimization runs, sequencing chemistry validation experiments, and reagent formulation trials. Captures experiment title, hypothesis, experimental design type (controlled, factorial, dose-response), associated protocol reference, Benchling ELN entry ID, assigned scientist, lab location, start/end dates, status (planned, in-progress, completed, failed), outcome summary, ELN entry type (observation, result, protocol execution, data analysis), review status (unreviewed, peer-reviewed, supervisor-approved), and data integrity signature. Serves as the unified scientific record integrating experimental design with auditable notebook documentation required for IP prosecution and GxP compliance.

attributes.name: experiment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each experiment record in the Genomics Biotech research data platform. Primary key for the experiment entity.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 4.2 — Document and Record Control

attributes.name: assay_development_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.assay_development. Business justification: Experiments are frequently executed as part of assay development programs in genomics biotech. Linking experiment to assay_development enables tracking which experiments contribute to each assay devel

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to instrument.instrument_asset. Business justification: Experiments are performed on specific instruments. Essential for data provenance, instrument utilization analysis, qualification status verification, and correlating experiment outcomes with instrumen

attributes.name: change_control_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.change_control. Business justification: GxP-applicable experiments must be linked to change controls when instruments, reagents, or methods change mid-study. This supports GxP audit trails and regulatory inspection readiness. A GxP lab scie

attributes.name: configuration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to instrument.configuration. Business justification: Experiments are executed under a specific validated instrument configuration. Knowing the active configuration during an experiment is critical for reproducibility, deviation investigation, and GxP au

attributes.name: crispr_construct_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.crispr_construct. Business justification: CRISPR gene-editing experiments use specific constructs from the construct registry. Currently experiment has crispr_guide_rna_sequence (STRING) and target_gene_symbol (STRING) but no FK to crispr_con

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Experiments often use customer-provided samples or validate customer-specific protocols. Essential for sample traceability, regulatory compliance (CLIA/CAP/GxP), data ownership determination, and cons

attributes.name: deviation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.quality_deviation. Business justification: Experiments trigger quality deviations when protocol violations, OOS results, or GxP non-compliance occurs. Required for linking deviation investigations back to originating experimental work and ensu

attributes.name: irb_submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.irb_submission. Business justification: Experiments involving human subjects require IRB approval. experiment currently stores irb_approval_number as a denormalized string. Linking experiment to irb_submission normalizes this reference, ena

attributes.name: lims_sample_batch_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Sample Batch ID
attributes.description: The batch or worklist identifier from LabVantage LIMS linking this experiment to the set of samples processed. Enables bidirectional traceability between the ELN experiment record and the LIMS sample tracking workflow.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS Sample Tracking and Laboratory Workflow; ISO 15189 Section 5.4

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material. Business justification: Experiments consume specific materials (reagent kits, enzymes, consumables). Material traceability is GxP-critical for protocol compliance, batch tracking in regulatory submissions, and root-cause ana

attributes.name: molecular_design_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.molecular_design. Business justification: Experiments in genomics R&D are designed around molecular design artifacts (plasmid maps, guide RNA designs, primer designs) created in Benchling. Linking experiment to molecular_design connects the e

attributes.name: pipeline_validation_study_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bioinformatics.pipeline_validation_study. Business justification: Validation experiments are conducted as part of a formal pipeline validation study (sensitivity, specificity, LOD experiments). Linking experiment to pipeline_validation_study enables tracking which e

attributes.name: pipeline_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bioinformatics.pipeline_version. Business justification: Genomics experiments must record the exact pipeline version used for analysis to ensure reproducibility and GxP compliance. Regulatory submissions and publications require citing the specific pipeline

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent R&D project under which this experiment is conducted. Links the experiment to its governing project portfolio record for milestone tracking and R&D spend allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO — Internal Order / Project System

attributes.name: reagent_sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Experiments consume specific reagent SKUs (kits, consumables, controls). Lab managers track SKU usage for cost accounting, inventory planning, protocol optimization, and reagent performance evaluation

attributes.name: research_protocol_id
attributes.description: Reference to the approved laboratory protocol or Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) that governs the experimental procedure. Ensures traceability to controlled documents required for GxP compliance.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; GxP Good Laboratory Practice (GLP); ISO 13485 Section 7.5

attributes.name: sample_specimen_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sample.sample_specimen. Business justification: Experiments consume specific specimens as input material. Direct specimen link enables material tracking for experimental reproducibility, chain of custody documentation, consent verification for spec

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.submission. Business justification: Experiments generate analytical/clinical data packages for regulatory submissions. Traceability from raw data to submission is required for GxP compliance and regulatory inspections.

attributes.name: test_method_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.test_method. Business justification: Experiments in genomics biotech are executed using validated test methods (sequencing QC, PCR, array methods). Linking experiment to test_method enables GxP audit trail traceability of which validated

attributes.name: veeva_document_id
attributes.description: The document identifier in Veeva Vault for any associated regulatory submission document, quality record, or controlled document linked to this experiment. Supports regulatory traceability for IVD/CE-IVD submissions and GxP quality management.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Regulatory Document Management; FDA 21 CFR Part 820; ISO 13485 Section 4.2.4; IVDR 2017/746

attributes.name: actual_cost_usd
attributes.description: The actual total cost in US Dollars (USD) incurred to execute this experiment, as recorded in SAP. Compared against estimated_cost_usd for budget variance analysis and R&D spend efficiency reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Actual Cost Settlement; GAAP ASC 730; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the experiment was completed or terminated. Used to calculate actual Turnaround Time (TAT) and compare against planned duration for R&D efficiency analytics.
attributes.references: Benchling ELN Entry Timestamp; GxP Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the experiment commenced. Compared against planned_start_date to measure schedule adherence and identify delays in R&D execution.
attributes.references: Benchling ELN Entry Timestamp; GxP Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: benchling_eln_entry_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Benchling Electronic Lab Notebook (ELN) Entry ID
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the corresponding Electronic Lab Notebook (ELN) entry in Benchling. Provides direct traceability from the data product to the authoritative scientific record in the system of record for R&D documentation.
attributes.references: Benchling R&D Notebook and Molecular Biology Platform; 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records

attributes.name: contribution_type
attributes.description: Classifies how the experiment's output contributes to the publication: raw_data, processed_result, statistical_analysis, visualization, or protocol_description. Belongs to the relationship because the same experiment's data may be used differently across publications.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the experiment record was first created in the data platform, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit trail creation anchor required for GxP data integrity and 21 CFR Part 11 compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GxP Data Integrity Guidance; ISO 27001 Audit Logging

attributes.name: crispr_guide_rna_sequence
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clustered Regularly Interspaced Short Palindromic Repeats (CRISPR) Guide RNA Sequence
attributes.description: The nucleotide sequence of the guide RNA (gRNA) used in CRISPR gene-editing experiments. Captured for IP prosecution, reproducibility, and molecular design traceability. Applicable only to CRISPR experiment types; null for non-CRISPR experiments. Classified as confidential due to IP sensitivity.
attributes.references: Benchling Molecular Biology — Sequence Design; IP Intellectual Property Protection; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: data_included_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the experiment's data is directly included in the publication (true) versus merely referenced or cited without inclusion of underlying data (false). Critical for data-sharing compliance and repository deposition requirements.

attributes.name: data_integrity_signature
attributes.description: Cryptographic hash or electronic signature value applied to the experiment record at the time of ELN entry finalization. Ensures data integrity and non-repudiation of the scientific record as required by 21 CFR Part 11 and GxP data integrity guidelines.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records and Signatures; GxP Data Integrity Guidance (MHRA/FDA); ISO 27001

attributes.name: design_type
attributes.description: The statistical or methodological design framework applied to the experiment (e.g., controlled, factorial, dose-response, observational, screening, comparative). Informs data analysis approach and statistical power assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials; GxP GLP; ISO 13485

attributes.name: eln_entry_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the nature of the ELN entry associated with this experiment record (observation, result, protocol execution, data analysis). Drives downstream data routing and review workflows in Benchling.
attributes.references: Benchling ELN Entry Type Classification; 21 CFR Part 11; GxP GLP

attributes.name: estimated_cost_usd
attributes.description: The estimated total cost in US Dollars (USD) to execute this experiment, including reagents, consumables, instrument time, and FTE labor. Used for R&D budget planning, ROI analysis, and project financial forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Internal Orders; GAAP ASC 730 R&D Cost Accounting; SOX

attributes.name: experiment_code
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the experiment within the organization (e.g., EXP-CRISPR0042). Used in lab notebooks, reports, IP filings, and cross-system references.
attributes.references: Benchling Experiment Naming Convention; ISO 13485 Section 4.2.4 — Record Control

attributes.name: experiment_role
attributes.description: Describes the evidentiary role this experiment plays in the publication: primary_evidence, validation, supplementary, negative_control, or replication. Belongs to the relationship because the same experiment may serve different roles in different publications.

attributes.name: experiment_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the experiment in its lifecycle (planned, in-progress, completed, failed, cancelled, on-hold). Drives operational dashboards, resource planning, and milestone reporting.
attributes.references: Benchling Experiment Status Workflow; ISO 13485 Section 7.5 — Production and Service Provision

attributes.name: experiment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the experiment by scientific domain or workflow category (e.g., CRISPR editing efficiency assay, library preparation optimization, sequencing chemistry validation, reagent formulation trial, custom assay development, dose-response). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: crispr_editing|library_prep_optimization|sequencing_chemistry_validation|reagent_formulation|assay_development|dose_response|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Benchling Experiment Schema; Genomics Biotech R&D Taxonomy

attributes.name: failure_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the root cause when an experiment has a status of 'failed'. Captures technical, procedural, or material failure modes for CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) analysis and experimental design improvement.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 8.5 — Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA); GxP GLP; Benchling ELN Failure Notes

attributes.name: figure_reference
attributes.description: Identifies the specific figure(s), table(s), or supplementary section(s) in the publication where this experiment's data appears (e.g., 'Figure 3B', 'Supplementary Table S2'). Belongs to the relationship because the same experiment may appear in different figures across different publications.

attributes.name: gxp_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this experiment is conducted under GxP (Good Laboratory Practice, Good Manufacturing Practice, or Good Clinical Practice) regulatory requirements. Determines the level of documentation, audit trail, and data integrity controls required.
attributes.references: GxP Good Practice Regulations (GLP/GMP/GCP); FDA 21 CFR Part 58; OECD GLP Principles

attributes.name: hypothesis
attributes.description: The scientific hypothesis or research question that the experiment is designed to test. Captured as free text from the ELN entry. Critical for IP prosecution documentation and scientific reproducibility.
attributes.references: Benchling ELN Entry Fields; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; GxP GLP

attributes.name: ip_disclosure_filed
attributes.description: Indicates whether an Intellectual Property (IP) invention disclosure has been filed based on the findings of this experiment. Triggers IP prosecution workflows and ensures novel discoveries are protected prior to publication.
attributes.references: Genomics Biotech IP Policy; USPTO Patent Filing Requirements; ISO 13485 Section 4.2

attributes.name: lab_location_code
attributes.description: Reference to the physical laboratory facility or room where the experiment is conducted. Supports environmental monitoring, equipment qualification traceability, and site-level compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 6.3 — Infrastructure; CLIA Laboratory Requirements

attributes.name: organism
attributes.description: The biological organism or model system used in the experiment (e.g., Homo sapiens, Mus musculus, E. coli, cell line HEK293T, in vitro). Required for regulatory submissions, biosafety classification, and cross-species genomics analytics.
attributes.references: NCBI Taxonomy; NIH Biosafety Guidelines; FDA IND Application Requirements

attributes.name: outcome_summary
attributes.description: Free-text narrative summarizing the scientific outcome, key findings, and conclusions of the experiment. Captured from the ELN entry and used for IP documentation, publication preparation, and knowledge management.
attributes.references: Benchling ELN Result Entry; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; GxP GLP

attributes.name: planned_end_date
attributes.description: The scheduled completion date for the experiment. Used for project milestone planning, resource allocation, and Turnaround Time (TAT) target setting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS Project System; ISO 13485 Section 7.1

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: The scheduled start date for the experiment as defined in the project plan. Used for resource scheduling, milestone tracking, and R&D timeline reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS Project System; ISO 13485 Section 7.1 — Planning

attributes.name: primary_result_metric
attributes.description: The name of the principal quantitative or qualitative metric used to evaluate the experiment outcome (e.g., CRISPR editing efficiency percentage, Phred Score threshold, library yield ng/uL, LOD value). Enables structured result comparison across experiments.
attributes.references: Benchling Result Schema; ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures; ISO 15189

attributes.name: primary_result_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the primary result value (e.g., percent, ng/uL, copies/mL, Phred score, fold-change). Ensures dimensional correctness in analytics and cross-experiment comparisons.
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1); ISO 15189; NIST SI Units

attributes.name: primary_result_value
attributes.description: The numeric value of the primary result metric for this experiment (e.g., 87.5 for 87.5% editing efficiency, 35.2 for Phred Score). Paired with primary_result_unit for dimensional analysis and cross-experiment benchmarking.
attributes.references: Benchling Result Schema; ICH Q2(R1); ISO 15189 Section 5.5

attributes.name: r_and_d_cost_center
attributes.business_glossary_term: Research and Development (R&D) Cost Center Code
attributes.description: The SAP cost center code to which R&D expenditure for this experiment is charged. Enables R&D spend tracking, budget vs. actual analysis, and EBITDA reporting at the project and portfolio level.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Center Accounting; SOX Financial Reporting; GAAP R&D Expense Recognition (ASC 730)

attributes.name: replicate_count
attributes.description: The number of technical or biological replicates included in the experimental design. Distinct from sample_count; captures the replication strategy for statistical validity assessment and reproducibility documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; GxP GLP; ISO 15189 Section 5.6

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Scientific review and approval state of the experiment record (unreviewed, peer-reviewed, supervisor-approved, rejected). Required for GxP data integrity compliance and IP prosecution readiness.
attributes.references: GxP Data Integrity Guidance (MHRA/FDA); 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 13485 Section 8.2

attributes.name: sample_count
attributes.description: The total number of biological samples or replicates processed in this experiment. Used for statistical power assessment, reagent consumption planning, and LIMS sample tracking reconciliation.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS Sample Tracking; ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ISO 15189

attributes.name: target_gene_symbol
attributes.description: The HGNC-approved gene symbol for the primary gene targeted or studied in this experiment (e.g., BRCA1, TP53, EGFR). Links the experiment to reference genomics data and enables gene-centric analytics across the research portfolio.
attributes.references: HGNC HUGO Gene Nomenclature Committee; NCBI Gene Database; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: technology_readiness_level
attributes.description: Numeric scale (1–9) indicating the maturity of the technology or discovery generated by this experiment, per NASA/DoD TRL framework adapted for genomics product development. Used for R&D portfolio stage-gate decisions and commercialization planning.
attributes.references: NIH Technology Readiness Level Framework; Genomics Biotech R&D Stage-Gate Process

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Descriptive title of the experiment as recorded in the Electronic Lab Notebook (ELN). Provides a concise human-readable label for search, reporting, and scientific communication.
attributes.references: Benchling ELN Entry Fields; GxP Good Laboratory Practice (GLP)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to the experiment record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Required for change tracking, data lineage, and GxP audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GxP Data Integrity Guidance; ISO 13485 Section 4.2.4

products.name: research_protocol
products.description: Master catalog of molecular biology and laboratory protocols used in R&D — including CRISPR guide RNA design protocols, library preparation SOPs, PCR/qPCR assay protocols, cell transfection procedures, and sequencing run setup protocols. Tracks protocol name, version, type (SOP, method, assay protocol), author, approval status, effective date, superseded version, associated Benchling protocol ID, applicable instrument platforms, and regulatory classification (GLP, RUO). Serves as the authoritative protocol library for the research domain.

attributes.name: research_protocol_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each protocol record in the master protocol catalog. Primary key for the research.protocol data product.

attributes.name: approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.approval. Business justification: GLP/GCP research protocols in genomics biotech are developed under specific regulatory approvals (IND, IDE). Regulatory affairs and QA teams require direct traceability from protocol to governing appr

attributes.name: change_control_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.change_control. Business justification: Research protocol version changes in GxP environments must go through the change control process. This link enables direct traceability between a protocol revision and its governing change control rec

attributes.name: controlled_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.controlled_document. Business justification: Research protocols are controlled documents requiring version control, approval workflows, training records, and change control. Fundamental GxP requirement for maintaining protocol integrity and regu

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Custom protocols developed for specific customer applications (clinical validation workflows, custom panels, customer-specific QC thresholds). Required for protocol versioning in customer-specific wor

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.project. Business justification: Research protocols are developed within R&D projects. research_protocol has no in-domain FK to project despite being a core R&D artifact. Adding project_id connects protocols to the project portfolio,

attributes.name: risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.risk_assessment. Business justification: Research protocols in GxP-applicable genomics labs require formal risk assessments for biosafety classification and GLP compliance. This link supports protocol approval workflows and regulatory inspec

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.submission. Business justification: Validated protocols submitted as analytical methods in regulatory dossiers (IVD submissions, BLA CMC sections). Method validation is core regulatory requirement for genomics assays.

attributes.name: training_curriculum_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the associated training curriculum or course in MasterControl that personnel must complete to be qualified to execute this protocol. Populated when training_required is True.

attributes.name: applicable_instruments
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of instrument platforms or models for which this protocol is validated and applicable (e.g., 'NovaSeq 6000, NextSeq 2000, MiSeq'). Critical for ensuring protocol-instrument compatibility in sequencing and assay workflows.

attributes.name: applicable_sample_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of biological sample types for which this protocol is validated (e.g., 'FFPE tissue, whole blood, saliva, cell line, cfDNA'). Ensures protocol is applied only to compatible sample matrices.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the protocol received final formal approval from the designated approver(s). Distinct from the effective date; a protocol may be approved before it becomes effective. Required for regulatory audit trails.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 4.2.3; MasterControl Approval Workflow; GxP

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the protocol within the document control workflow. draft = under authorship; in_review = submitted for peer/QA review; approved = formally approved for use; superseded = replaced by a newer version; retired = withdrawn from use; on_hold = temporarily suspended pending investigation.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 4.2.3; MasterControl Document Control Workflow; GxP Document Lifecycle

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the authorized signatory who granted final approval for the protocol. Typically a department head, QA manager, or designated authority. Required for regulatory compliance and audit.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 4.2.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 58; GxP Approval Authority

attributes.name: assay_type
attributes.description: Specific assay or experimental type that the protocol describes (e.g., 'WGS Library Preparation', 'WES Capture', 'SNP Genotyping', 'CNV Detection', 'gRNA Efficacy Assay', 'Cell Viability Assay'). Provides finer-grained classification below protocol_category. attributes.references: FDA Guidance on NGS-Based IVDs; ISO 15189; CLIA

attributes.name: authored_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the primary author who drafted the protocol. Captured as a display name string for audit trail and document control purposes. Supports accountability and traceability per GxP requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 4.2.3; GxP Document Authorship; MasterControl

attributes.name: benchling_protocol_reference
attributes.description: External identifier assigned by Benchling (Electronic Lab Notebook / ELN) to the corresponding protocol entry. Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse catalog and the Benchling R&D system of record.

attributes.name: change_summary
attributes.description: Brief narrative description of the changes made in this version relative to the superseded version. Captured at the time of approval to support change control documentation and regulatory audit trails. Required for GxP change control.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 4.2.3; GxP Change Control; MasterControl Change Management

attributes.name: clia_applicable
