attributes.references: CLIA (Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments) 42 CFR Part 493; CAP Accreditation

attributes.name: coverage_depth_target
attributes.description: Target sequencing coverage depth (in X, i.e., fold coverage) specified by this protocol for NGS applications (e.g., 30 for WGS, 100 for WES, 500 for targeted panels). Null for non-sequencing protocols. Used in run planning and QC acceptance criteria.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; FDA Guidance on NGS-Based IVDs; ACMG Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this protocol record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit trail creation anchor for the record lifecycle.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 4.2.4 — Control of Records; GxP Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the approved protocol becomes effective and authorized for use in laboratory operations. Marks the start of the protocols active lifecycle period. Required for GxP compliance and audit trail.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 4.2.3; GxP Document Control; FDA 21 CFR Part 58

attributes.name: estimated_duration_hours
attributes.description: Estimated total hands-on and elapsed time required to execute the protocol from start to finish, expressed in decimal hours. Used for laboratory scheduling, resource planning, and Turnaround Time (TAT) estimation.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Workflow Scheduling; TAT Management

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the protocol is scheduled to expire and must be reviewed, renewed, or retired. Supports periodic review cycles mandated by GxP and ISO 13485. Null if the protocol has no defined expiry.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 4.2.3; GxP Periodic Review Requirements

attributes.name: external_reference_standard
attributes.description: Citation or identifier of the external compendial, regulatory, or industry standard that this protocol is based on or aligned with (e.g., 'CLSI EP17-A2', 'ISO 20166-1', 'FDA Guidance for NGS-Based IVDs', 'ACMG/AMP Variant Classification Guidelines'). Supports regulatory submission traceability.

attributes.name: glp_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this protocol has been designed and validated to comply with Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) regulations. True = GLP-compliant protocol; False = not GLP-compliant. Relevant for non-clinical safety studies submitted to regulatory agencies.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 58 — Good Laboratory Practice; OECD GLP Principles

attributes.name: ip_generating
attributes.description: Indicates whether this protocol is associated with or has generated Intellectual Property (IP) such as a patent application, trade secret, or proprietary method. True = IP-generating; False = no IP association. Classified as confidential to protect competitive information.
attributes.references: IP (Intellectual Property) Management Policy; Benchling ELN IP Disclosure Workflow

attributes.name: irb_approval_number
attributes.description: Official IRB protocol approval number assigned by the reviewing Institutional Review Board. Required when irb_approval_required is True. Used for regulatory submissions and clinical study documentation.
attributes.references: IRB Regulations; 45 CFR Part 46; FDA 21 CFR Part 56; HIPAA

attributes.name: irb_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether Institutional Review Board (IRB) approval is required before this protocol can be executed on human-derived samples. True = IRB approval mandatory; False = IRB approval not required (e.g., non-human samples or RUO context).
attributes.references: IRB (Institutional Review Board) Regulations; 45 CFR Part 46 (Common Rule); HIPAA

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this protocol record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Updated on every change to support audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 4.2.4; GxP Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: lod
attributes.description: Limit of Detection (LOD) for the assay or method described by this protocol, expressed as a value with units (e.g., '0.1% VAF', '1 ng/µL', '10 copies/mL'). Stored as a string to accommodate varied units across protocol types. Key analytical performance characteristic.
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1); FDA Guidance on Analytical Procedures; ISO 15189 Section 5.5

attributes.name: mastercontrol_doc_reference
attributes.description: Document control identifier assigned by MasterControl, the enterprise document control and training management system. Used to cross-reference the approved controlled document record for audit and regulatory inspection purposes.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control Module; ISO 13485 Section 4.2.3

attributes.name: owning_department
attributes.description: Name of the organizational department or team responsible for maintaining and updating the protocol (e.g., 'Molecular Biology R&D', 'Genomics Assay Development', 'Quality Assurance'). Determines accountability for periodic review.

attributes.name: patent_reference
attributes.description: Patent application number or granted patent number associated with the method or invention described in this protocol (e.g., 'US20230123456A1'). Populated when ip_generating is True. Classified as confidential.
attributes.references: USPTO Patent Filing; IP Management Policy

attributes.name: principal_scientist

attributes.name: protocol_category
attributes.description: Scientific or operational category of the protocol describing the laboratory discipline it covers (e.g., 'Library Preparation', 'CRISPR Gene Editing', 'PCR/qPCR', 'Cell Transfection', 'Sequencing Run Setup', 'Nucleic Acid Extraction', 'Variant Calling'). attributes.references: Benchling ELN — Protocol Category Taxonomy; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: protocol_number

attributes.name: protocol_type

attributes.name: read_length

attributes.name: regulatory_classification

attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 58 (GLP); FDA 21 CFR Part 820 (GMP); IVDR 2017/746; ISO 13485; CLIA

attributes.name: required_reagent_skus
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of reagent and consumable SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) codes required to execute this protocol. Enables Bill of Materials (BOM) linkage, inventory planning, and reagent lot tracking in SAP MM and LabVantage LIMS.

attributes.name: reviewed_by

attributes.name: safety_classification
attributes.description: Biosafety Level (BSL) classification of the protocol indicating the containment level required for safe execution. BSL1–BSL4 per CDC/NIH biosafety guidelines. attributes.name: short_name

attributes.name: superseded_version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the immediately preceding protocol version that this record replaces. Enables forward and backward traceability across the protocol version history chain. Null for the initial version.

attributes.name: technology_platform
attributes.description: Primary genomics technology platform that this protocol supports. NGS = Next-Generation Sequencing; array = microarray-based; PCR = Polymerase Chain Reaction; qPCR = Quantitative PCR; CRISPR = gene editing; Sanger = Sanger sequencing; ddPCR = droplet digital PCR. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NGS|array|PCR|qPCR|CRISPR|Sanger|ddPCR|digital_PCR|other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: title

attributes.name: validation_status

attributes.name: version_number

products.name: crispr_construct

Captures construct name, type (crispr_grna, cas_variant, plasmid, oligo, gene_fragment, expression_vector), target gene or locus, genomic coordinates (GRCh38/hg38), sequence data reference (Benchling entity ID), editing modality (knockout, knock-in, base edit — for CRISPR types), delivery format (plasmid, RNP, LNP, AAV), design tool/algorithm used, Benchling molecular design reference, design status (draft, reviewed, approved, deprecated), IP status, and development stage. Serves as the unified molecular construct registry bridging Benchling ELN with the broader research data model and IP portfolio management.

attributes.description: Username or identifier of the researcher who created the construct record in the system.

products.name: construct_assay_evaluation
products.description: This association product represents the Evaluation event between a CRISPR construct and an assay development program. It captures the operational record of a specific construct being tested within a specific assay development project — including the role the construct played, the concentration used, the validation outcome for that pairing, and the scientific rationale for inclusion. Each record links one crispr_construct to one assay_development with attributes that exist only in the context of this evaluation relationship. Required for regulatory submissions (FDA 510(k), CE-IVD) that mandate documentation of all constructs evaluated during assay development.. Existence Justification: In genomics biotech R&D, a single CRISPR construct (e.g., a Cas9-gRNA targeting BRCA1) is routinely evaluated across multiple assay development programs (e.g., an NGS editing efficiency assay, a qPCR readout assay, and a CNV detection assay). Conversely, a single assay development program evaluates multiple CRISPR constructs to compare editing efficiency, specificity, and performance characteristics. This is an actively managed operational relationship — assay scientists explicitly track which constructs were tested in which assay programs, at what concentration, in what role, and with what validation outcome, particularly for regulatory submissions (FDA 510(k), CE-IVD) that require documented evidence of all constructs evaluated.

products.description: Bill of Materials defining the complete assembly structure for a manufactured product (instrument, reagent kit, array, flow cell, consumable) — including both the header definition and all component line items. Header captures: material number, BOM usage (production, engineering, costing), BOM status (active, inactive), valid-from/valid-to dates, base quantity, unit of measure, plant, BOM alternative number, change number, and ECM reference. Components capture: component material number, item category (stock, non-stock, document, text), required quantity, unit of measure, scrap factor, valid-from/valid-to dates, operation assignment, storage location, batch classification requirement, controlled substance flag, and cold-chain requirement. Serves as the authoritative BOM definition for production execution, MRP explosion, and cost rollup. Integrates with SAP PP BOM (CS01/CS02).

attributes.name: quality_approver
attributes.description: Name of the Quality Assurance (QA) manager or authorized person who approved the validation report.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Primary regulatory authority for which this validation was conducted: FDA (United States), EMA (European Union), MHRA (United Kingdom), TGA (Australia), PMDA (Japan), NMPA (China).

attributes.name: statistical_method
attributes.description: Statistical methods and tools used for validation data analysis (e.g., ANOVA, control charts, process capability analysis, hypothesis testing).

attributes.name: validation_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when all validation runs were completed and the validation report was approved.

attributes.name: validation_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the process validation expires and revalidation is required. Typically set based on regulatory requirements, process changes, or periodic review schedules.
attributes.references: FDA Process Validation Guidance, ICH Q7

attributes.name: validation_outcome
attributes.description: Overall outcome of the validation study: passed (all acceptance criteria met), failed (criteria not met), conditional pass (minor deviations with justification), in progress, or not started.

attributes.name: validation_protocol_number
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the validation protocol document. Externally-known reference number used across regulatory submissions and quality systems.
attributes.references: FDA Process Validation Guidance, ISO 13485 Section 7.5.6

attributes.name: validation_runs_completed
attributes.description: Number of validation runs successfully completed to date.

attributes.name: validation_runs_planned
attributes.description: Number of validation runs planned in the protocol (typically 3 consecutive successful runs for prospective validation per FDA guidance).
attributes.references: FDA Process Validation Guidance, ICH Q7

attributes.name: validation_scope
attributes.description: Detailed description of the validation scope, including process steps, equipment, materials, and environmental conditions covered by the validation study.

attributes.name: validation_stage
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the validation study: protocol approved, execution in progress, report approved, validated (active), revalidation required, or expired.

attributes.name: validation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the validation study execution began (first validation run initiated).

attributes.name: validation_team_lead
attributes.description: Name of the validation team lead or principal investigator responsible for the validation study.

attributes.name: validation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the validation approach: prospective (before routine production), concurrent (during initial production), retrospective (using historical data), or revalidation (periodic re-qualification).
attributes.references: FDA Process Validation Guidance 2011, ICH Q7

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who created this process validation record.

products.name: work_center
products.description: Master data for manufacturing work centers — production lines, assembly stations, clean rooms, fill-finish suites, and packaging lines — where production operations are executed. Captures work center ID, name, category (machine, labor, production line), plant, cost center, capacity (shifts, hours), efficiency factor, utilization rate, GMP classification (ISO class 5/7/8, EU GMP grade A/B/C/D), associated equipment list, and qualification status. Used for production scheduling, capacity planning, and GMP environmental monitoring zone assignment. Integrates with SAP PP work center master (CR01/CR02).

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the manufacturing work center. Primary key.

attributes.name: controlled_document_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master SOP document governing operations, maintenance, and quality procedures for this work center.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.plant. Business justification: Work centers are assigned to ERP plants for capacity planning and MRP scheduling. In genomics biotech, work center availability and qualification status must be tracked per plant for production schedu

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where this work center is physically located.

attributes.name: activity_type
attributes.description: SAP CO activity type used for internal cost allocation and activity-based costing for operations performed at this work center.

attributes.name: allows_overlapping_operations
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this work center supports overlapping operations where subsequent operations can begin before the previous operation is fully complete.
attributes.references: SAP PP Routing and Work Center Master

attributes.name: available_capacity_hours_per_day
attributes.description: Total available production hours per day calculated from shifts and hours per shift, accounting for planned downtime.

attributes.name: capacity_category
attributes.description: SAP PP capacity category code used for grouping work centers with similar capacity characteristics for planning purposes.

attributes.name: capacity_hours_per_shift
attributes.description: Standard operating hours per shift for this work center, used for capacity planning and scheduling calculations.

attributes.name: capacity_shifts_per_day
attributes.description: Number of production shifts this work center operates per day (e.g., 1.0 for single shift, 2.0 for two shifts, 3.0 for continuous operation).

attributes.name: control_key
attributes.description: SAP PP control key defining how operations at this work center are scheduled, confirmed, and costed (e.g., internal processing, external processing, inspection).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this work center record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: efficiency_factor_percent
attributes.description: Standard efficiency factor as a percentage representing the work center's expected performance relative to theoretical maximum (e.g., 85.00 means 85% efficiency).

attributes.name: environmental_monitoring_zone
attributes.description: Designated environmental monitoring zone identifier for tracking particulate, microbial, and environmental parameters per GMP requirements.

attributes.name: equipment_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or summary of major equipment assets assigned to this work center (e.g., sequencers, liquid handlers, autoclaves, fill-finish machines).

attributes.name: formula_key
attributes.description: SAP PP formula key used for calculating operation times, setup times, and processing times based on lot size and work center parameters.

attributes.name: gmp_classification
attributes.description: GMP environmental classification for the work center indicating cleanroom grade per ISO 14644 (Class 5/7/8) or EU GMP Annex 1 (Grade A/B/C/D), or non-GMP for non-controlled areas. Critical for IVD and RUO product manufacturing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: iso_class_5|iso_class_7|iso_class_8|eu_gmp_grade_a|eu_gmp_grade_b|eu_gmp_grade_c|eu_gmp_grade_d|non_gmp — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 14644 (Cleanroom Classification), EU GMP Annex 1, FDA 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: is_bottleneck
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this work center is identified as a production bottleneck requiring special capacity management and scheduling attention.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who last modified this work center record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this work center record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: last_qualification_date
attributes.description: Date when the work center last completed qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ) or requalification activities.

attributes.name: location_building
attributes.description: Building identifier or name where the work center is physically located within the plant.

attributes.name: location_floor
attributes.description: Floor or level within the building where the work center is located.

attributes.name: location_room
attributes.description: Room number or identifier for the specific room or area where the work center operates.

attributes.name: next_qualification_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic requalification or recertification of the work center per GMP maintenance schedules.

attributes.name: processing_time_per_unit_minutes
attributes.description: Standard processing time in minutes required to produce one unit of output at this work center, used for capacity and scheduling calculations.
attributes.references: SAP PP Routing and Work Center Master

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current qualification state of the work center per GxP requirements: Installation Qualification (IQ), Operational Qualification (OQ), Performance Qualification (PQ), fully qualified, or requiring requalification.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211, ISO 13485, GxP Guidelines

attributes.name: queue_time_minutes
attributes.description: Standard queue time in minutes representing the typical wait time before an operation can start at this work center.

attributes.name: requires_batch_record
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether operations at this work center require formal GMP batch record documentation and electronic batch record (EBR) execution.

attributes.name: scheduling_type
attributes.description: Default scheduling direction for operations at this work center (forward from start date, backward from due date, or midpoint scheduling).

attributes.name: setup_time_minutes
attributes.description: Standard setup or changeover time in minutes required to prepare the work center for a new production run or product changeover.
attributes.references: SAP PP Routing and Work Center Master

attributes.name: standard_value_key
attributes.description: SAP PP standard value key defining the costing and time calculation parameters for operations performed at this work center.

attributes.name: teardown_time_minutes
attributes.description: Standard teardown or cleanup time in minutes required after completing a production run, including cleaning and decontamination for GMP compliance.
attributes.references: SAP PP Routing and Work Center Master

attributes.name: usage_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for tracking work center usage and capacity consumption (e.g., hours, minutes, units produced, batches, cycles).

attributes.name: utilization_rate_percent
attributes.description: Current utilization rate as a percentage of available capacity actually used for production operations.

attributes.name: work_center_category
attributes.description: Classification of the work center type indicating its primary operational mode (machine-based, labor-intensive, full production line, assembly station, controlled environment clean room, or packaging line).

attributes.name: work_center_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the work center used in production planning and scheduling. Externally visible code used in SAP PP module.

attributes.name: work_center_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the work center's purpose, capabilities, and operational scope.

attributes.name: work_center_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the work center (e.g., 'Flow Cell Assembly Line 3', 'Reagent Fill-Finish Suite A', 'NGS Library Prep Station').

attributes.name: work_center_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the work center in its lifecycle (active for production, inactive/idle, under maintenance, undergoing qualification, or permanently decommissioned).

Integrates with SAP QM usage decision and Veeva Vault batch release workflow.

attributes.name: sap_qm_inspection_lot

attributes.name: storage_condition_requirement

products.name: production_routing
products.description: Master data defining the sequence of manufacturing operations (routing) required to produce a specific product, including standard times, work center assignments, and control keys. Captures routing number, routing group, material/product, plant, routing status (active, inactive), valid-from/valid-to dates, total standard lead time, operation sequence with operation numbers, work center per operation, standard setup/machine/labor times, GMP-critical operation flags, electronic signature requirement per operation, and MES integration reference. Serves as the manufacturing process template for work order generation and shop-floor execution. Integrates with SAP PP routing (CA01/CA02).

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the production routing master record. Primary key for the routing entity.

attributes.name: controlled_document_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master SOP document that governs the execution of this routing. Links routing to controlled documentation for GMP compliance.

attributes.name: plant_id

attributes.name: primary_production_sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product or material that this routing produces. Links to the master product catalog.

attributes.name: product_bom_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Bill of Materials that defines the components and materials consumed during execution of this routing. Links routing to material requirements.

attributes.name: research_protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.protocol. Business justification: Production routings are industrialized versions of research protocols. Tech transfer process scales lab protocols to manufacturing SOPs. Essential for traceability in regulatory filings, process devia

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where this routing is valid and executed. Routings are plant-specific in SAP PP.

attributes.name: submission_id

attributes.name: alternative_routing_number
attributes.description: Reference to an alternative routing that can be used if this routing is unavailable. Enables flexible production planning and capacity management.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this routing was formally approved for production use. Part of the GMP document control audit trail.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the routing in the document control workflow. Only approved routings can be released for production use.

attributes.name: base_quantity
attributes.description: Reference quantity for which the standard times in this routing are defined. Actual times are scaled proportionally based on order quantity.

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the base quantity and lot sizes (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilograms, L for liters). ISO standard unit codes.

attributes.name: change_control_number
attributes.description: Reference to the change control record that authorized the creation or last modification of this routing. Required for GMP traceability and audit compliance.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special instructions, or context about this routing. Used for operational communication and knowledge transfer.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this routing record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: gmp_classification
attributes.description: GMP criticality classification of the routing. GMP-critical routings require enhanced documentation, validation, and electronic signatures per FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and EU GMP Annex 11.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211 (GMP), EU GMP Annex 11

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this routing record was last updated. Tracks the currency of the routing data and supports change management.

attributes.name: last_validation_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent process validation study for this routing was completed and approved. Used to track validation currency.

attributes.name: lot_size_from
attributes.description: Minimum production lot size for which this routing is valid. Used in SAP PP to select the appropriate routing based on order quantity.

attributes.name: lot_size_to
attributes.description: Maximum production lot size for which this routing is valid. Enables lot-size-dependent routing selection in SAP PP.

attributes.name: mes_integration_reference
attributes.description: External reference identifier used to link this routing to the shop-floor MES system for real-time production execution and data collection.

attributes.name: next_revalidation_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the routing must undergo revalidation to maintain its validated status. Periodic revalidation is required per GMP regulations.

attributes.name: operation_count
attributes.description: Total number of manufacturing operations defined in this routing. Each operation represents a discrete production step with its own work center and times.

attributes.name: process_validation_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this routing requires formal process validation studies before use in commercial production. Required for IVD and RUO products per FDA and ISO 13485.

attributes.name: process_validation_status
attributes.description: Current status of process validation for this routing. Validated status is required before the routing can be used for commercial GMP production.

attributes.name: requires_batch_record
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether production using this routing requires a formal batch manufacturing record (BMR) for traceability and compliance. Mandatory for GMP-regulated products.

attributes.name: requires_electronic_signature
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether operations in this routing require electronic signatures for GMP compliance. True for IVD and regulated product routings per FDA 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records and Signatures)

attributes.name: routing_group
attributes.description: Group key that categorizes related routings together. Used in SAP PP to organize routings by product family or process type.

attributes.name: routing_group_counter
attributes.description: Sequential counter within the routing group to distinguish multiple routings for the same material. Part of the composite routing key in SAP PP.

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the routing. Externally-known unique code used in SAP PP for routing identification and work order generation.

attributes.name: routing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the routing. Active routings are available for work order generation, released routings are approved for production, locked routings are temporarily unavailable, and obsolete routings are retired.

attributes.name: routing_type
attributes.description: Classification of the routing by its usage pattern. Standard routings are used for regular production, rate routings for repetitive manufacturing, reference routings as templates, and special routings for one-time or custom orders.

attributes.name: routing_usage
attributes.description: SAP PP usage indicator defining the purpose of the routing (1=production, 2=maintenance, 3=quality inspection, etc.). Controls which business processes can reference this routing.

attributes.name: total_labor_time_minutes
attributes.description: Sum of all labor times across all operations in the routing for the base quantity. Labor time represents manual work and scales with lot size.

attributes.name: total_machine_time_minutes
attributes.description: Sum of all machine processing times across all operations in the routing for the base quantity. Machine time is equipment-dependent and scales with lot size.

attributes.name: total_setup_time_minutes
attributes.description: Sum of all setup times across all operations in the routing. Setup time is independent of lot size and occurs once per production run.

attributes.name: total_standard_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Total manufacturing lead time in days required to complete all operations in this routing, including setup, processing, queue, and move times. Used for production planning and scheduling.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this routing becomes effective and can be used for work order generation. Part of the routing validity period.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this routing remains valid. Nullable for routings with indefinite validity. After this date, the routing cannot be used for new work orders.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for this routing. Incremented with each approved change to maintain change history and support regulatory traceability.

products.name: validation_run
products.description: This association product represents the formal designation of a production batch as an executed run within a process validation study. It captures the operational and regulatory evidence generated when a specific production batch is used to demonstrate process consistency for a validation study. Each record links one process_validation study to one production_batch and carries run-specific attributes — sequence number, outcome, acceptance status, run date, and deviation count — that exist only in the context of this specific batch-within-study execution. Governed by ICH Q7, FDA Process Validation Guidance (2011), and EMA guidelines.. Existence Justification: In GMP biotech/genomics manufacturing, process validation studies formally designate specific production batches as 'validation runs' — this is a regulated, actively managed business activity governed by ICH Q7 and FDA Process Validation Guidance (2011). One validation study requires multiple batches (typically 3 consecutive runs minimum per regulatory guidance), and one production batch can legitimately serve as a validation run for multiple concurrent studies (e.g., a batch validating both a new process parameter and a site transfer simultaneously). The 'Validation Run' is a recognized regulatory and operational concept with its own data (run sequence, outcome, acceptance status) that belongs to neither the validation study nor the batch record alone.

attributes.name: validation_run_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the validation_run association

attributes.name: process_validation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the process validation study for which this batch serves as a validation run.

attributes.name: production_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the production batch designated as a validation run.

attributes.name: acceptance_status
attributes.description: Whether this run met the acceptance criteria defined in the validation protocol. Values: ACCEPTED, REJECTED, PENDING_REVIEW. Belongs to the relationship because acceptance is evaluated against the specific study's protocol criteria, not the batch's general quality disposition.

attributes.name: deviation_count
attributes.description: Number of deviations recorded specifically during the execution of this batch as a validation run. Distinct from the production_batch.deviation_count which covers all batch deviations. Run-specific deviations are evaluated against the validation protocol's acceptance criteria.

attributes.name: run_date
attributes.description: The date on which this production batch was executed as a validation run. May differ from the batch's manufacturing_start_date if the batch was produced for other purposes and subsequently designated as a validation run.

attributes.name: run_outcome
attributes.description: The overall outcome of this specific validation run: PASS, FAIL, or INCONCLUSIVE. Distinct from batch disposition — a batch may be released (PASS disposition) but still FAIL a validation run criterion.

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: The sequential order of this batch within the validation study (e.g., 1, 2, 3). Required by regulatory guidance to demonstrate consecutive run consistency. Belongs to the relationship, not to the batch or study alone.
attributes.references: FDA Process Validation Guidance (2011), ICH Q7

attributes.description: Three-digit SAP movement type code that classifies the nature of the stock movement (e.g., 101=Goods Receipt from PO, 261=Goods Issue to Production Order, 311=Transfer Posting, 551=Scrapping). Determines accounting impact and inventory valuation logic.

attributes.name: movement_type_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the movement type (e.g., Goods Receipt, Goods Issue, Stock Transfer, Return, Scrapping).

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the stock movement was posted to the material ledger and financial accounting. Used for period-end closing and Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) calculation.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of material moved, expressed in the base unit of measure. Positive for receipts, negative for issues in some reporting contexts.

attributes.name: quantity_in_entry_unit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Quantity in Entry Unit of Measure (UOM)
attributes.description: The quantity in the unit of measure used during data entry (e.g., purchase order unit). May differ from base unit for conversion tracking.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the business reason for the stock movement (e.g., quality defect, expiration, customer return, process scrap). Used for root cause analysis and Quality Assurance (QA) investigations.

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the movement reason code.

attributes.name: reservation_line_item
attributes.description: Line item number within the reservation document.

attributes.name: reservation_number
attributes.description: Reference to the material reservation document if this movement fulfills a reservation (e.g., for production or project consumption).

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this movement is a reversal (cancellation) of a previous material document. True if reversal, False otherwise.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The material document number that this movement reverses. Populated only if reversal_indicator is True.

attributes.name: sales_order_line_item
attributes.description: Line item number within the sales order. Identifies the specific material line being shipped.

attributes.name: sales_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the sales order if this movement is a goods issue for customer delivery. Links to Order Management (SD) process.

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: Single-character code indicating special stock scenarios (e.g., consignment stock, project stock, sales order stock). Blank for standard stock.

attributes.name: stock_type
attributes.description: Classification of the stock status: unrestricted (available for use), quality_inspection (under QC testing), blocked (quarantined), or restricted (conditionally available). Critical for GMP compliance and Quality Control (QC) workflows.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the quantity is expressed (e.g., EA=Each, KG=Kilogram, L=Liter, BOX=Box). Aligns with ISO unit codes where applicable.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this stock movement record was last updated in the data warehouse. Used for change tracking and incremental load processing.

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: Sub-classification of material for split valuation purposes (e.g., different pricing for domestic vs. imported batches). Blank if not used.

products.name: batch
products.description: Master record for a specific production or procurement batch of a material, enabling full lot traceability from supplier through manufacturing to customer delivery. Captures batch number, material reference, manufacturing date, expiry date, COA number, QC release status, storage conditions, cold-chain compliance flag, GMP classification, and batch origin (internal production vs. external procurement). Critical for GxP compliance, recall management, and reagent/consumable quality assurance. Sourced from SAP MM/QM (MCH1/MCHA).

attributes.name: batch_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the production or procurement batch. Primary key for the batch master record.

attributes.name: approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.regulatory_approval. Business justification: GMP batch release requires verification that batch specifications conform to approved regulatory dossier. Critical for QC disposition decisions, certificate of analysis generation, and ensuring batche

attributes.name: device_identifier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.device_identifier. Business justification: FDA UDI rule and EU MDR require lot/batch-level UDI-PI traceability linking each batch to its UDI device identifier. material has device_identifier_id for product-level UDI, but batch-level UDI tracea

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for which this batch was produced or procured. Links to the material product in the supply domain.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or facility where the batch was produced. Links to the facility master in the supply or manufacturing domain.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order under which this batch was procured. Null for internally manufactured batches.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier master record if the batch was externally procured. Null for internally manufactured batches.

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary warehouse location where the batch is stored. Links to warehouse master in the supply domain.

attributes.name: available_quantity
attributes.description: Current unrestricted quantity available for use or shipment from this batch. Updated in real-time as inventory is consumed or reserved.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Business-facing batch or lot number assigned to the production or procurement batch. Used for traceability and quality control. Also known as lot number.

attributes.name: batch_status
attributes.description: Overall lifecycle status of the batch indicating its current state in inventory and usability.
attributes.references: SAP MM Custom Field; GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: blocked_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity from this batch that is blocked for quality or compliance reasons and cannot be used or shipped until released.

attributes.name: coa_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Certificate of Analysis document that certifies the batch meets quality specifications. Required for GMP compliance and customer shipments.
attributes.references: GMP Guidelines; ISO 13485 Section 7.5.3; SAP QM Custom Field

attributes.name: cold_chain_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the batch has been maintained within required cold-chain temperature ranges throughout its lifecycle. False indicates a temperature excursion event occurred.
attributes.references: GMP Guidelines; ISO 13485 Section 7.5.5; Custom Field

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating where the batch was manufactured or procured. Required for customs, trade compliance, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; SAP MM Custom Field

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the batch record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: SAP MM MCH1-ERSDA; SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which the batch should not be used due to potential degradation or loss of efficacy. Mandatory for reagents, consumables, and IVD products.
attributes.references: SAP MM MCH1-VFDAT; FDA 21 CFR Part 820; ISO 13485 Section 7.5.3

attributes.name: gmp_classification
attributes.description: Indicates whether the batch was manufactured under GMP, non-GMP, or GMP-equivalent conditions. Critical for regulatory compliance and product classification.
attributes.references: GMP Guidelines; FDA 21 CFR Part 820; EMA GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the batch contains hazardous materials requiring special handling, storage, and shipping procedures.
attributes.references: OSHA HCS 29 CFR 1910.1200; DOT 49 CFR; Custom Field

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified the batch record. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: SAP MM Custom Field; SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the batch record was last updated in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: SAP MM MCH1-LAEDA; SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: manufacturing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the batch was manufactured or produced. Critical for shelf-life calculation and expiry determination.
attributes.references: SAP MM MCH1-HSDAT; ISO 13485 Section 7.5.3; GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: origin
attributes.description: Source of the batch indicating whether it was produced internally, procured from an external supplier, manufactured by a contract manufacturer, reworked from a previous batch, or is a sample batch.
attributes.references: GMP Guidelines; SAP MM Custom Field

attributes.name: qc_release_date
attributes.description: Date on which the batch was officially released by Quality Assurance for use or distribution. Null if batch is not yet released.
attributes.references: SAP QM Custom Field; ISO 13485 Section 8.2.4

attributes.name: qc_status
attributes.description: Current quality control release status of the batch. Only released batches are available for use or shipment. Managed by Quality Management module.
attributes.references: SAP QM QALS-PASTRTERM; ISO 13485 Section 8.2.4; GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: quarantine_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity from this batch that is in quality inspection and not yet released for use. Managed by Quality Management.

attributes.name: recall_date
attributes.description: Date on which the recall was initiated for this batch. Null if no recall has been issued.

attributes.name: recall_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this batch is subject to a product recall. True triggers immediate inventory blocking and customer notification workflows.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7; ISO 13485 Section 8.5.1; Custom Field

attributes.name: recall_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the batch was recalled. Includes quality defect description, safety concern, or regulatory non-compliance issue.

attributes.name: regulatory_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory category of the batch indicating its intended use and compliance requirements. IVD (In Vitro Diagnostic), RUO (Research Use Only), GMP API (Good Manufacturing Practice Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820; IVDR 2017/746; Custom Field

attributes.name: retest_date
attributes.description: Date by which the batch must be retested to confirm continued quality and stability. Applicable to raw materials and intermediates.
attributes.references: SAP MM MCH1-VFDAT; GMP Guidelines; ICH Q7

attributes.name: sds_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Safety Data Sheet associated with this batch. Required for hazardous materials and chemicals.
attributes.references: OSHA HCS 29 CFR 1910.1200; GHS; Custom Field

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Total shelf life of the batch in days from manufacturing date to expiry date. Used for inventory planning and FEFO (First Expired First Out) logic.
attributes.references: SAP MM Custom Field; GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: size_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity produced or procured in this batch. Expressed in the base unit of measure for the material.

attributes.name: size_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the batch size quantity. Examples: EA (each), KG (kilogram), L (liter), ML (milliliter).

attributes.name: sterilization_date
attributes.description: Date on which the batch was sterilized. Null if sterilization is not applicable.

attributes.name: sterilization_method
attributes.description: Method used to sterilize the batch if applicable. Critical for consumables and reagents used in clinical or diagnostic applications.

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required storage condition for the batch to maintain quality and stability. Defines temperature and environmental requirements.
attributes.references: SAP MM Custom Field; GMP Guidelines; ISO 13485 Section 7.5.5

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the batch. Exceeding this threshold may compromise batch quality.

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the batch. Used for cold-chain monitoring and compliance.

attributes.name: supplier_batch_number
attributes.description: Original batch or lot number assigned by the supplier for externally procured materials. Used for supplier traceability and quality investigations.
attributes.references: SAP MM Custom Field; GMP Guidelines

products.name: inbound_delivery
products.description: Logistics document tracking the physical inbound shipment of materials from a supplier to a Genomics Biotech receiving location. Captures delivery number, carrier, tracking number, expected arrival date, actual arrival date, incoterms, cold-chain monitoring device ID, temperature excursion flag, number of packages, total weight, and customs clearance status for international shipments. Links to purchase orders and triggers goods receipt processing. Sourced from SAP MM/LE (LIKP/LIPS).

attributes.name: inbound_delivery_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inbound delivery document. Primary key for the inbound delivery entity.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order that triggered this inbound delivery. Links delivery to procurement document.

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.submission. Business justification: Import clearance for regulated genomics/IVD products (sequencing reagents, diagnostic kits) requires referencing the import license or regulatory submission. inbound_delivery already tracks customs_cl

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor who is shipping the materials. Primary counterparty for this inbound delivery.

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Genomics Biotech facility, warehouse, or laboratory receiving the inbound shipment.

attributes.name: actual_arrival_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the shipment physically arrived at the receiving dock. Critical for TAT (Turnaround Time) measurement and SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance.

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: Carrier-issued document serving as receipt of goods and contract of carriage. Required for international shipments and freight claims.

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the logistics carrier or freight forwarder responsible for transporting the shipment.

attributes.name: cold_chain_device_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the temperature monitoring device attached to the shipment. Essential for reagent and consumable shipments requiring temperature control per GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice).

attributes.name: commercial_invoice_number
attributes.description: Supplier invoice number associated with this delivery. Used for three-way match in accounts payable (invoice, PO, goods receipt).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the inbound delivery record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: customs_clearance_date
attributes.description: Date when customs clearance was completed for international shipments. Impacts delivery lead time and TAT (Turnaround Time).

attributes.name: customs_clearance_status
attributes.description: Status of customs clearance process for international shipments. Critical for cross-border deliveries of reagents, instruments, and consumables.

attributes.name: delivery_note_text
attributes.description: Free-text notes or special instructions related to the inbound delivery. Captures handling requirements, supplier communications, or receiving observations.

attributes.name: delivery_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the inbound delivery document. Used for tracking and communication with suppliers.

attributes.name: delivery_priority
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to the inbound delivery. Determines receiving sequence and expedited handling for critical reagents or time-sensitive materials.

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Current state of the inbound delivery in its lifecycle. Tracks progression from planning through goods receipt posting.

attributes.name: expected_arrival_date
attributes.description: Planned date when the inbound delivery is expected to arrive at the receiving location. Used for warehouse planning and scheduling.

attributes.name: freight_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total freight and transportation cost for the inbound delivery. Contributes to landed cost calculation and COGS (Cost of Goods Sold).

attributes.name: freight_cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for freight cost amount. Required for multi-currency operations and financial reporting.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date when goods receipt was posted in the system, triggering inventory update and invoice verification. Key event for COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) recognition.

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment contains hazardous materials requiring special handling per SDS (Safety Data Sheet) and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms defining the division of costs and risks between supplier and buyer. Critical for international shipments and customs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: inspection_lot_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the quality inspection lot created for this inbound delivery. Links to QC (Quality Control) results and COA (Certificate of Analysis).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the inbound delivery record was last updated. Tracks changes for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: max_temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Highest temperature recorded during shipment transit in degrees Celsius. Used for cold-chain validation and quality assessment.

attributes.name: min_temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Lowest temperature recorded during shipment transit in degrees Celsius. Used for cold-chain validation and quality assessment.

attributes.name: package_count
attributes.description: Total number of packages, boxes, or containers in the inbound delivery. Used for receiving verification and warehouse handling.

attributes.name: packing_list_number
attributes.description: Supplier-provided packing list identifier detailing contents of the shipment. Used for receiving verification and quality inspection.

attributes.name: proof_of_delivery_document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the signed proof of delivery document. Used for dispute resolution and freight claim processing.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether incoming materials require QC (Quality Control) inspection before goods receipt posting. Critical for GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) compliance.

attributes.name: receiving_dock_location
attributes.description: Specific dock, bay, or receiving area within the facility where the delivery was unloaded. Used for warehouse operations and material flow tracking.

attributes.name: shipping_point
attributes.description: Supplier facility or warehouse location from which the shipment originated. Used for supplier performance analysis and lead time calculation.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system that created or last updated this delivery record. Supports data lineage and integration troubleshooting.

attributes.name: temperature_excursion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment experienced temperature deviations outside acceptable range during transit. Critical for quality control and product acceptance decisions.

attributes.name: total_volume_m3
attributes.description: Total volume of the inbound delivery in cubic meters. Used for warehouse space allocation and freight cost calculation.

attributes.name: total_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of the entire inbound delivery in kilograms. Used for freight cost validation and warehouse capacity planning.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier-provided tracking identifier for real-time shipment visibility and proof of delivery.

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: UN number identifying hazardous materials classification for dangerous goods in shipment. Required for HAZMAT compliance.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: supplier_id

attributes.name: approval_date

attributes.name: approved_by_name
attributes.description: Name of the authorized person who approved this contract on behalf of the purchasing organization.

attributes.name: cold_chain_required_flag

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Legal entity or company code under which this contract is executed. Four-character SAP company code for financial and legal segregation.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the procurement contract or scheduling agreement. Sourced from SAP MM EKKO-EBELN.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the supplier contract: draft (under negotiation), active (in force), suspended (temporarily paused), expired (validity period ended), terminated (cancelled before expiry), or closed (completed and archived).

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the procurement contract defining the commitment structure: value contract (monetary ceiling), quantity contract (volume ceiling), scheduling agreement (delivery schedule), blanket order, framework agreement, or master agreement.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contract record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values in this contract (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: delivery_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard lead time in days from purchase order release to expected delivery at the receiving location. Used for material planning and scheduling.

attributes.name: gmp_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether materials supplied under this contract must comply with GMP regulations for pharmaceutical and biotechnology manufacturing. True if GMP compliance is mandatory.

attributes.name: incoterms

attributes.name: incoterms_location
attributes.description: Named place or port specified in the Incoterms clause where risk and cost transfer occurs (e.g., San Diego Port, Frankfurt Airport).

attributes.name: maximum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum quantity that can be ordered per release or purchase order as agreed with the supplier. Enforces supplier capacity constraints.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity that must be ordered per release or purchase order as agreed with the supplier. Enforces supplier MOQ requirements.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contract record was last modified. Audit trail for record updates.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Payment terms code defining the payment schedule and conditions agreed with the supplier (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30). Four-character SAP payment terms key.

attributes.name: price_adjustment_clause
attributes.description: Description of the price adjustment mechanism or escalation clause agreed in the contract (e.g., annual CPI adjustment, raw material index-linked pricing).

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Buyer or procurement team responsible for this contract. Three-character code identifying the purchasing group within the organization.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization
attributes.description: SAP organizational unit responsible for negotiating and managing this contract. Typically a four-character code representing a procurement division or business unit.

attributes.name: quality_agreement_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the quality agreement or quality technical agreement (QTA) associated with this contract, defining quality specifications, testing requirements, and acceptance criteria.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing specific regulatory compliance requirements, certifications, or clauses applicable to this contract (e.g., FDA registration, ISO 13485 certification, GDPR data processing terms).

attributes.name: release_strategy
attributes.description: Strategy for releasing purchase orders or delivery schedules against this contract: automatic (system-triggered), manual (buyer-initiated), scheduled (time-based), forecast-based (demand-driven), or JIT (Just-In-Time).

attributes.name: renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract is eligible for automatic renewal upon expiry. True if renewal is enabled.

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days before contract expiry that renewal notice must be provided to the supplier or by the supplier to continue the contract.

attributes.name: sla_on_time_delivery_target_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) On-Time Delivery Target Percentage
attributes.description: Target percentage for on-time delivery performance agreed in the SLA. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 95.00 for 95%).

attributes.name: sla_turnaround_time_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Turnaround Time (TAT) Hours
attributes.description: Maximum turnaround time in hours committed by the supplier for order fulfillment or service delivery under this contract. Key SLA metric for performance monitoring.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system from which this contract record was sourced (e.g., SAP MM, Oracle Procurement, Ariba, Manual entry).

attributes.name: target_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity committed under this contract for quantity contracts. Represents the volume of materials or units to be procured over the contract period.

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: Total monetary value committed under this contract for value contracts. Represents the maximum spend ceiling or target procurement value over the contract period.

attributes.name: temperature_range_max_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum temperature in Celsius for storage and transportation of materials under this contract. Applicable for temperature-sensitive reagents and consumables.
attributes.references: WHO Guidelines on Cold Chain Management

attributes.name: temperature_range_min_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum temperature in Celsius for storage and transportation of materials under this contract. Applicable for temperature-sensitive reagents and consumables.
attributes.references: WHO Guidelines on Cold Chain Management

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice required to terminate this contract before its natural expiry date, as agreed in the contract terms.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for quantities specified in this contract (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilogram, L for liter). Aligns with ISO standards and SAP UOM.

attributes.name: validity_end_date

attributes.name: validity_start_date

products.name: warehouse_location
products.description: Master record for physical storage locations within Genomics Biotech warehouses and distribution centers — including ambient, refrigerated (2–8°C), frozen (−20°C, −80°C), and ultra-cold (liquid nitrogen) zones required for biological reagents, flow cells, and CRISPR components. Captures warehouse number, storage type, storage section, bin location, temperature zone, capacity (weight/volume), hazardous material classification (UN number, hazard class, storage incompatibilities), GMP zone classification, and current utilization. Supports cold-chain zone management and regulatory compliance for transport/storage of hazardous genomics inputs. Sourced from SAP WM/EWM.

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the physical storage location within the warehouse or distribution center. Primary key.

attributes.name: warehouse_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent warehouse or distribution center facility where this storage location resides.

attributes.name: aisle_number
attributes.description: Aisle identifier within the warehouse where this storage location resides. Used for warehouse navigation and picking route optimization.

attributes.name: batch_managed_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether inventory stored in this location requires batch or lot number tracking. True if batch management is enforced for traceability and quality control. Critical for reagents, flow cells, and consumables subject to Certificate of Analysis (COA) requirements.

attributes.name: bin_location
attributes.description: Specific bin, shelf, or pallet position within the storage section. Represents the most granular physical address for inventory placement (e.g., A12-R03-B05).

attributes.name: blocked_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the storage location is currently blocked for use due to maintenance, damage, temperature excursion, or other operational issues. True if location is unavailable for inventory placement or retrieval.

attributes.name: blocked_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the storage location is blocked (e.g., 'Temperature excursion detected', 'Structural damage', 'Scheduled maintenance'). Populated only when blocked_indicator is True.

attributes.name: capacity_volume_m3
attributes.description: Maximum volumetric capacity of the storage location in cubic meters. Used for space utilization planning and warehouse optimization.

attributes.name: capacity_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum weight capacity of the storage location in kilograms. Used for load planning and safety compliance to prevent structural overload.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this storage location record was first created in the warehouse management system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: current_utilization_percent
attributes.description: Current utilization of the storage location as a percentage of total capacity (weight or volume). Calculated based on inventory currently stored. Used for warehouse efficiency KPIs and replenishment planning.

attributes.name: cycle_count_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this storage location is included in regular cycle counting programs for inventory accuracy verification. True if location is subject to periodic physical counts.

attributes.name: fefo_enforcement
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether First Expired First Out (FEFO) inventory rotation is enforced for this storage location. True if the WMS must prioritize inventory with the earliest expiration date for picking. Used for biological reagents, enzymes, and flow cells with strict shelf-life requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.142, SAP EWM FEFO Strategy

attributes.name: fifo_enforcement

attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.142, SAP EWM FIFO Strategy

attributes.name: gmp_zone_classification
attributes.description: GMP cleanliness classification for the storage location. attributes.name: hazard_class

attributes.name: hazmat_indicator

attributes.name: last_cycle_count_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent cycle count performed for this storage location. Used to schedule next cycle count and monitor inventory accuracy compliance.

attributes.name: level_number
attributes.description: Vertical level or shelf position within the rack (e.g., 1 for ground level, 2 for first shelf above ground). Used for ergonomic picking optimization and safety compliance.

attributes.name: location_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the storage location. Active for normal use, inactive for temporarily unused, blocked for operational issues, quarantine for QC hold, maintenance for scheduled work, decommissioned for permanently retired locations.

attributes.name: mixed_storage_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this storage location allows multiple Stock Keeping Units (SKUs) to be stored simultaneously. True if mixed SKU storage is permitted, False if location is dedicated to a single SKU.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this storage location record. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SAP EWM Audit Trail, SOX Compliance

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this storage location record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: picking_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this storage location is designated for active picking operations (order fulfillment). True if location is in the pick zone, False if it is a reserve or bulk storage location.

attributes.name: picking_strategy
attributes.description: WMS strategy for selecting inventory from this storage location during order fulfillment. FIFO for oldest first, FEFO for earliest expiration first, LIFO for last in first out, nearest_location for travel optimization, highest_stock for inventory balancing.

attributes.name: putaway_strategy
attributes.description: Warehouse management system (WMS) strategy for directing incoming inventory to this storage location. Fixed_bin for dedicated SKU locations, next_empty_bin for dynamic allocation, bulk_storage for pallet-level storage, high_rack for vertical storage systems, floor_storage for oversized items.

attributes.name: quarantine_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this storage location is designated for quarantined inventory pending quality control (QC) release or investigation. True if location is restricted for quarantine use only.

attributes.name: rack_number
attributes.description: Rack or shelving unit identifier within the aisle. Used for precise physical location addressing.

attributes.name: replenishment_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this storage location requires automatic replenishment from reserve storage when inventory falls below a threshold. True if location is part of an automated replenishment strategy.

attributes.name: serial_number_managed_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether inventory stored in this location requires serial number tracking at the individual unit level. True if serial number management is enforced. Used for high-value instruments, flow cells, and components requiring unit-level traceability.

attributes.name: storage_incompatibilities
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of hazard classes or material types that must NOT be stored in proximity to this location due to chemical incompatibility (e.g., 'acids,oxidizers'). Used to enforce segregation rules and prevent dangerous reactions.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the storage location, typically a combination of warehouse number, aisle, rack, and bin identifiers (e.g., WH01-A12-R03-B05). Used for operational picking and putaway instructions.
attributes.references: SAP MM Storage Location, SAP EWM Storage Bin

attributes.name: storage_section
attributes.description: Logical subdivision within the warehouse (e.g., aisle, zone, or area designation) used to organize storage locations by product category, temperature zone, or operational workflow.

attributes.name: storage_type
attributes.description: Classification of the storage environment based on temperature control and regulatory requirements. Ambient for room temperature, refrigerated for 2–8°C, frozen for −20°C or −80°C, ultra_cold for liquid nitrogen storage, hazmat for hazardous materials, gmp_controlled for Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) zones.

attributes.name: temperature_max_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum allowable temperature in degrees Celsius for this storage location. Excursions beyond this threshold trigger quality alerts and potential quarantine of affected inventory.

attributes.name: temperature_min_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum allowable temperature in degrees Celsius for this storage location. Used for cold-chain monitoring and compliance validation.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Controlled temperature range for the storage location. Critical for cold-chain management of biological reagents, flow cells, enzymes, and CRISPR components. Values: ambient (15–25°C), 2_to_8_celsius (refrigerated), minus_20_celsius (frozen), minus_80_celsius (ultra-frozen), liquid_nitrogen (−196°C).

attributes.name: un_number

attributes.name: y_coordinate
attributes.description: Y-axis coordinate of the storage location within the warehouse floor plan (in meters). Used for AGV navigation and warehouse mapping.

attributes.name: z_coordinate
attributes.description: Z-axis (height) coordinate of the storage location within the warehouse (in meters). Used for vertical storage systems and automated retrieval systems.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review or re-qualification of the supplier. Ensures ongoing compliance and performance monitoring.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special conditions related to the supplier qualification. May include restrictions, special handling requirements, or historical context.

attributes.name: qualification_date

attributes.name: qualification_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the supplier qualification record, typically generated by Veeva Vault or SAP QM (Quality Management) module. Format: SQ-NNNNNNNN.

attributes.name: qualification_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the Quality Assurance (QA) or procurement professional responsible for managing this supplier qualification record.

attributes.name: qualification_score
attributes.description: Numerical score assigned to the supplier based on qualification assessment criteria (e.g., audit results, documentation completeness, certifications, past performance). Scale typically 0-100.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current status of the supplier qualification: approved (fully qualified), conditional (qualified with restrictions or corrective actions required), suspended (temporarily not approved), disqualified (failed qualification), pending (awaiting decision), or under_review (evaluation in progress).

attributes.name: qualification_type
attributes.description: Type of supplier qualification process conducted: initial (first-time qualification), re-qualification (periodic renewal), audit-based (triggered by on-site audit), risk-based (triggered by risk assessment), expedited (fast-track for low-risk suppliers), or conditional (qualified with restrictions).

attributes.name: regulatory_body_alignment
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of regulatory bodies and standards to which this supplier qualification aligns (e.g., FDA, EMA, ISO 13485, ISO 9001, CLIA, CAP). Indicates the regulatory frameworks under which the supplier is qualified.

attributes.name: reinstatement_date
attributes.description: Date on which a previously suspended supplier qualification was reinstated following successful corrective actions. Nullable if never suspended or not yet reinstated.

attributes.description: Frequency (in months) at which the supplier qualification must be reviewed or renewed. Typically 12, 24, or 36 months depending on risk tier and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: risk_tier
attributes.description: Risk classification of the supplier based on the criticality of supplied materials, regulatory requirements, and supply chain impact: critical (single-source GMP materials), high (GMP or critical non-GMP), medium (important non-GMP), or low (commodity materials).

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: Date on which the supplier qualification was suspended or revoked. Nullable if never suspended.

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Reason for suspension or disqualification of the supplier, if applicable. May include quality issues, audit failures, regulatory non-compliance, or business reasons. Nullable if status is not suspended or disqualified.

domains.name: quality
domains.description: Enterprise-wide quality management system encompassing QC testing, QA oversight, CAPA, deviation management, audit trails, SOP management, document control, training qualification tracking, and regulatory inspection readiness. Integrates Veeva Vault and MasterControl for controlled document management. Ensures compliance with GxP, ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, CLIA, and CAP requirements.

products.name: capa
products.description: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) master record tracking the full lifecycle of quality issues requiring systematic investigation and remediation. Captures CAPA initiation trigger (deviation, audit finding, complaint, OOS result), root cause analysis methodology (5-Why, Fishbone, FTA), effectiveness check criteria, GxP classification, regulatory impact assessment, and closure approval chain. Integrates with Veeva Vault for controlled document linkage and MasterControl for associated SOP updates. Supports FDA 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 13485 Clause 8.5.2, and ICH Q10 CAPA system requirements.
